SCHEME NAME: Assistance for Quality Enhancement
TAGS: Intellectual Property, Micro Enterprises, Quality Certification, Quality Enhancement, Reimbursement, Small Enterprises
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The "Assistance for Quality Enhancement" scheme was started under Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024 by the Department of Industries & Commerce, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme envisages to support Micro and Small enterprises in state to improve the quality of their products and processes through assistance towards the cost incurred for quality certification as well as other system certifications and Intellectual Property Right. This scheme will remain in force until 31st March 2029.
Scheme Implementation
This scheme component is implemented through the respective District Industries & Commerce Centers (DICCs) in their districts under the aegis of the Department of Industries & Commerce. Office of the Commissioner, Industries & Commerce will be the nodal agency for the implementation and supervision of the scheme at the state level.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
One-Time Financial Assistance:
Reimbursement of up to 50% of the total cost incurred for obtaining quality certifications (e.g., BIS, FSSAI), system certifications (e.g., ISO, ZED), and Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs), subject to a maximum of ₹3,00,000/- per unit.
Note:
Micro and Small Enterprises may acquire such certifications from any government agency or an agency authorized by the Government of India or the Government of Rajasthan.
Costs Covered:
Documentation and consultation fees
Testing and calibration charges
Accreditation, license, and application fees
Mode of Disbursement:
The approved amount is directly transferred to the applicant’s authorized bank account.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
All Micro and Small Enterprises existing anywhere in Rajasthan will be required to comply with the following conditions to avail benefits under the scheme:
The enterprise will be required to have Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) as per MSME Development Act 2006.
The enterprise should apply for the one-time reimbursement within 12 months of obtaining the quality certification/(s).
Cost of certification will include documentation, testing, accreditation fee, consultation fee, and calibration charges (till the enterprise obtain the certificate), application fee, license fee and other relevant fees.
Certification should be related to the product or process of the enterprise.
The enterprise should be in commercial production at the time of disbursement and the assistance shall not be released to the closed unit.
One MSME enterprise can apply only once under the scheme.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Application Process:
Step 1:
The interested applicant downloads the application form
(Annexure 4.1)
from the official website.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the respective General Manager, District Industries & Commerce Centre (DICC).
Verification Process:
Step 1:
The District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) will review and approve, partially approve, or reject the application.
Step 2:
Upon approval, an approval letter will be issued by the GM, DICC.
Step 3:
The sanctioned assistance will be disbursed to the applicant’s authorized bank account.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Copy of Udyam Registration Certificate
Certificate of Incorporation/Partnership Deed/Firm Registration (as applicable)
Board Resolution or Power of Attorney in the name of Authorized Signatory
Copy of Certification/IPR and other related documents
Bills of Eligible Expenses and Proof of Payment
Proof of Regular Commercial Production (e.g., Recent Sale Bill)
Bank Account Details (Cancelled Cheque) and PAN Card
Undertaking/Declaration on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper (
Annexure 4.2
)
CA-Certified Statement of Expenditure (
Annexure 4.3
)

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Rajasthan
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/afqe
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Who can apply under this scheme?
Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) operating in Rajasthan with valid Udyam Registration.
What is the objective of the scheme?
To support MSEs in improving product and process quality through quality certifications and IPRs.
﻿
﻿
What is the maximum financial assistance provided?
Up to ₹3,00,000 per enterprise as a one-time reimbursement.
﻿
What is the validity period of the scheme?
Until 31st March 2029.
How is the assistance amount disbursed?
It is transferred directly to the enterprise’s bank account after approval.
What is the application deadline after getting the certification?
Applications must be submitted within 12 months of obtaining the certification.
Who approves the application?
The District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC).
Where should I submit the application?
To the General Manager of the concerned District Industries & Commerce Centre (DICC).
What types of certifications are covered under this scheme?
BIS, FSSAI, ISO, ZED, and IPR among others.
Can I apply more than once for different certifications?
No, only one application per enterprise is allowed.
Is the scheme applicable to enterprises outside Rajasthan?
No, it is applicable only to enterprises located in Rajasthan.
What if the enterprise is not in commercial production at the time of disbursement?
The application will be rejected as the enterprise must be in commercial production.

TAGS: Cooperative Society, Farmer, Farmer Group, Financial Assistance, General Category, HRT-2, Post-Harvest Management, Shorting Equipment, Tools
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme “Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for General Category (HRT-2)” is implemented by the Directorate of Horticulture, Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the General Category as well as to farmer groups and cooperative societies for purchasing various tools, equipment, sorting/grading equipment, and Post-Harvest Management (PHM) equipment. This includes plastic crates with equipment such as weights, packing materials, sorting/grading machinery, etc.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
The General Category farmers will be eligible for assistance up to 75% of the cost of the Tools/Equipment or ₹3,750/-, whichever is less.
Farmer groups/cooperative societies will be eligible for assistance of 90% of the cost of equipment or up to ₹7,50,000/-, whichever is less, for the installation of Post-Harvest Management (PHM) Equipment.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The beneficiary should be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
The beneficiary should belong to the General Category.
The individual farmer or farmer groups/Cooperative Societies are eligible to avail benefits under the scheme.
Note 01:
The tool/equipment has to be purchased from the authorised dealer of the empanelled manufacturer for the purpose of price discovery as notified by the Department of Agriculture from time to time.
Note 02:
Companies empanelled by the Department of Agriculture for tarpaulin seats and their regulations will have to be implemented as per the norms.
Note 03:
Companies empanelled by the Department of Agriculture for plastic crates and their regulations will have to be implemented as per the norms.

﻿

Click on the ‘Apply’ button and an application page will open.
Step 05:
Click on the "Apply New" button and submit a new application.

Once the application is done, confirm it.

Take a printout of the confirmed application.

Take a printout of the online application and submit it to the office/office address mentioned on the application along with the necessary documents. SCHEME NAME: Assistance in Case of Accidents (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
TAGS: Accidental Benefit, Building Worker, Construction Worker, Disability, Hospitalization, Labour
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The “Assistance in Case of Accidents” scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, financial assistance shall be provided to the nominee of a registered member in the event of an accident causing the member to suffer a permanent total disability, loss of one limb or eye, or permanent disability without losing two limbs or eyes.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Permanent total disability due to accident:
₹1,50,000/-
Loss of one limb/ eye:
₹80,000/-
Permanent disability without loss of two limbs/ eyes:
₹40,000/-

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:
The applicant should be a resident of Odisha.
The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker.
The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years.
The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:
The applicant should be a nominee of a deceased registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Odisha.
The member should have permanent disability/ lost one limb or eye/ permanent disability without the loss of two limbs or eyes due to an accident.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online
Offline
Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:
Step 1:
Visit the official
website
of the Odisha BOCWW Board.
Step 2:
Click on “One Time Registration” on the top right side of the page.
Step 3:
Click on the Declaration box and then on the “Proceed” button.
Step 4:
In the next window fill in all the required details carefully and click on “Proceed”.
Step 5:
Enter the received OTP and click on “Submit”.
Step 6:
Your account will be successfully created and a Username will be displayed (Keep the Username for future references).
Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:
Step 1:
Visit the Applicant
Login page
of the Odisha BOCWW Board.
Step 2:
Enter your Username, OTP and fill in the captcha then click on “Sign In”.
Step 3:
In the next window, fill in your General Details, Address Details, Family & Nominee Details, Details of the establishment(s) where the applicant worked during the last one year, Bank Details etc. and then click on “Submit”.
Step 4:
Now in the Menu bar section, click on “Benefit”. From the list select the concerned benefit you want to apply.
Step 5:
Fill in all the mandatory details carefully and click on “Submit” to complete the application process.
Check Your Application Status:
Registered workers can check their application status through visiting this
link
upon entering their Application Tracking Number.
Pay Annual Contribution:
Registered workers can pay the Annual Contribution through visiting this
link
upon entering their Registration Number.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:
Aadhaar Linked Bank Passbook Front Page Copy (Allowed file types: PNG, JPG, PDF. Allowed size: less than 500 KB).
Passport Size Photo (Allowed type: PNG, JPG. Allowed size: less than 500 KB).
Aadhaar Card (Allowed file types: PNG, JPG, PDF. Allowed size: less than 500 KB).
Signature of Applicant (Allowed type: PNG, JPG. Allowed size: less than 500 KB).
Employment certificate (Allowed file types: PNG, JPG, PDF. Allowed size: less than 500 KB).
For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:
Xerox copy of the Registration Certificate of the beneficiary duly attested by DLO/ ALO/ RLI of the concerned district.
Xerox copy of updated annual contribution receipt to be verified by the DLO/ ALO/ RLI of the concerned district.
Essentiality Certificate to be filled completely and to be signed not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon of Government Hospital.
All original Bills should be verified by the treating doctor and it should be signed on the face of the bills with a seal.
Original OPD Report /Discharge Certificate from the hospital duly signed by the Doctor.
The detailed list of medicines, laboratory tests, investigations, no doctor's visit etc.
Whether the construction workers have been covered under the Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY).
Referral form for admission/ OPD treatment from nearby Government Hospital for treatment/admission.
Non-availability certificate for treatment /admission in nearby Government Hospital, if applicable.
Copy of the first page of Bank pass book indicating Bank name, IFSC Code and applicant's account number clearly visible and verified by concerned DLO/ ALO/ RLI.
Note:
On loss of original documents, photocopies duly signed by Medical Authority would be entertained subject to submission of the affidavit.

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Odisha
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/acaobocwwb
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the age requirement for registration as a beneficiary under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Odisha?
The building worker must be at least 18 years old and not older than 60 years old.
Is there a minimum service requirement to register as a beneficiary?
Yes, the building worker must have completed 90 days of service as a building worker in the preceding 12 months.
Who can apply for the welfare scheme?
Any registered worker of the Board can apply for the welfare scheme.
Who is responsible for registering a worker as a beneficiary?
The District Labour Officers (D.L.O)/ Asst. Labour Officers/ Rural Labour Inspectors are acting as Registering Officers for the registration of beneficiaries under the Board.
Who is eligible for registration as a beneficiary of the BOCW Welfare Board?
Every building worker who is between the age of 18-60 years and who has been engaged in any building or other construction work for not less than 90 days during the preceding one year is eligible for registration as a beneficiary of the BOCW Welfare Board of Odisha.
Can Odia migrant workmen be registered as beneficiaries under the Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board?
Yes, Odia migrant workmen engaged in building and other construction works in other states can be registered as beneficiaries under the Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board.
What is the procedure for applying for the registration?
To register as a beneficiary under the BOCW Welfare Board, an applicant worker should download Form-XXVII and attach all the mandatory documents (self attested, if required) and a fee of ₹20/- to the District Labour Officers (D.L.O)/ Asst. Labour Officers/ Rural Labour Inspectors of your area.
Alternatively, registration can also be done through the official website of the Odisha BOCWW Board: https://nirmanshramik.odisha.gov.in/obocwwb/public/cwLogin .
Is there a specific form for the registration through offline mode as a beneficiary under the BOCW Welfare Board?
Yes, the application for registration must be made in Form-XXVII. You can obtain this form from the District Labour Officers (D.L.O)/ Asst. Labour Officers/ Rural Labour Inspectors in your area.
How much is the fee associated with the registration process?
The registration fee is ₹20/- which is payable during the registration.
What happens after I pay the application fee?
After you pay the application fee of  ₹20/-, your application will be reviewed by the registering officer. The decision to approve or reject your application will be based on the merits of your application.
Who decides whether my application will be approved or rejected?
The registering officer is responsible for deciding whether your application will be approved or rejected based on its merits.
Can my application be rejected even if I have paid the application fee?
Yes, your application can be rejected even if you have paid the application fee. The final decision is made by the registering officer based on the merits of your application.
How much is the fee associated with the renewal of the registration?
The renewal fee is ₹50/- which is payable during the renewal process of the registration.
What criteria must an applicant meet to be considered for this benefit?
A nominee of a registered member is eligible for this benefit in the event of an accident causing the member to suffer a permanent total disability, loss of one limb or eye, or permanent disability without losing two limbs or eyes.
What kind of assistance is provided under this scheme?
Under this scheme, the Board shall provide ₹1,50,000/- for Permanent total disability;  ₹80,000/- for Loss of one limb/ eye; ₹40,000/- for Permanent disability without loss of two limbs/ eyes in the event of an accident in all cases.
What form needs to be used to apply for this welfare scheme?
The application must be made in the prescribed Form-XXXIV. The form can be downloaded from https://bocboard.labdirodisha.gov.in/Building/homecontent/BeneficiaryForms/ACCIDENT%20Form.pdf or can be collected from the District Labour Officers (D.L.O)/ Asst. Labour Officers/ Rural Labour Inspectors of your area.
Where do I submit the application for this welfare scheme?
Application can be submitted online on: https://nirmanshramik.odisha.gov.in/obocwwb/public/cwLogin . Alternatively , the offline application for this welfare scheme should be submitted to the District Labour Officers (D.L.O)/ Asst. Labour Officers/ Rural Labour Inspectors in your area.
What happens if the application is rejected?
In case of rejection, the applicants would be intimated about such rejection, with due intimation to the Board.
What are the consequences of submitting fraudulent documents for assistance?
In case of receipt of assistance on the basis of fraudulent documents, the amount released towards any assistance would be recovered from the applicant under the provisions of the OPDR Act, and his/her membership would be ceased.

₹10,000/ha.
75% of the cost or ₹7,500/hectare, whichever is less.
﻿

Corrugated boxes, wooden boxes will be used as packing material.
Assistance will be available up to a maximum limit of 1 hectare per account.
Available on i-Khedut portal every year (once during the year),

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the objective of the "Assistance in Packing Materials under Post Harvest Management of Horticultural Produce" scheme?
The "Assistance in Packing Materials under Post Harvest Management of Horticultural Produce" scheme aims to support farmers by providing financial aid for packing materials used in post-harvest stages to maintain quality and reduce losses.
Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
Any farmer residing in Gujarat and engaged in horticultural cultivation is eligible to apply for this scheme.
﻿
﻿
What is the amount of financial assistance provided under the scheme?
The scheme offers financial assistance of 75% of the unit cost or ₹7,500 per hectare, whichever amount is lower.
﻿
﻿
What is the maximum area for which assistance can be claimed?
Assistance can be claimed for a maximum of 1 hectare per farmer account per year.
﻿
﻿
What is the unit cost considered by the scheme?
The scheme considers a unit cost of ₹10,000/- per hectare for the purpose of calculating assistance.
﻿
﻿
Which types of packing materials are covered under the scheme?
The scheme provides support for packing materials such as corrugated boxes and wooden boxes used in the post-harvest handling of horticultural produce.
﻿
﻿
Is the scheme available every year?
Yes, the scheme is offered once every year and can be availed annually through the i-Khedut portal.
﻿
﻿
Is there any income limit set for eligibility under this scheme?
No, there is no personal or family income limit prescribed for applying to this scheme.
﻿
﻿
How is the assistance amount disbursed to the applicant?
The approved assistance amount is typically transferred directly to the applicant’s registered bank account.
﻿
﻿
Where should a farmer apply for the scheme?
Applicants can apply on the
iKhedut

iKhedut
portal for more information.

1,600 units per hectare
GI Wire (12–18 gauge) or Plastic Wire:
400 kg per hectare
Recommended Plant Spacing:
2.5 x 2.5 meters (approximate)
Coverage Limit:
Maximum Area:
2.00 hectares per Khata
Validity:
Assistance duration:
3 years

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the main objective of the scheme "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops"?
The main objective of the scheme is to encourage the adoption of structured farming methods by supporting farmers with financial assistance for constructing kachha, semi-pucca, or pucca trellis mandaps to improve vegetable crop productivity and quality.
﻿
﻿
﻿
Who is eligible to apply under the scheme "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops"?
All farmers residing in the state of Gujarat who are engaged in vegetable cultivation are eligible to apply under the "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" scheme.
﻿
﻿
﻿
What are the financial benefits available to farmers under this scheme?
Under the "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" scheme, General category farmers are entitled to receive 50% of the unit cost or ₹80,000/- per hectare, SC/ST category farmers receive 75% of the cost or ₹1,20,000/- per hectare, and Devipoojak farmers are eligible for 90% of the cost or ₹46,800/- per hectare.
﻿
﻿
﻿
Is there a limit on the area of land for which assistance can be availed?
Yes, the assistance under the scheme "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" is limited to a maximum of 2.00 hectares per Khata, and farmers cannot claim benefits for land beyond this limit.
﻿
﻿
﻿
What are the materials that farmers are expected to use for constructing the trellis mandap?
Farmers availing benefits under the "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" scheme are expected to use approved materials such as bamboo or wooden supports (1,600 units per hectare), GI wire of 12–18 gauge or plastic wire (400 kg per hectare) to ensure durable and efficient structures.
﻿
﻿
﻿
Is there any specific spacing required for the trellis structure under the scheme?
Yes, the scheme "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" recommends a spacing of approximately 2.50 meters by 2.50 meters for the trellis structure to ensure optimal crop growth and structural balance.
﻿
﻿
﻿
What is the validity period of the assistance once it is approved?
Once approved, the financial assistance under the "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" scheme remains valid for a period of three years, within which the farmer is expected to construct and utilize the trellis structure.
﻿
﻿
﻿
Are farmers from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, or Devipoojak communities given any special benefit?
Yes, farmers belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, or Devipoojak communities are given higher subsidy percentages under the "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" scheme, thereby ensuring inclusive and equitable access to agricultural infrastructure support.
﻿
﻿
﻿
Can farmers from all districts of Gujarat apply for this scheme?
Yes, the "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" scheme is applicable across the entire state of Gujarat, allowing farmers from any district to apply, provided they meet the eligibility conditions.
﻿
﻿
﻿
What are the steps to apply for the scheme?
To apply for the “Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops,” the applicant must visit the
iKhedut
portal, fill out the online application form, upload the required documents, and submit the form electronically.
﻿
Is there any income limit or financial background criteria for applying under this scheme?
There is no individual or family income limit specified in the guidelines for eligibility under the "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" scheme, making it accessible to all farmers irrespective of their economic background.
﻿
﻿
﻿
What documents are required for applying under this scheme?
Farmers applying for the "Assistance in Trellise Mandap for Cultivation of Vegetable Crops" scheme must submit a copy of their Aadhaar Card, 7/12 Certificate, and either a Bank Passbook or a Cancelled Cheque for bank account verification.
﻿

SCHEME NAME: Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)
TAGS: Animal Husbandry, Cattle Development, Concentrate Feeds, Milk Production
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, is designed to support livestock owners during the critical post-parturition period, one month after delivery. This time is crucial for the health of the mother cattle and the calf. Under the scheme, 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed is provided free of cost to livestock owners belonging to the General Category.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
﻿
Name of Component
Standard of assistance
Remarks
Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Benefits
Concentrate Feed
150 kg BIS type II Concentrate feed per beneficiary
100% assistance
Every year
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a livestock owner.
The applicant must belong to the General Category.
The animal must have recently calved (given birth).

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online
Step 1:
The applicant may visit and apply online at I-Khedut Portal:
https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/
﻿
Step 2:
On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Animal Husbandry Schemes’.
Step 3:
Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button and an application page will open.
Step 4:
Click on "Apply New" button and submit a new application.
Step 5:
Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application.
Step 6:
Once the application is done, confirm it.
Step 7:
Take a print out of the confirmed application.
Step 8:
Applicant can also check their Application Status/View/Print/Upload Application details from the below link:
https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/public/frm_Applicant_Corner.aspx
Contact Us:
Click here
.
Note:

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Barcoded Ration card.
Government approved photo ID (Aadhaar/Voter Card).
Certificate of calving of an animal from Govt. Livestock inspector.
Disability certificate from competent authority (If beneficiary is disabled).

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Gujarat
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/acfapgc
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the main objective of the "Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (General Category)" scheme?
The main objective of the scheme is to provide nutritional support to milch animals after parturition in the form of BIS Type II concentrate feed, helping to improve their health and milk production.
﻿
﻿
Who is eligible to benefit from this scheme?
Livestock owners belonging to the General Category who meet the prescribed eligibility criteria are eligible to benefit from this scheme.
﻿
﻿
What kind of assistance is provided under the scheme?
Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed free of cost.
﻿
﻿
How often can a beneficiary avail the scheme?
A beneficiary can avail the benefit of the scheme once every year.
﻿
﻿
Is there any cost to be paid by the applicant for the feed?
No, the concentrate feed is provided with 100% assistance, meaning it is completely free for the eligible beneficiaries.
﻿
﻿
Can an applicant submit documents offline?
Yes, the applicant can submit the required documents in hard copy to the concerned office within 7 days of applying online.
﻿
﻿
Can livestock owners from any category apply under this scheme?
No, this scheme is specifically designed for livestock owners belonging to the General Category.
﻿
﻿
What is the role of the calving certificate in the application process?
The calving certificate confirms that the animal has recently given birth, which is essential for verifying the applicant’s eligibility.
﻿
﻿
What is BIS Type II concentrate feed?
BIS Type II concentrate feed is a balanced and nutritious feed approved by the Bureau of Indian Standards, used to improve the health and milk yield of cattle.
﻿
﻿
Is it necessary for the animal to have recently calved to apply?
Yes, only livestock owners whose animals have recently calved are eligible to apply under this scheme.
﻿
﻿
Where should an applicant apply for the scheme?
The applicant should apply online through the official
iKhedut
portal.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the main purpose of the 'Assistance of Concentrate Feed for Pregnant Animals (General Category)' scheme?

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the main purpose of the 'Assistance of Concentrate Feed for Pregnant Animals (Scheduled Tribe Category)' scheme?
The scheme is designed to provide nutritional support to pregnant animals during their last trimester to improve their health, enhance immunity, prevent metabolic diseases, and increase milk production.
Who is eligible to benefit from this scheme?
Livestock owners who belong to the Scheduled Tribe Category are eligible to receive assistance under this scheme.
What type and quantity of feed is provided under the scheme?
Under the scheme, each eligible beneficiary receives 250 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed free of cost.
How often can a beneficiary receive the feed assistance?
The assistance can be claimed once every year by eligible livestock owners.
Does the beneficiary have to pay anything for the concentrate feed?
No, the concentrate feed is provided as 100% assistance, and the beneficiary does not have to bear any cost.
What is BIS Type II concentrate feed?
BIS Type II concentrate feed is a balanced, high-quality nutritional supplement approved by the Bureau of Indian Standards, suitable for pregnant animals.
Can the same livestock owner apply again next year?
Yes, the benefit can be availed once every year by the same eligible livestock owner.
How can a livestock owner apply for the scheme?
A livestock owner can apply by completing an online registration on the
iKhedut
portal.

SCHEME NAME: Assistance on Death- Haryana Silicosis Board
TAGS: Death, Financial Assistance, Silicosis, Worker
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The "Assistance on Death" scheme, implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board, Government of Haryana, provides financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- in the event of the death of a Silicosis victim. If the deceased was married, the assistance will be payable to the widow or widower. If the deceased was unmarried, the amount will be given to their nominee.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Under this scheme, in the event of the death of a Silicosis victim, financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- will be provided.
Note 1:
If the deceased was married, the assistance will be payable to the widow or widower.
Note 2:
If the deceased was unmarried, the financial assistance will be given to the nominee.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be the widow/widower/nominee of the deceased worker.
The deceased worker should have been suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana.
The deceased worker should have been employed in a factory or at a construction site.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Online - via CSCs
Step 01:
The applicant may visit the nearest Labour Office and collect the application form. The Application Performa (
Annexure VIII
) may also be downloaded from the Official Website of the Labour Department Haryana.
Step 02:
Fill out the application form with all required details, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
Step 03:
Attach all necessary documents, including medical certificates, proof of identity, and the certificate of being the widow/widower or nominee, if applicable, etc.
Step 04:
Submit the completely filled application form along with supporting documents to the Assistant Director, Industrial Health of your concerned jurisdiction.
Step 05:
The Assistant Director will review the application and then forward it to the Office of the Labour Commissioner-cum-Welfare Commissioner, Haryana.
Step 06:
Await notification from the Labour Department regarding the approval or any further requirements for your application.
Step 07:
Upon approval, the financial assistance will be processed and provided to the applicant as per the scheme's guidelines.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Copy of Aadhaar Card of applicant
Death Certificate of the worker
Identity Card (Silicosis)
Proof of relation with the deceased worker
Copy of Bank Pass Book
Any other documents as required

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Haryana
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/ad-hsb
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Who implements the scheme?
The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board, Government of Haryana.
What is Silicosis?
Silicosis is an incurable lung disease prevalent in workplaces like stone crushers and mines, caused by inhaling silica dust.
What are the symptoms of Silicosis?
Symptoms include shortness of breath, fatigue, loss of appetite, chest pain, dry cough, respiratory failure, and it eventually leads to death.
What kind of financial assistance is provided under the scheme?
A financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- is provided.
Who receives the financial assistance if the deceased Silicosis victim was married?
The widow or widower of the deceased receives the financial assistance.
Who receives the financial assistance if the deceased Silicosis victim was unmarried?
The nominee of the deceased receives the financial assistance.
Where can affected Silicosis workers receive treatment?
Workers under the Employee State Insurance Act, 1948 receive care at ESI hospitals, while others are treated at district hospitals and medical colleges by the Health Department.
What is the eligibility criteria for the scheme?
The applicant must be the widow, widower, or nominee of a deceased worker who was confirmed to have Silicosis and was employed in a factory or at a construction site.
How can eligible applicants apply for the scheme benefits?
Eligible applicants may visit the nearest Antyodaya Kendra and fill up the application form.

SCHEME NAME: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (NIEPVD Dehradun)
TAGS: Assistive Devices, Disability Aids, Free Aids, Hearing Impairment, Visual Impairment
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)"  implemented by National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Dehradun, aims to assist persons with disabilities in enhancing their physical, social, and psychological rehabilitation by providing them with modern, standard aids and appliances. Through this scheme, eligible visually, hearing, locomotor, and mentally disabled individuals receive necessary assistive devices free of cost or at a subsidized rate. The scheme is implemented by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Dehradun.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
For Visually Impaired:
Braille Kit, Daisy Player, Refractive Mirror, Mobility Cane, Smart Phone.
For Hearing Impaired:
Hearing Aid.
For Locomotor Disabled:
Wheelchair, Tricycle, Walking Sticks, Calipers, Crutches.
For Mentally Disabled:
MR Kit.
Note:
For those with an annual income up to ₹22,500/-, the aid is provided completely free.
For those with an annual income up to ₹30,000/-, 50% of the cost of the aid must be borne by the beneficiary.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a person with a benchmark disability.
The applicant’s disability must be certified by a competent medical authority.
The applicant’s monthly income should not exceed ₹30,000/-.
Note:
Visually impaired children up to 12 years of age can apply for a Braille kit free of charge every year under the aid scheme.
Excluding smartphones, if visually impaired children want to receive other devices again under the aid scheme after receiving them once, they can apply only after a minimum interval of 03 years.
After receiving a smartphone once, one can apply again only after 05 years.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
The interested applicant should visit the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Dehradun and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form.
Step 2:
In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Dehradun.
Step 4:
Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the purpose of the scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)"?
The purpose of the scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)" is to empower persons with disabilities by providing them with essential aids and assistive devices either free of cost or at a subsidized rate to enhance their mobility, independence, and overall quality of life.
﻿
﻿
Who is responsible for implementing the scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)" in Uttarakhand?
The implementation of the scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)" in Uttarakhand is carried out by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD).
What are the types of assistive devices provided to visually impaired individuals under the scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)"?
Under the scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)", visually impaired individuals are eligible to receive aids such as Braille Kits, Daisy Players, Refractive Mirrors, Mobility Canes, and Smart Phones to facilitate their education, navigation, and communication.
﻿
﻿
Are hearing-impaired individuals eligible for support under the scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)"?
Yes, hearing-impaired individuals are eligible for support under the scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)", and they are provided with hearing aids to help improve their auditory functions and social interaction.

What kinds of aids are provided to persons with locomotor disabilities under the scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)"?
Persons with locomotor disabilities can receive assistive devices such as wheelchairs, tricycles, walking sticks, calipers, and crutches under the scheme "Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)" to assist with their movement and physical functioning.

Visually impaired children up to 12 years of age can apply for a Braille kit free of charge every year under the aid scheme.

Excluding smartphones, if visually impaired children wish to receive other aid devices again under the scheme after receiving them once, they can apply only after a minimum interval of 3 years.

Immediately following the formalities of disability examination and document verification, the assistive devices are provided to the disabled individuals.

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme “Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program” by the Agriculture and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to improve agricultural productivity and reduce manual labor burden by providing financial assistance for the purchase of mini tractors and power tillers to farmers. The scheme offers a subsidy based on the horsepower of the machinery and the applicant's category to promote inclusive agricultural mechanization and improve efficiency in farming operations.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits

Financial assistance of ₹45,000/- or 40% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.
SC/ST Farmers:
Financial assistance of ₹60,000/- or 50% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.
Power Tillers Below 8 BHP:
General Category Farmers:
Financial assistance of ₹40,000/- or 40% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.
SC/ST Farmers:
Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- or 50% of the equipment cost, whichever is less.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a farmer.
The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
The applicant should be engaged in agricultural practices and require mechanization support.
The applicant should intend to purchase either a mini tractor up to 20 HP, or a power tiller (either above or below 8 BHP).

Is there any special benefit provided to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) farmers under this scheme?

What is the financial assistance amount for general category farmers under the scheme?
General category farmers can receive financial assistance up to ₹45,000/- or 40% of the equipment cost for mini tractors and power tillers above 8 BHP, and ₹40,000/- or 40% of the cost for power tillers below 8 BHP, whichever amount is lower, under the scheme "Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program".

Can female farmers apply for this scheme?
Yes, female farmers are equally eligible to apply under the scheme "Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program", as there is no gender-based restriction mentioned in the eligibility criteria.

Is this scheme applicable in all regions of Gujarat?
Yes, the scheme "Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program" is applicable across the entire state of Gujarat, ensuring uniform access to farm mechanization support for farmers in all districts.
﻿
﻿
﻿
What type of farm equipment is supported under this scheme?

What are the steps to apply for the scheme?

iKhedut
portal, fill out the online application form, upload the required documents, and submit the form electronically.

What documents are required to apply under the scheme?
The documents required to apply under the scheme "Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program" include the 7/12 Certificate (proof of land ownership), Aadhaar Card (identity proof), and a copy of the Bank Pass Book or a Cancelled Cheque (for DBT purposes).

Details
The scheme "Assistance to Farmers in Purchasing Nano Fertilizers Under the Agricultural Assistance Program for Farmers Other than Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial aid to non-SC/ST farmers in Gujarat to help them purchase Nano Fertilizers. By encouraging the use of efficient and innovative agricultural inputs, the scheme strives to boost farm productivity, improve crop yields, and raise the overall economic well-being of farmers.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Up to 50% of the purchased price per hectare or ₹750/- (within a maximum limit of 4 hectares per account.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a farmer.
The applicant must belong to the General category (i.e., not SC or ST).
The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online
Step 1:
The applicant may visit and apply online at I-Khedut Portal:
https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/
﻿

On the home page, click on ‘Schemes’ and then click on ‘Agricultural Schemes’.
Step 3:
Now select the scheme, click on the ‘Apply’ button and an application page will open.

Click on "Apply New" button and submit a new application.

Click on the "Update Application" button to add corrections to the application.
Step 6:
Once the application is done, confirm it.
Step 7:
Take a print out of the confirmed application.

.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the primary objective of this scheme?
The primary objective of this scheme is to enhance the agricultural productivity and standard of living of general category farmers by providing financial assistance for Nano Fertilizer purchases.
Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
Any individual who is a registered farmer, belongs to the General category, and resides in Gujarat is eligible to apply under this scheme.
﻿
﻿
What kind of financial benefit does the scheme offer to farmers?
Under this scheme, eligible farmers are entitled to receive financial assistance equivalent to up to 50% of the purchase price of Nano Fertilizers per hectare or a maximum of ₹750 per hectare, whichever is lower, subject to a cap of 4 hectares per applicant.
﻿
﻿
Is there a maximum landholding limit for receiving assistance through this scheme?
No, however, the scheme provides financial assistance for a maximum of 4 hectares of agricultural land per applicant, and any landholding beyond that is not considered for subsidy.
﻿
﻿
Does the applicant have to pay any fee while submitting the application form?
No, the application process for this scheme is completely free of cost, and applicants are not required to pay any application or processing fee.
﻿
﻿
Can farmers belonging to Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes apply under this scheme?
No, this scheme is specifically designed for the upliftment of farmers from the General category, and therefore SC and ST category farmers are not eligible to apply.
﻿
﻿
Will an applicant be eligible for assistance if they apply for more than 4 hectares of land?
No, the scheme strictly enforces a limit of 4 hectares per account, and any additional area beyond this limit is not eligible for subsidy or assistance.
﻿
﻿
How can an eligible farmer submit an application for this scheme?
An eligible farmer must visit the official

portal and fill out the online application form by providing accurate personal, bank account and other details along with the required documents.
﻿
﻿
What are the essential documents that need to be uploaded with the application?
The applicant must upload a copy of their 7/12 land certificate, Aadhar card, and either a bank passbook or a cancelled cheque to complete the application process.
﻿
﻿
Who should the applicant contact for help or more information about the scheme?
The applicant should contact the nearest agriculture office or visit the
iKhedut
portal for more information.

SCHEME NAME: Assistance to General Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories
TAGS: Agriculture, Farmer, Pump, Subsidy
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme “Assistance to General Farmers for Installation of Submersible / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories" was launched by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the farmers from the General Category are provided with a grant of 65% subsidy towards the installation of suitable Submersible / Centrifugal motor pump sets with accessories, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/‐ per tubewell per individual.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
65% subsidy towards the installation of suitable Submersible / Centrifugal motor pump sets with accessories, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/‐ per tubewell per individual.
The subsidy amount shall be released through the Electronic Clearing System (ECS) if the applicant has undertaken the construction with his/her funds. In case, he/she has availed himself/herself loan from the Nationalized Bank / Co‐operative Bank towards the construction of the tubewell, the subsidy amount shall be remitted to the Bank against the loan account of the beneficiary.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be from the General Category.
The applicant should be a farmer in the Union Territory of Puducherry.
The tubewell in which the submersible/centrifugal motor pump sets is going to be erect and should have been registered in Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry.
The applicant should hold a minimum of 1.5 acres of land under the command area of the tubewell to be constructed and the applicant should have ownership of the land at least for 2 years and should have a clear ownership title deed in his/her name.
The eligible land holding of 1.5 acres should be in favour of the applicant farmer or in favour of the spouse or favour of the member of a joint/undivided family.
The farmers who have already availed themselves of the subsidy for the said purpose within 5 years are not entitled to any benefit under this scheme.
The applicant should not convert the lands for a maximum period of 10 years from the date of construction of the tubewell/filter point to any purpose other than agriculture and should execute a bond accordingly.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Online
Step 1:
The applicant must obtain the mandatory PERMIT for the construction of a new / replacement tubewell from the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry.
Step 2:
The applicant of the Puducherry region should approach the concerned office towards the construction of the tubewell by deploying departmental machinery. The applicants who want to construct the tubewell through private machinery should approach the concerned office to get NOC.
Step 3:
After obtaining NOC, the farmer has to construct a tubewell by deploying private machinery which is registered with Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry. Inspection will be conducted by the Agricultural Officer (Engg.) concerned at the time of the construction of the tubewell to ascertain the details of pipes and other materials used.
Step 4:
After successful completion of the tubewell/filter point construction work under departmental supervision, the interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the concerned office and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the concerned authority:
Puducherry:
Office of the Hydrogeologist‐II, State Ground Water Unit & Soil Conservation, Thattanchavady, Puducherry‐9.
Karaikal:
Office of the Additional Director of Agriculture, Karaikal.
Step 5:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 6:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form and the documents to the aforementioned authority.
Step 7:
On receipt of the application, necessary entries will be made in the application receipt register and a unique seniority number will be assigned to the applicant for identifying each applicant which shall be used for all further references and also as acknowledgement for the receipt of the application will be issued to the applicant.
*The application should be submitted within 90 days from the date of completion of the tubewell/filter point construction work.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
The certificate for the ownership of the land issued by an officer, not below the rank of Deputy Tahsildar.
The copy of the Registration certificate, Permit and Energisation Certificate issued by the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry.
Original bills for the expenses incurred towards the construction of the tubewell (or) in case of those who have availed themselves of a Bank loan, attested copy of the original bills, and certificate from the Bank to that effect.
Copy of the Aadhaar card, Farmers Identity Card, and Bank passbook front page.
*Upon selection, the beneficiaries should submit an affidavit signed before a Notary Public to the effect that the above-said land is under his / her possession, he/she will not sell, mortgage or transfer the lands to any other person for 10 years and that he/she will not convert the land for any other purpose other than agriculture and in case if he/she is found to have not abided by the terms, he/she will be liable for such course of legal action by the Government for breach of any of the conditions of the schemes besides facing recovery/cancellation of subsidy.

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Puducherry
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/agfiscmpwa
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What action can be taken if the applicant breaches the conditions of the scheme?
If the applicant breaches the conditions, legal action may be taken by the government, including recovery/cancellation of subsidy, as mentioned in the affidavit.
How is the unique seniority number assigned to the applicant used?
The unique seniority number serves as identification for each applicant in all further references and serves as acknowledgment for the receipt of the application.
Within how many days should the application be submitted from the date of completion of the work?
The application should be submitted within 90 days from the date of completion of the tubewell construction work.
Where will advertisements inviting applications be published?
Advertisements will be published in local leading Tamil dailies.
What restriction is placed on the conversion of lands after the construction of the tubewell?
The applicant should not convert the lands for a maximum period of 10 years for any purpose other than agriculture and must execute a bond accordingly.
Can farmers who have availed the subsidy for the same purpose within 5 years apply for this scheme?
No, farmers who have already availed the subsidy within 5 years are not entitled to benefits under this scheme.
How long should the applicant have ownership of the land to be eligible for the scheme?
The applicant should have ownership of the land for at least 2 years and possess a clear ownership title deed in their name.
What is the mode of subsidy release if the applicant has availed a loan from a Nationalized Bank or Co‐operative Bank?
The subsidy amount is remitted directly to the bank against the loan account of the beneficiary.
What is the maximum subsidy provided under the scheme for each tubewell per individual?
The scheme provides a 65% subsidy, with a maximum limit of ₹50,000 per tubewell per individual.
What type of bond should the applicant execute regarding the land use?
The applicant should execute a bond affirming not to convert the land for any purpose other than agriculture for a period of 10 years.
Is there any specified timeframe for the applicant's possession of the land?
The applicant should possess the land for at least 2 years to be eligible for the scheme.
Can applicants from any category apply for the scheme, or is it limited to a specific category?
The scheme is specifically for applicants from the General Category in the Union Territory of Puducherry.

SCHEME NAME: Assistance to General Farmers for Sinking Tubewell
TAGS: Agriculture, Farmer, Subsidy, Tubewell
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme “Assistance to General Farmers for Sinking Tubewell" was launched by the Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare, Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the farmers from the General Category are provided with a grant of 65% subsidy towards the construction of tubewell/filter points in Puducherry subject to a maximum of ₹1,50,000 per tubewell/filter point per individual.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
65% subsidy
towards construction of tubewell/filter point in the Union Territory of Puducherry subject to a maximum of ₹1,50,000 per tubewell/filter point per individual.
*The total cost incurred towards the construction of the tubewell shall be taken into account for the calculation of the subsidy.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must obtain the necessary permit to sink a new/replacement tubewell/filter point from Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry.
The tubewell/Filter point should have been constructed through a departmental power rig/hand bore set or should have been constructed with a No Objection Certificate of the Agriculture Department for engaging private drilling machinery registered with Pondicherry Ground Water Authority under departmental supervision.
The applicant should hold a minimum of 1.5 acres of land under the command area of the tubewell/filter point to be constructed.
The applicant should have ownership of the land for at least 2 years and a clear ownership title deed in his/her name. The eligible land holding of 1.5 acres should be in favour of the applicant farmer, spouse, or a member of the joint/undivided family.
Farmers who have already availed themselves of the subsidy for the same purpose within 5 years are not entitled to any benefit under this scheme.
The casing pipes should have a BIS certificate and should have been purchased from an authorized dealer/ M/s.PASIC Ltd.
The applicant should not convert the lands for a minimum period of 10 years from the date of construction of the tubewell/filter point to any purpose other than agriculture and should execute a bond accordingly.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Online
Step 1:
The applicant must obtain the mandatory PERMIT for the construction of a new / replacement tubewell from the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry.
Step 2:
The applicant of the Puducherry region should approach the concerned office towards the construction of the tubewell by deploying departmental machinery. The applicants who want to construct the tubewell through private machinery should approach the concerned office to get NOC.
Step 3:
After obtaining NOC, the farmer has to construct a tubewell by deploying private machinery which is registered with Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry. Inspection will be conducted by the Agricultural Officer (Engg.) concerned at the time of the construction of the tubewell to ascertain the details of pipes and other materials used.
Step 4:
After successful completion of the tubewell/filter point construction work under departmental supervision, the interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the concerned office and request the hard copy of the
prescribed format
of the application form from the concerned authority:
Puducherry:
Office of the Hydrogeologist‐II, State Ground Water Unit & Soil Conservation, Thattanchavady, Puducherry‐9.
Karaikal:
Office of the Additional Director of Agriculture, Karaikal.
Step 5:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 6:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form and the documents to the aforementioned authority.
Step 7:
On receipt of the application, necessary entries will be made in the application receipt register and a unique seniority number will be assigned to the applicant for identifying each applicant which shall be used for all further references and also as acknowledgement for the receipt of the application will be issued to the applicant.
*The application should be submitted within 90 days from the date of completion of the tubewell/filter point construction work.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
The certificate for land ownership issued by an officer, not below the rank of Deputy Tahsildar.
A copy of the PERMIT obtained from the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry, for sinking a New/Replacement tubewell/filter point.
The Registration Certificate for the tubewell/filter point, issued by Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry. In the case of a new service connection, provide a copy of the energization letter obtained from the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry.
If the tubewell/filter point was constructed using private machinery, submit (i) a copy of the NOC issued by the competent authority and (ii) a copy of the License for the private machinery issued by the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, Puducherry.
Original bills for the expenses incurred in the construction of the tubewell/filter point. In the case of those who have availed themselves of a Bank loan, provide an attested copy of the original bills and a certificate from the Bank to that effect.
Include a copy of the Aadhaar card, Farmers Identity Card, and the front page of the Bank passbook.
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Puducherry
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/agfst
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What percentage of subsidy is granted to General Farmers, and what is the maximum amount per tubewell under this scheme?
General Farmers receive a 65% subsidy, with a maximum grant of ₹1,50,000 per tubewell or filter point in the Union Territory of Puducherry.
What costs are considered for calculating the subsidy under this scheme?
The total cost incurred towards the construction of the tubewell, including casing pipes with a BIS certificate, is taken into account for subsidy calculation.
Are there any restrictions on converting the lands after the construction of the tubewell?
Applicants are obligated not to convert the lands for a minimum period of 10 years from the date of construction to any purpose other than agriculture and must execute a bond accordingly.
Can farmers who have availed themselves of the subsidy for the same purpose within 5 years benefit from this scheme?
No, farmers who have already availed themselves of the subsidy for the same purpose within 5 years are not entitled to any benefit under this scheme.
What certification is required for casing pipes used in the construction?
Casing pipes must have a BIS certificate and should be purchased from an authorized dealer or M/s.PASIC Ltd.
What role does the Agricultural Officer (Engg.) play in the application process?
The Agricultural Officer (Engg.) conducts an inspection during tubewell construction to verify details of pipes and materials used.
Where can the application form for the scheme be obtained?
Applicants can obtain the hard copy of the application form from specified offices, including the Office of the Hydrogeologist‐II in Puducherry and the Office of the Additional Director of Agriculture in Karaikal.
Within what timeframe should the application be submitted after completing the tubewell construction?
The application should be submitted within 90 days from the date of completion of the tubewell/filter point construction work.
Can the tubewell be constructed using private machinery, and what is the process for such cases?
Yes, applicants can use private machinery with an NOC. After obtaining NOC, the tubewell should be constructed using registered private machinery under the supervision of Pondicherry Ground Water Authority.
Where should applicants approach if they want to construct the tubewell through private machinery?
Applicants intending to use private machinery should approach the concerned office to obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) for the construction.
What role does the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority play in the application process?
Applicants must obtain the mandatory permit for tubewell construction from the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority, and the authority also issues the registration certificate for the tubewell/filter point.

SCHEME NAME: Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances
TAGS: Artificial Limbs, Equipments, Financial Assistance, Person With Disability, PwD
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances" is implemented by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals for self-employment and the purchase of artificial limbs/equipment to overcome physical disabilities.
Under this scheme, the beneficiaries receive financial assistance to procure prosthetic aids and equipment such as tricycles, crutches, wheelchairs, calipers, hearing aids, blind sticks, smartphones, Jaipur Foot/Shoes/Palm pads, etc.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial assistance of up to ₹10,000/- for purchasing artificial limbs/equipment to overcome physical disabilities.
Covers aids like tricycles, crutches, wheelchairs, calipers, hearing aids, blind sticks, smartphones, Jaipur Foot/Shoes/Palm pads, etc.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
The applicant should be a disabled person.
The applicant should be suffering from 40% disability.
The applicant’s family should not be an income tax payer.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
The interested applicant should visit the office of the District Social Justice & Empowerment Department and request a copy of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Social Justice & Empowerment Department.
Step 4:
Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Social Justice & Empowerment Department to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Identity proof
Domicile Certificate
Disability Certificate
Aadhaar Card
Family Income Proof
Any Other Document if Required

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Rajasthan
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/apafale
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the objective of the scheme?
The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals for self-employment and for purchasing artificial limbs or equipment to overcome physical disabilities.
Who implements this scheme?
The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan.
What type of assistance is provided under this scheme?
Financial assistance of up to ₹10,000/- is provided for purchasing artificial limbs and assistive devices.
What types of assistive devices are covered under the scheme?
The scheme covers tricycles, crutches, wheelchairs, calipers, hearing aids, blind sticks, smartphones, Jaipur Foot, Jaipur Shoes, and Palm Pads.
Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
The applicant must be a native of Rajasthan, a person with a disability, have at least 40% disability, and belong to a family that is not an income tax payer.
Is there any income limit to apply for this scheme?
Yes, the applicant’s family should not be an income tax payer to be eligible for the scheme.
What is the minimum disability percentage required for eligibility?
The applicant must have a minimum of 40% disability to be eligible.
Where can an applicant get the application form?
The application form can be obtained from the office of the District Social Justice & Empowerment Department.
How can an applicant submit the application form?
The duly filled and signed application form, along with necessary documents, should be submitted to the District Social Justice & Empowerment Department.

SCHEME NAME: Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan
TAGS: Financial Assistance, Kailash, Mansarovar, Pilgrim, Tourism, Yatra
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The "Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra" scheme was introduced by the Devasthan Department, Government of Rajasthan, on 1st April 2011. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to residents of Rajasthan who successfully complete the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India. Under this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/- is granted to each pilgrim, with a maximum of 100 beneficiaries selected per year.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial Assistance
₹1,00,000 per selected pilgrim after completing the Yatra.
Mode of Disbursement
Direct transfer to the beneficiary’s bank account via account payee cheque/demand draft, depending on departmental discretion.
Note:
The Yatra must be completed through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India.
The benefit is available only once in a lifetime.
A maximum of 100 beneficiaries per year.
Selection via lottery if applications exceed the quota.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
The applicant should have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India.
The applicant receives this grant only once in a lifetime.
Note 1:
100 pilgrims are selected each year. If there are more applicants than available slots, selection is done through a lottery system.
Note 2:
After completing the trip, a certificate from the Ministry of External Affairs confirming the successful completion of the journey is required.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online
Offline
The application dates are announced via departmental notification (typically between June to September)
Step 1
: The applicant applying for the scheme for the first time needs to register using the icon “Applying for Yatra" and click on "New User” at the
Ministry of External Affairs
portal by providing accurate and correct information as per their documents.
Step 2:
After successfully getting registration done, the applicant will get their “login details”.
Step 3:
Through “Email ID and Password,” the applicant will be able to login into the account using the icon “Existing User” at the Ministry of External Affairs portal.
Step 4:
After successful login to the portal, the welcome page appeared. On clicking the “Application Form” icon, the applicant will be directed to the application screen.
Step 5:
Now, the applicant may fill out the complete application form, and on clicking the “Final Submit” button, the application is finally submitted.
Step 6
: On successful submission of the application, the applicant will receive an SMS and e-mail after successful submission of the application, which can be used for future reference.
Note:
The printed application form with documents must be submitted within 2 months after completing the Yatra.
Selection & Approval Process
Step 1:
Applications are verified by the Sub-Divisional Officer or Assistant Commissioner of the Devasthan Department.
Step 2:
Documents are matched with the originals, and a verification note is made.
Step 3:
Applications are forwarded to the Assistant Commissioner for approval within 15 days.
Step 4:
Selection through a computerized lottery if applications exceed the annual quota.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Certified copy of Rajasthan domicile certificate
Certified copy of passport with permanent address
Certified copy of visa stamps/seals related to the Yatra
Certified copy of successful completion certificate from the Ministry of External Affairs
Copy of Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Bhamashah Card
Passport-size Photograph

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Rajasthan
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/apkmy
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Who is eligible for this scheme?
Permanent residents of Rajasthan who undertake the yatra via the Ministry of External Affairs and have not previously availed this assistance.
What is the amount of financial assistance provided?
Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 per selected pilgrim.
How often can one avail this benefit?
Only once in a lifetime.
What is the total beneficiary cap per year?
100 pilgrims per year.
How are pilgrims selected if more than 100 apply?
Through a computerized lottery (draw of lots).
What is the deadline to apply for the grant after the Yatra?
Within 2 months of completing the journey.
Where can I apply for the travel itself?
On the Government of India’s MEA portal:
https://kmy.gov.in
﻿
Can I apply offline for the financial assistance?
Only if permitted by special instructions; otherwise, online is preferred.
Can NRIs apply?
No, only Rajasthan permanent residents.
How is the selection process conducted?
Applications are verified by the Block Officer and forwarded to the Assistant Commissioner, who finalizes the selection within 15 days.
How is the assistance amount disbursed?
The amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account or issued via an account payee cheque/demand draft.
Can I apply before completing the yatra?
No, applications are accepted only after the successful completion of the yatra.
