### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Where should the duly filled application form and documents be submitted?
Submit the documents to the concerned authority at the Department of Fisheries, Dayanand Bandodkar Marg, Patto Colony, Panaji Goa - 403 521, or to the official at BDO Office/ Sub-Offices of the Department of Fisheries.
How often can a beneficiary avail of the scheme, and what is the subsidy percentage for the SC/ST/Woman category?
The scheme can be availed every 3 years, and the subsidy for SC/ST/Woman category is 60%, limited to ₹36,000.
What is the unit cost of a Stake Net and its Accessories under the "Financial Assistance for Purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories" scheme?
The unit cost of a Stake Net and its Accessories is ₹60,000 (excluding GST).
What is the significance of the Stake Allotment Permission, and how can one obtain it?
The Stake Allotment Permission is essential and can be acquired from the Department of Fisheries, Goa, prior to applying for the scheme.
Can the subsidy amount be utilized for any other purpose apart from the purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories?
The subsidy is specifically designated for the purchase of Stake Net and its Accessories and cannot be diverted for any other purpose.
Is there any provision for extending the deadline for submitting applications, and are there age-related criteria for applicants?
There is no deadline for applications, and there are no age-related criteria. Applications can be submitted without any time constraints.
How is the subsidy amount disbursed to the beneficiaries, and what is the mode of payment?
The approved subsidy amount is disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account through electronic transfer.
In the event of a change in the unit cost after application submission, how is the subsidy recalculated?
The subsidy is fixed based on the unit cost at the time of application submission, and any subsequent changes do not impact the approved subsidy amount.
If a beneficiary has already availed of the scheme, can they reapply for another unit before the stipulated three-year gap?
No, the scheme allows beneficiaries to apply every 3 years. Reapplication before this period is not permitted.
Can the subsidy be availed for multiple units of Stake Nets in a single application, and what are the considerations for such cases?
The subsidy is applicable per unit, and multiple units can be covered in a single application, subject to meeting eligibility and documentation requirements.
What is the process for calculating the subsidy amount, considering the unit cost and applicable percentage?
The subsidy is calculated as a percentage of the unit cost. For the General category, it's 50%, limited to ₹30,000, and for SC/ST/Woman category, it's 60%, limited to ₹36,000.
In situations where the applicant's address changes after submission, how should they communicate this to the department?
Applicants should promptly inform the department in writing about any changes in their address, providing updated documentation as necessary.

SCHEME NAME: Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House (UKBOCWWB)
TAGS: Building Worker, Construction Worker, House, Labour, Loan
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The “Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House” scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) under the Labour Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide loans to registered construction workers for the purchase or construction of a house at a minimal interest rate.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Under the scheme, registered construction workers are eligible to receive an advance loan amount of up to ₹50,000/- for the purchase or construction of a house, subject to the conditions specified by the Board.
Interest of at least 5% per annum is applicable on this loan.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
To avail an advance loan for the purchase or construction of a house, the worker must have been a member of the fund for at least five years and should have a minimum of 15 years remaining until superannuation/retirement age.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online - via CSCs
The online application is submitted through Shramik Suvidha Kendras.
Along with the application form, the applicant must attach the Shramik Card, Aadhaar Card, bank account details, and a handwritten self-declaration certificate stating that no assistance has been taken from any other department for the same purpose.
If the application is verified and found correct during the departmental investigation, the advance amount is disbursed, on which the worker is required to pay interest at the rate of 5% per annum.
Proof of completion of the work must be submitted to the Secretary of the Board within six months from the date of withdrawal of the advance. The sanctioned advance amount shall be recovered in equal installments as determined by the Board.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Labour Card
Aadhaar Card
Bank account details
A handwritten self-declaration certificate stating that no assistance has been taken from any other department for the same purpose
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Uttarakhand
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/hasukbocwwb
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the main objective of the scheme?
The scheme aims to support construction workers by providing them with financial assistance in the form of loans to buy or build their own house at a subsidized interest rate.
﻿
How much loan amount is provided under the scheme?
A loan of up to ₹50,000/- is provided for the purchase or construction of a house.
﻿
What is the interest rate applicable on the loan?
The loan is provided at a minimum interest rate of 5% per annum.
﻿
Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
Only construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board are eligible.
﻿
Is there a minimum membership period required?
Yes. The worker must have been a member of the Welfare Fund for at least five years.
﻿
Is there an age-related eligibility condition?
Yes. The applicant must have at least 15 years remaining until superannuation/retirement age.
﻿
How can a worker apply for this scheme?
The application must be submitted online through Shramik Suvidha Kendras.
﻿
How is the loan repaid?
The sanctioned loan amount is recovered in equal installments as determined by the Board.
﻿

### DESCRIPTION
Details

Under this scheme, one-time financial assistance is provided to the children (2 boys & 3 girls) of workers employed in industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana at the time of admission to continue their studies. The Board provides assistance for the sons and daughters of registered workers for the purchase of school uniforms, books, stationery, and other educational materials, enabling them to continue their studies from 1st to 12th standard.

SCHEME NAME: Financial Assistance for encouraging production of Traditional Khell-Tiatr
TAGS: Artist, Culture, Drama, Financial Assistance, Performance, Stage
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Financial Assistance for Encouraging Production of Traditional Khell-Tiatr" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage dramatic troupes and individuals to produce Khell-Tiatrs of better quality and preserve this folk musical drama. The scheme provides financial assistance to compensate for expenditures related to staging four shows, including the provision of an auditorium or hall, or financial aid for temporary village setups, along with video filming and a free Digital Versatile Disc copy for the applicant. The applicant must adhere to traditional Khell-Tiatr format, performance guidelines, advertising requirements, and submit detailed proposals with all required documentation in advance. The scheme is implemented by the Tiatr Academy of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted by submission to the Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days prior to the proposed performance date.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial Assistance for Staging Performances
Financial assistance (as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa) is provided for staging four shows.
Payment will be made directly to the applicant after a statement of expenditure enclosing all original bills (with stamped receipts if the amount exceeds ₹5,000/-) is submitted to the Tiatr Academy of Goa.
Infrastructure Support
An auditorium or hall is provided to stage the programme.
For Village Programmes: Financial assistance (as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa) is provided for erecting a temporary pandal or stage, chairs, sound, etc.
Archival and Personal Use Video Documentation
The Khell-Tiatr will be video filmed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa for its library and other uses.
One copy of the Digital Versatile Disc (DVD) of the video-filmed Khell-Tiatr will be given to the applicant free of cost.
The dramatic troupe will have the freedom to use the Digital Versatile Disc in any manner, but cannot make use of the logo of Tiatr Academy of Goa on the said Digital Versatile Disc.
﻿
Conditions
Ongoing Compliance regarding Content
There must not be any adverse remark made in any form, either written or verbal, against any Government, Individual, Institution, etc., or anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody.
If proved so, Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) reserves the right to disqualify the performance and refrain from making any payment or recall the payment if already made to the concerned.
Show Access Obligation
All shows must be presented to the public free of charge.
Advertising and Branding Obligation
In all advertisements, whether oral, print, or electronic media, banners, etc., the statement ‘This programme is held in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa’ must be inserted, published, or announced.
Guest of Honour Coordination
The organizing dramatic troupe or individual will need to discuss with Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) and decide about the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour well in advance.
The President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa (TAG) will serve as the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour at the function.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a dramatic troupe or an individual producing Khell-Tiatrs.
The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant should be a new or old script.
The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must conform to the traditional format of the Khell-Tiatr.
The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must be one in which just one-story flows from beginning to end with an interval of 10 to 15 minutes.
The Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant must have 12 to 14 cantos which are related to the theme of the play.
Out of these cantos, at least 7 must be of an interactive nature.
The band for the Khell-Tiatr produced by the applicant should include at least two blowing instruments, one keyboard, one bass guitar, and a drum set.
The applicant must not have any adverse remark made in any form, either written or verbal, against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc.
The applicant must not have anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
The interested applicant should take a printout of the
prescribed format
of the application form. The form may also be obtained directly from the office of the Tiatr Academy of Goa, requiring a physical visit to the office for collection.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Sign the application form and mention the date.
Step 3:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the copies of the mandatory documents to -
Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001
Deadline:
This submission must occur at least 30 days in advance of the proposed performance date.
*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment.
*The application will be considered on a 'First Come First Serve' basis and is subject to the availability of funds.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Self Attested Copies of Aadhaar Card
Self Attested Copies of Permanent Account Number Card
Typed Copy of Script And Lyrics To Be Presented (Including The Names of The Artistes)
Statement of Expenditure Enclosing All Original Bills (Stamped Receipt If Amount Exceeds ₹5,000/-)
Photographs of The Function (5 Copies, Two of Which Should Show The Tiatr Academy of Goa’s Banner During Performance)
List of Participants (On A Separate Sheet)
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Goa
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/faeptkt
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What types of applicants are eligible to apply for financial assistance under this traditional folk musical drama support program?
Both dramatic troupes and individual producers who create Khell-Tiatrs can apply for this assistance. You must fulfill all the conditions outlined in the scheme and ensure your production adheres to the traditional format requirements.
﻿
How much advance notice do I need to provide when submitting my application for this cultural performance assistance scheme?
Applications must be submitted to the Tiatr Academy of Goa at least 30 days prior to your proposed performance date. This advance submission requirement ensures proper processing and coordination of your application.
﻿
Are there any restrictions on the content I can include in my traditional folk musical drama performance?
Yes, your performance must not contain any adverse remarks against any government, individual, or institution. Additionally, nothing should be included that targets someone's caste, creed, or religion, as this could hurt religious sentiments and lead to disqualification.
﻿
What are the specific musical instrument requirements for the band accompanying my Khell-Tiatr performance?
Your band must include at least 2 blowing instruments, 1 keyboard, 1 bass guitar, and 1 drum set. These are the minimum instrumental requirements to qualify for the financial assistance under this scheme.
﻿
Can I charge admission fees for the shows that receive financial support through this program?
No, all shows must be presented to the public completely free of charge. This is a mandatory condition for receiving financial assistance and infrastructure support under the scheme.
﻿
What is the required structure regarding the number of cantos that my Khell-Tiatr production must contain?
Your Khell-Tiatr must have between 12 to 14 cantos that are directly related to the theme of your play. Out of these cantos, at least 7 must be of an interactive nature to meet the traditional format requirements.
﻿
How should I handle the selection of chief guests or guests of honour for my performances?
You must discuss and coordinate with the Tiatr Academy of Goa well in advance to decide about guests. The President or Vice President of Tiatr Academy of Goa will serve as the Chief Guest or Guest of Honour at your function.
﻿
What specific advertising requirements must I follow when promoting my performances under this assistance scheme?
In all advertisements, whether oral, print, electronic media, or banners, you must include the statement 'This programme is held in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa.' This acknowledgment is mandatory across all promotional materials.
﻿
How many performances am I required to stage if I receive financial assistance through this program?
You are required to stage exactly 4 shows as part of the financial assistance package. The scheme specifically provides support for staging this fixed number of performances.
﻿
What documentation do I need to submit regarding my script and artistic team for this application?
You must provide a typed copy of your complete script and lyrics to be presented, including the names of all artistes who will be performing. Additionally, submit a separate list of all participants on a dedicated sheet.
﻿
Can I use both new and previously written scripts for my Khell-Tiatr production under this scheme?
Yes, your Khell-Tiatr can be based on either a new script or an old script. Both options are acceptable as long as the production conforms to all other traditional format and content requirements.
﻿
What specific financial documentation must I provide to receive payment after completing my performances?
You must submit a statement of expenditure that includes all original bills with proper documentation. If any single expense exceeds ₹5,000/-, you need to provide stamped receipts along with the original bills for reimbursement.
﻿
What are the interval timing requirements that my traditional folk musical drama performance must follow?
Your Khell-Tiatr must have one continuous story flowing from beginning to end with a single interval lasting between 10 to 15 minutes. This timing structure is essential for maintaining the traditional format.
﻿
What photographic evidence am I required to submit after completing my performances under this assistance program?
You must provide 5 copies of photographs from your function, with 2 specific photographs showing the Tiatr Academy of Goa's banner displayed during the performance. These photos serve as documentation of proper acknowledgment and successful completion.
﻿

The worker Wages Slip from the previous month is a required document.
Is it mandatory to submit a Death Certificate for the application?
Yes, a Death Certificate is a mandatory document for the application.
What information should be included in the affidavit that needs to be submitted?
The affidavit should state that the applicant is fully dependent upon the deceased worker and has not previously availed of the said scheme.
Can a family apply for this assistance if the worker was not actively employed at the time of their death?
The requirement for an 'Employer Certificate' and 'Worker Wages Slip (Previous Month)' suggests the worker must have been employed.
Are there any specific conditions regarding the number of years a worker must have served to qualify for the scheme?
No.
Is this scheme intended for all workers across India or specifically for workers in Haryana?
The scheme is managed by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board, indicating its applicability within Haryana.

SCHEME NAME: Financial Assistance for setting up of Ornamental Fish Unit in Goa

==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
“Financial Assistance for setting up of Ornamental Fish Unit in Goa” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for setting up Breeding Units and Rearing Units. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Setting Up of a Breeding Unit:
50% of the actual cost, limited to ₹ 1,50,000/-.
Setting Up of a Rearing Unit:
50% of the actual cost, limited to ₹ 1,50,000/-.
Setting Up of a Rearing Unit & Breeding Unit:
50% of the actual cost, limited to ₹ 2,50,000/-.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a Fish Farmer/ Individual/ Registered Self Help Group/ Societies, interested in setting up of the Ornamental Fish Farming unit in Goa.
The applicant should be a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years.
The applicant should have adequate water facilities for setting up the unit.
The applicant should have own/ leased land, adequate to set up an ornamental unit.
The applicant should have undergone a training programme on Ornamental Fish Farming organized by the Fisheries Department/ MPEDA/ ICAR.

of the application form.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the duration of the training program on Ornamental Fish Farming, and is it conducted by the Department?
The duration of the training program on Ornamental Fish Farming is not specified. However, applicants should have undergone a training program organized by the Fisheries Department/ MPEDA/ ICAR to fulfill the eligibility criteria. The training content and duration may vary based on the organizing institution.
Is there a specific format for the estimate of the proposed construction work, and who approves it?
The estimate of the proposed construction work should be in a detailed plan/layout format and approved by the engineer attached to V.P/ Municipality/ BDO/ PWD. This is an essential part of the documentation for the application.
What are the specific criteria for ownership of land, and how does it affect the eligibility for the scheme?
Land ownership can be either freehold or on lease. For owners, a copy of the land deed and Form 1 & XIV are required. For lessees, an NOC from the landowner and a registered lease agreement are necessary. Ownership details impact the eligibility criteria for the scheme.
Can the application form be submitted electronically, or is it only accepted in hard copy?
The application for the "Financial Assistance for setting up of Ornamental Fish Unit in Goa" scheme is accepted only in offline mode. Applicants need to submit the duly filled and signed hard copy of the application form along with the required documents to the designated authority.
What is the process for submitting a complaint about the service or its standards to the Grievance Redressal Officer?
Complaints about any service or its standards can be registered with the Department's Grievance Redressal Officer. The grievance can also be lodged via the link dir-fish.goa@nic.in. The Department acknowledges all complaints and communicates the final action within 30 days.
Is there a specific format for the design/layout of the Ornamental Unit that applicants need to follow?
Yes, the design/layout of the Ornamental Unit should be submitted with the application. It should adhere to the approved detailed plan and layout, ensuring compliance with the construction work estimates.
How does the Department handle grievances, and what is the expected timeline for grievance resolution?
Grievances can be registered with the Department's Grievance Redressal Officer via dir-fish.goa@nic.in. The Department acknowledges all complaints and communicates the final action within 30 days.
What are the repercussions if the information furnished in the application is found to be false?
If the information is found to be false or if there is any deviation or violation of the conditions, the application is liable to be rejected.
Can an applicant propose multiple Ornamental Units at different locations in a single application?
The application form allows providing details for a single Ornamental Unit. If an applicant intends to propose multiple units at different locations, separate applications should be submitted for each unit.
How does the Department verify the documents submitted with the application?
The documents submitted with the application are verified by a Gazetted Officer or through self-attestation. This ensures the authenticity of the provided information.
What is the significance of the mandate form in the application process?
The mandate form is essential for providing bank account details. It should be enclosed with the application and includes information on the bank account, such as the name of the bank, branch, and a copy of the passbook.
What is the maximum financial assistance limit for setting up both a Breeding Unit and a Rearing Unit under the scheme?
The financial assistance limit for setting up both a Breeding Unit and a Rearing Unit is 50% of the actual cost, limited to ₹2,50,000.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the age requirement for registration as a beneficiary under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Odisha?
The building worker must be at least 18 years old and not older than 60 years old.
Is there a minimum service requirement to register as a beneficiary?
Yes, the building worker must have completed 90 days of service as a building worker in the preceding 12 months.
Who can apply for the welfare scheme?
Any registered worker of the Board can apply for the welfare scheme.
Who is responsible for registering a worker as a beneficiary?
The District Labour Officers (D.L.O)/ Asst. Labour Officers/ Rural Labour Inspectors are acting as Registering Officers for the registration of beneficiaries under the Board.
Who is eligible for registration as a beneficiary of the BOCW Welfare Board?
Every building worker who is between the age of 18-60 years and who has been engaged in any building or other construction work for not less than 90 days during the preceding one year is eligible for registration as a beneficiary of the BOCW Welfare Board of Odisha.
Can Odia migrant workmen be registered as beneficiaries under the Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board?
Yes, Odia migrant workmen engaged in building and other construction works in other states can be registered as beneficiaries under the Odisha Building & Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board.
What is the procedure for applying for the registration?
To register as a beneficiary under the BOCW Welfare Board, an applicant worker should download Form-XXVII and attach all the mandatory documents (self attested, if required) and a fee of ₹20/- to the District Labour Officers (D.L.O)/ Asst. Labour Officers/ Rural Labour Inspectors of your area.
Alternatively, registration can also be done through the official website of the Odisha BOCWW Board: https://nirmanshramik.odisha.gov.in/obocwwb/public/cwLogin .
Is there a specific form for the registration through offline mode as a beneficiary under the BOCW Welfare Board?
Yes, the application for registration must be made in Form-XXVII. You can obtain this form from the District Labour Officers (D.L.O)/ Asst. Labour Officers/ Rural Labour Inspectors in your area.
How much is the fee associated with the registration process?
The registration fee is ₹20/- which is payable during the registration.
What happens after I pay the application fee?
After you pay the application fee of  ₹20/-, your application will be reviewed by the registering officer. The decision to approve or reject your application will be based on the merits of your application.
Who decides whether my application will be approved or rejected?
The registering officer is responsible for deciding whether your application will be approved or rejected based on its merits.
Can my application be rejected even if I have paid the application fee?
Yes, your application can be rejected even if you have paid the application fee. The final decision is made by the registering officer based on the merits of your application.
How much is the fee associated with the renewal of the registration?
The renewal fee is ₹50/- which is payable during the renewal process of the registration.
What criteria must an applicant meet to be considered for this benefit?
Registered workers of the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, are eligible to apply for this scheme for their children's education.
How many children of a member can benefit from this scheme?
The scheme entitles financial assistance for the education of up to two children per registered member.
If both parents are registered beneficiaries, can both apply for educational assistance?
No, if both spouses are registered beneficiaries, only one of them is eligible to receive the benefit of educational assistance for their children.
What form needs to be used to apply for this welfare scheme?
The application must be made in the prescribed Form-XLII. The form can be downloaded from https://bocboard.labdirodisha.gov.in/Building/homecontent/BeneficiaryForms/EDUCATION%20FORM.pdf  or can be collected from the District Labour Officers (D.L.O)/ Asst. Labour Officers/ Rural Labour Inspectors of your area.
Where do I submit the application for this welfare scheme?
Application can be submitted online on: https://nirmanshramik.odisha.gov.in/obocwwb/public/cwLogin . Alternatively , the offline application for this welfare scheme should be submitted to the District Labour Officers (D.L.O)/ Asst. Labour Officers/ Rural Labour Inspectors in your area.
What happens if the application is rejected?
In case of rejection, the applicants would be intimated about such rejection, with due intimation to the Board.
What are the consequences of submitting fraudulent documents for assistance?
In case of receipt of assistance on the basis of fraudulent documents, the amount released towards any assistance would be recovered from the applicant under the provisions of the OPDR Act, and his/ her membership would be ceased.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the "Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Sewing Machine" scheme?
The scheme is an initiative started by the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB), Labour Department, Chandigarh. It aims to provide financial assistance to the spouse of a registered male construction worker or female construction worker for the one-time purchase of a sewing machine.
Who is eligible to benefit from this scheme?
The scheme is designed to benefit the spouse of a registered male construction worker or female construction worker who is registered with the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB).
What is the amount of financial assistance provided under the scheme?
The scheme offers a one-time financial assistance of ₹3500/- to the eligible spouse of a registered male construction worker or female construction worker for the purchase of a sewing machine.
How often can an individual avail of this financial assistance?
Each eligible individual can avail of the financial assistance for the purchase of a sewing machine once in a lifetime.
Who is eligible to apply under the Scheme?
To be eligible for the scheme, the beneficiary must be actively working in an establishment registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965. Their contributions towards the labour welfare fund should be regularly received by the Board.
How is the financial assistance disbursed, and what documentation is required?
This financial assistance will be given on presenting original bills of purchase, duly verified by the employer.
When can an applicant become eligible for the scheme after becoming a member of the Board?
An applicant becomes eligible to avail the benefits of the scheme only after completing a period of six months as a member of the Board.
Can the financial assistance be used for any other purpose apart from purchasing a sewing machine?
No.
How to apply under the scheme?
To apply under the scheme, the applicants need to visit the official website of Labour Department Chandigarh and on the home page, select the scheme ‘FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE FOR THE PURCHASE OF SEWING MACHINE’ under the Grant of Welfare Schemes to the workers of Chandigarh Labour Welfare Board: http://labour.chd.gov.in/

SCHEME NAME: Financial Assistance for the Treatment of Blind, Disabled, Deaf, Dumb, or Mentally Challenged Ex-Servicemen and their Dependents (Wife and Children)
TAGS: Ex-Servicemen, Financial Assistance, Illness, Medical Treatment, Person With Disability, PwD
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The "Financial Assistance for the Treatment of Blind, Disabled, Deaf, Dumb, or Mentally Challenged Ex-Servicemen and their Dependents (Wife and Children)" scheme was launched by the Department of Sainik Welfare, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance for the treatment of ex-servicemen and their dependents (wife & children) who have a disability of 40% or more and are suffering from serious illnesses such as cancer, leprosy, tuberculosis, kidney and cardiac ailments, paralysis, etc. Only an ex-serviceman of the rank of Havildar or below or a member of the family of an ex-serviceman whose disability is 40% or more is eligible to apply. This scheme came into effect on 01.07.2020, and financial assistance will be granted from the first day of the month in which the application is approved.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial Assistance:
S. No.
Percentage of Disability
Financial Assistance
Priority
1
80% and above
₹3,000/- per month
First Priority
2
60% but less than 80%
₹2,000/- per month
Second Priority
3
40% but less than 60%
₹1,000/- per month
Third Priority
Note:
The assistance is provided for three years. After that, the applicant will re-apply for renewal.
The financial aid is disbursed online through the District Sainik Welfare Office.
A maximum of two disabled family members of an ex-serviceman can avail of this benefit.
The financial assistance will cease upon the death of the disabled ex-serviceman or the disabled family member.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
The applicant should either be an ex-serviceman as defined by the Government of India or a dependent family member (excluding parents) of ex-serviceman.
Only an ex-serviceman holding the rank of Havildar or below, or their family members, are eligible to apply.
The ex-serviceman or their dependent should have a disability of 40% or more.
Both pensioner and non-pensioner are eligible. However, ex-serviceman who is already receiving a disability pension from the Army cannot apply for financial assistance for himself based on their disability. He may apply on behalf of a disabled family member with 40% or more disability.
Under this scheme, the family members do not include parents. Only wife/widow, son/daughter are included.
The ex-serviceman’s disability will be considered valid regardless of whether it occurred during military service or after retirement.
The name of the disabled wife, son, or daughter should be recorded in the discharge book or Part II Order of the ex-serviceman.
Assistance will not be provided to more than two members of the same family, including the ex-serviceman.
A valid recommendation from the District Sainik Welfare Officer (DSWO) is mandatory.

### HOW TO APPLY

The application should be made through the same District Sainik Welfare Officer from whom the ex-serviceman/widow's identity card was issued.
Beneficiaries must reapply every three years for renewal.

SCHEME NAME: Financial Assistance in Marriage of Women Workers or Daughters of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
TAGS: Daughter, Financial Assistance, Marriage, Woman Worker, Worker
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme “Financial Assistance in Marriage of Women Workers or Daughters of Workers” is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board (HLWB), Labour Department, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹51,000/- is provided to the workers employed in the industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana for the marriage of their daughters and for the self-marriage of the working women workers as Kanyadaan. From 23.02.2015, the benefit of the said scheme is being extended from 02 girls to 03 girls for marriage and from 15.01.2019, the amount of kanyadaan will be provided three days before the date of solemnization of marriage. With the implementation of this scheme, the girl child will not be considered a burden in society and the boy-girl discrimination will also be reduced to some extent. This assistance will have no effect on the financial assistance received by the workers from other sources.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹51,000/- is provided to the workers employed in the industrial and commercial establishments of Haryana state for the marriage of their daughters and to the working female workers for their own marriage in the form of Kanyadan.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
The monthly salary of the applicant should not exceed ₹25,000/-.
The applicant must have a minimum of three years of regular membership of the Board till the Marriage date.
The applicant should apply within six months after the marriage date.
The benefits are provided to workers for the marriage of up to three daughters and for the self-marriage of female workers.
Note:
The worker will give an undertaking that he will clearly explain to the Board whether he/she has availed the benefits of the Kanyadaan Scheme for the first time, second time or third time or never before.

SCHEME NAME: Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academy’s Annual Tiatr Competition
TAGS: Artist, Culture, Drama, Financial Assistance, Music, Workshop
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academy’s Annual Tiatr Competition"  was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to encourage non-commercial dramatic troupes participating in Kala Academy’s yearly Tiatr Festival to produce Tiatrs of better quality. The scheme provides financial support for specific aspects of drama, including Direction, Stage Setting, Live Band Music with at least 2 blowing instruments, Light Effects, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, and Transport. It also features the video recording of the Tiatr for the Tiatr Academy of Goa Library, with a free Digital Versatile Disc copy provided to the institution, and offers expertise through compulsory workshops in various Tiatr components.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
1. Financial Support
For improving aspects of Tiatr production, including Direction, Stage Setting, Live Band Music with at least 2 blowing instruments, Light Effects, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, and Transport.
The extent of the financial support shall be fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
Direct payment to the Institution based on submitted bills.
Conditions
*The troupe must compulsorily participate in workshops organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa by deputing at least one of its members; otherwise, they will not be entitled to avail the benefits of this scheme.
*The Tiatr must not contain any adverse remark in any form, either written or verbal, against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc., or anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments; if proved so, Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to disqualify the performance and refrain from making any payment or recall the payment if already made.
*All advertisements, oral, print or electronic media, banners/standees, etc., must insert/publish and announce before the performance and during the interval that ‘This Tiatr is staged in collaboration with Tiatr Academy of Goa’.
﻿
2. Video Recording of Tiatr and Digital Versatile Disc Copy
Tiatr Academy of Goa will video record the said Tiatr for its Library and other uses. One copy of the Digital Versatile Disc will be given to the Institution free of cost. To preserve the presentation of Tiatr for future generations.
The dramatic troupe will have the freedom to use the Digital Versatile Disc in any manner, but cannot make use of the logo of Tiatr Academy of Goa on the said Digital Versatile Disc.
*The videographer will be appointed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
﻿
3. Expertise and Workshops
Tiatr Academy of Goa will provide expertise to the troupes in the different compartments of Tiatr (Direction, Stage Setting, Live Band Music, Light Effects, Background Music, Costumes, Make-up, Transport) by organizing workshops in those aspects.
Conditions
*The troupe will have to compulsorily participate in these workshops by deputing at least one of the members of the troupe.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a dramatic troupe.
The applicant must be participating in the Tiatr Competitions organized by Kala Academy.
The applicant must fulfill the conditions laid down in the scheme as per the format enclosed.
The applicant's Tiatr script will be scrutinized by a scrutiny committee who will submit a report on whether the Tiatr is as per the format.
The applicant must ensure that one typed copy of the Tiatr script and one typed copy each of the lyrics of the songs are submitted to Tiatr Academy of Goa along with the application form.
The applicant must ensure that handwritten copies of scripts and lyrics will not be accepted.
The applicant's Tiatr, in any form either written or verbal, must not contain any adverse remarks against any Government/Individual/Institution, etc., or anything against one’s caste, creed, and religion which may lead to hurting of religious sentiments of anybody.
The applicant must compulsorily participate in workshops organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa by deputing at least one of the members of the troupe.
﻿

prescribed format
of the application form.

SCHEME NAME: Financial Assistance to Ex-Servicemen of and above the Age of 60 Years and their Widows
TAGS: Ex-Serviceman, Financial Assistance, Sainik, Widow
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Ex-Servicemen of and above the Age of 60 Years and their Widows" is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Haryana. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹3,000/- per month shall be given to ex-servicemen and widows of ex-servicemen of and above the age of 60 years, who are not in receipt of any kind of pension/financial assistance or maintenance allowance either from any Department of Government of India/State Government or from any Body/Organization controlled by Central/State Government. Only bonafide residents of Haryana State are eligible for a grant of financial assistance and the applicants shall have to produce a domicile certificate issued by the competent authority as authorized by the Haryana Government and an attested copy of the Ration Card.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹3,000/- per month is given to ex-servicemen and widows of ex-servicemen aged 60 years and above, with an annual increase of ₹400/- w.e.f. 01.11.2017 every year in November.
Note:
Sanctioned financial assistance grant shall be payable to the beneficiary from the first day of the following month in which case for grant of financial assistance is sanctioned by the Raiya Sainik Board and no arrear, for the past period prior to the date of sanction of grant of financial assistance shall be paid.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana.
The applicant should be an ex-serviceman or widow of an ex-serviceman aged 60 years and above.
Only ex-servicemen of other ranks (i.e., Havildar and below) who are in penury and have an annual income from all sources below ₹2,00,000/- are eligible under the scheme.
The applicant should not be in receipt of any kind of pension, financial assistance, or maintenance allowance from any department of the Government of India/State Government or from anybody/organization controlled by the Central/State Government.
Persons who were discharged from service on the ground of "Service No Longer Required" under rule 13, III (V) due to misconduct & inefficiency are not eligible for financial assistance, and their widows’ are also not eligible for financial assistance as the individual does not fall in the definition of ex-serviceman.
The widows of ex-servicemen as per definition, who were discharged from service with fair character due to inefficiency/misconduct and "Service No Longer Required" due to inefficiency/misconduct are also not eligible for grant of financial assistance.
Note 1: If any beneficiary, after the date of sanction of the financial assistance, is found drawing old age pension or any other financial assistance from any other Government source. He/she shall be permanently debarred for the grant of financial assistance under all the welfare schemes run by the Rajya Zila Sainik Boards in Haryana.
Note 2: Payment of financial assistance to those beneficiaries shall be stopped immediately who fail to submit their survival verification proofs once every year in the month of April from the authorities.
Note 3: Old ex-serviceman & widow beneficiaries, whose cases for grant of financial assistance have already been sanctioned prior to the issue of the guidelines shall continue to get the financial assistance at enhanced rates as per their eligibility and they need not apply afresh.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online
Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:
Step 1:
The eligible applicant may apply online through the Official Portal-
Antyodaya-SARAL Portal
.
Step 2:
If the applicant is not registered on the portal, he/she gets registered there.
Step 3:
For registration, click “
New User
” under ‘Sign In Here’ and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password & State. Click on ‘Submit’.
Step 4:
Verify your mobile number and email ID through the received OTP and complete the registration process.
Login to apply for the scheme:
Step 1:
To avail the benefits of the scheme, visit the Official
Antyodaya-SARAL Portal
and log in through the email ID used while registering.
Step 2:
Enter Password & Captcha and click on ‘Login’.
Step 3:
After successful login, click on ‘Apply for Services’ and then ‘View all Available Services’.
Step 4:

Step 5:

Step 6:
Select the beneficiary/applicant name and enter the OTP that is being sent to the selected family member for verification. Click on “Click to Verify”
Step 7:
Fill in all the mandatory details and upload all the mandatory documents.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the monthly financial assistance amount under this scheme?
The monthly financial assistance amount is ₹3,000, with an annual increase of ₹400 every November starting from 01.11.2017.
Who is eligible for this scheme?
Eligible applicants are ex-servicemen or widows of ex-servicemen aged 60 years and above, who are bonafide residents of Haryana, have an annual income below ₹2,00,000, and are not receiving any other pension or financial aid from government bodies.
Are there any specific income criteria for eligibility?
Yes, the applicant’s annual income from all sources should be below ₹2,00,000.
Can an ex-serviceman discharged for misconduct apply for this scheme?
No, an ex-serviceman discharged on grounds of misconduct or inefficiency is not eligible for this scheme. Their widows are also not eligible.
How does one apply for this scheme?
Eligible applicants can apply online through the Antyodaya-SARAL Portal at https://saralharyana.gov.in/
Is there any penalty for receiving other government pensions after being sanctioned under this scheme?
Yes, beneficiaries found receiving any other government pension after sanction will be permanently debarred from all welfare schemes run by the Rajya Zila Sainik Boards in Haryana.
When does the sanctioned financial assistance start being paid?
The financial assistance is payable from the first day of the month following the month in which the grant is sanctioned.
Are there any arrears paid for the period before the sanction date?
No, there are no arrears paid for the period prior to the sanction date.
How can applicants track their application status?
Applicants can track their application status through the Antyodaya-SARAL Portal by entering their Department Name, Scheme Name, and Application Reference ID at https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/
Is it mandatory to submit survival verification proofs?
Yes, beneficiaries must submit survival verification proofs once every year in April.
Are old beneficiaries required to reapply under the new guidelines?
No, old beneficiaries whose cases were sanctioned prior to the new guidelines will continue to receive financial assistance at enhanced rates and do not need to reapply.
Can applicants receive financial assistance from other state government schemes simultaneously?
No, applicants should not be receiving financial assistance from any other state government schemes to be eligible for this scheme.
Can applicants from other states apply for this scheme?
No, only bonafide residents of Haryana are eligible for this scheme.

### DESCRIPTION

The scheme “Financial Assistance to Former Sports Person of UP” was launched by the Department of Sports, Government of Uttar Pradesh to provide financial assistance to sports persons who are old, weak, or facing hardships, under a scheme for the welfare of sports person of the state. International level sports persons who were members of the official national team and represented the country in the Olympics, Commonwealth, Asian games, and World Cup tournaments:

The sports persons awarded with the Arjun award, Dronacharya award, and Khel Ratna award or the sports persons awarded with Padma Shree and Padma Bhushan based on their achievements in the sports field:

Former sports persons of Uttar Pradesh who are facing difficulties in their old age are eligible for financial assistance under this scheme.

The financial assistance is categorized based on the level of representation and achievements of the sports person:

1. State-level sports persons who represented the official state team will receive ₹2,000/- per month.
2. National level sports persons who represented the official national team will receive ₹3,000/- per month.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the objective of the scheme "Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks" ?
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the  Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to boost industrial growth through financial assistance, modern technologies, and enhanced facilities for industrial parks and clusters.
What is the purpose of the "Assistance on Fixed Capital Investment" component?
The component "Assistance on Fixed Capital Investment", is designed to encourage the development of Industrial Parks by reimbursing a portion of eligible fixed capital investments.
Who is eligible to apply for this assistance?
Industrial Parks that include eligible fixed capital investments, such as new buildings, infrastructure facilities, and residential facilities for workers, are eligible to apply for this assistance.
What types of expenses are considered eligible for assistance?
Eligible expenses include the construction of new buildings, internal roads, power substations, water distribution facilities, sewage systems, and dormitories for workers, as per the SLEC-approved norms.
Is the cost of land purchase covered under this assistance?
No, the cost of land purchase, land development, and related expenses are explicitly excluded from eligibility for this assistance.
What is the maximum amount of financial assistance available?
Industrial Parks can receive up to  ₹30,00,00,000/- for infrastructure development and up to ₹20 crores for hostel/dormitory construction, depending on the type and location of the park.
Is prior approval from the State Level Empowered Committee (SLEC) required?
Yes, all projects must obtain prior approval from the SLEC for eligibility before claiming any financial assistance.
Do Industrial Parks in Vanbandhu Taluka receive additional assistance?
Yes, Industrial Parks located in Vanbandhu Taluka are eligible for 50% financial assistance, with a maximum limit of  ₹30,00,00,000/-, which is higher than the general rate.
Are technical consultant fees or preliminary expenses eligible for assistance?
No, fees for technical consultants, as well as preliminary and pre-operative expenses, are not eligible for financial assistance.
What are Schedule of Rates (SOR) norms?
SOR norms are cost estimation guidelines set by concerned government departments, which define the eligible construction costs for various infrastructure projects.
Can applicants claim assistance for expenses incurred before receiving approval?
No, only expenses incurred after receiving approval from the SLEC are eligible for financial assistance.
Are transportation equipment and vehicles covered under this assistance?
No, expenses related to transportation equipment or vehicles are not eligible for financial assistance under this scheme.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the objective of the scheme "Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks" ?
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the  Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to boost industrial growth through financial assistance, modern technologies, and enhanced facilities for industrial parks and clusters.
What are infrastructure facilities in an Industrial Park?
Infrastructure facilities include roads, power distribution, water supply, communication systems, sewage, parking, and other utilities required for the park's operations.
What is the financial assistance available for infrastructure facilities?
Financial assistance of up to 25% of the cost of Hostel/Dormitory Housing for domiciled workers is available, with a maximum limit of ₹20,00,00,000/- (excluding land costs).
What costs are considered eligible for financial assistance?
Only costs incurred for constructing approved infrastructure facilities, as per SOR norms or with SLEC approval, are considered eligible for financial assistance.
Are land costs included in the financial assistance?
Land costs are not included in the financial assistance provided for infrastructure development in an Industrial Park.
What is the significance of SOR norms in determining construction costs?
SOR (Schedule of Rates) norms ensure standardization and fairness in construction cost estimation for infrastructure development.
Who is eligible for financial assistance for infrastructure development?
Industrial Parks that provide approved infrastructure facilities and have prior approval for constructing Hostel/Dormitory Housing for domiciled workers are eligible for financial assistance.
Is prior approval necessary for constructing worker dormitories?
Yes, obtaining prior approval from the relevant authority is mandatory for receiving financial assistance for constructing worker dormitories.
What happens if the construction cost exceeds the SOR norms?
If the construction cost exceeds SOR norms, the project requires approval from the SLEC to remain eligible for financial assistance.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the objective of the scheme "Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks" ?
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the  Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to boost industrial growth through financial assistance, modern technologies, and enhanced facilities for industrial parks and clusters.
What is the purpose of the "Stamp Duty" component?
The "Stamp Duty" component provides financial assistance to developers and individual units by reimbursing a percentage of the stamp duty paid on land or plot purchases within an approved Industrial Park.
How much reimbursement can Institute receive under this scheme?
Institute can receive 100% reimbursement of the stamp duty paid on the purchase of land for an Industrial Park.
What is the reimbursement percentage for individual units within the Industrial Park?
Individual units located within an Industrial Park are eligible for a 50% reimbursement of the stamp duty paid on the purchase of plots.
What are the conditions for developers to be eligible for the reimbursement?
Developers must purchase the total required land and complete at least 10% of the infrastructure as approved by the State-Level Empowered Committee (SLEC).
Are individual units required to meet specific conditions to apply for the reimbursement?
Yes, individual units must purchase a plot within an approved Industrial Park and provide proof of stamp duty payment to apply for reimbursement.
Is this scheme applicable to land or plots purchased outside an approved Industrial Park?
No, the reimbursement is only applicable to land or plots purchased within an approved Industrial Park.
Are individual units required to apply directly to the SLEC for reimbursement?
No, individual units need to apply through the Industrial Park authority with the necessary documents.

==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
“Financial Assistance to Mussel Culture and Oyster Farming in Goa” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for setting up units in estuarine waters, and in open sea. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Setting Up of Unit in Estuarine Waters
50% subsidy limited to ₹ 25,000 per unit, maximum for 2 units. Each unit in the estuarine water will be of size 4 meters x 4 meters.
Setting Up of Unit in Open Sea
50% limited to ₹ 40,000 per unit, maximum for 2 units. Each unit in the Open sea will be of size 6 meters x 6 meters.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a Fish Farmer/ Individual/ Registered Self Help Groups/ Societies/ Associations, interested in setting up the Mussel Culture/ Oyster Farming Unit in Goa.
The applicant should be a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years.
The applicant should have undergone a training programme on Mussel Culture/ Oyster Farming organized by the Fisheries Department/ MPEDA/ ICAR/ any other institute.

Department of Fisheries, Dayanand Bandodkar Marg, Patto Colony, Panaji Goa - 403 521, or to the official posted at

SCHEME NAME: Financial Assistance to Newlyweds under Kanyadan Yojana (Vijabhaj)
TAGS: Backward Class, Bride, Groom, Marriage, Nomadic Tribe
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Newlyweds under Kanyadan Yojana (Vijabhaj)" was launched by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to reduce the economic, social, and educational backwardness of Scheduled Castes, Freed Castes, Nomadic Tribes, and Special Backward Classes in Maharashtra, helping integrate them into the mainstream of society. The grant is provided for the first marriage of both the bride and groom of these communities.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
A financial assistance of ₹10,000/- is provided to couples who participate in mass marriage ceremonies.
An incentive grant of ₹2,000/- per couple is offered to institutions and organizations that organize mass marriage ceremonies for these communities.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The bride and the groom must be residents of Maharashtra.
The groom should not be less than 21 years of age.
The bride should not be less than 18 years of age.
The grant is only admissible for the first marriage of the bride and groom, however, it is also admissible to a widow for her second marriage.
Either or both of the bride and groom must belong to Scheduled Castes (including Neo-Buddhists), Vimukta Castes, Nomadic Tribes (including Dhangars and Vanjaris), or Special Backward Classes.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the
District Social Welfare Office
and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the concerned authority.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the Assistant Commissioner or to the Social Welfare Officer of the District Social Welfare Office.
Step 4:
Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
NOTE:
Ensure that the application is submitted within the prescribed period, if any.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter Card, etc.).
Passport-size Photograph.
﻿
﻿
Proof of Residence.
Ration Card.
Bank Account Details.
Proof of Age.
Marriage Certificate.
A written affidavit must be submitted by the couple/family, stating that there has been no violation of any section under the Prevention of Child Marriage Act and the Prevention of Dowry Act.
A caste certificate issued by a competent and authorized officer must be provided.

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Maharashtra
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/fatnukyv
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the "Kanyadan Yojana (Vijabhaj)" scheme?
This scheme provides financial assistance to economically backward couples belonging to Scheduled Castes, Freed Castes, Nomadic Tribes, and Special Backward Classes for their first marriage.
How much financial assistance is provided under this scheme?
A financial assistance of ₹10,000/- is given to the newlywed couple.
Can organizations receive assistance for mass marriage ceremonies?
Yes, institutions or organizations organizing mass marriage ceremonies can receive an incentive of ₹2,000/- per couple.
Who is eligible for the financial assistance?
The bride and groom must belong to Scheduled Castes, Freed Castes, Nomadic Tribes, or Special Backward Classes. They must also be residents of Maharashtra.
What is the age requirement for the bride and groom?
The groom must be at least 21 years old, and the bride must be at least 18 years old.
Is the financial assistance provided for all marriages?
No, the grant is only available for the first marriage of the bride and groom, though it can also be provided to widows for their second marriage.
Do both the bride and groom need to belong to the same caste category?
No, either or both the bride and groom must belong to the eligible categories (Scheduled Castes, Freed Castes, Nomadic Tribes, or Special Backward Classes).
What documents are required to apply for the scheme?
Caste certificates, marriage registration certificates, and a written affidavit must be submitted by the couple.
Is there any income limit to apply for the scheme?
The scheme does not specify any income limit, but the assistance is targeted at economically backward families.
What is the procedure for applying for this scheme?
Couples need to apply through the concerned district office, submitting the necessary documents and affidavits.

SCHEME NAME: Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of Ex-Servicemen
TAGS: ESM, Ex-Servicemen, Financial Assistance, Orphan, Sainik
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Financial Assistance to Orphan Children of Ex-Servicemen" is implemented by the Sainik and Ardh Sainik Welfare Department, Government of Haryana. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹3,000/‐ per month shall be granted to those Orphan Children of Ex-Servicemen (ESM) only who are bonafide resident of the Haryana State and are not in receipt of any kind of financial assistance from any Department of Haryana Government. The benefits under this scheme are given only to those orphan children of ex-servicemen who are below age 21 years, unmarried, and unemployed.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
1.	Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹3,000/- per month is given to the orphan children of ex-servicemen, with an annual increase of ₹400/- w.e.f. 1.11.2017 every year in November.
Note:
Subject to the condition that application claim case of the orphan children is found in order. Financial Assistance to the orphan children of Ex-servicemen will be sanctioned with effect from the first day of the following month in which their case for claiming the Financial Assistance is sanctioned.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana.
The applicant should be an orphan child of an ex-serviceman.
The applicant should not be receiving any kind of financial assistance from any department of the Haryana Government.
The applicant's age should be below 21 years.
The applicant should be unmarried.
The applicant should be unemployed.
Note 1:
The definition of Ex-Servicemen for the purpose of the eligibility of grant of Financial Assistance to shall be effective as adopted by the Ministry of Defence Government of India from time to time.
Note 2:
Details of orphan children of ESM along with their date of birth as issued by Unit Record Office of the Ex-servicemen will have to be submitted by the applicant while applying for Financial Assistance.
Note 3:
The orphan children of ESM who are in receipt of ordinary family pension from Govt. of India are also eligible for financial assistance under this scheme.
Note 4:
Old beneficiaries, (orphan children) whose cases for grant of Financial Assistance have already been sanctioned prior to issue of these guidelines shall continue to get the Financial Assistance at enhanced rates and they need not apply afresh.
Note 5:
The payment shall be discontinued with immediate effect to the orphan children on their attaining the age of 21, or till he/she gets employment or till he/she gets married whichever is earlier.
Note 6:
Payment of Financial Assistance to those beneficiaries shall be stopped immediately who fail to submit their survival verification proofs once every year from the revenue authorities in the month of April. Secretary, Zila Sainik Board shall be personally responsible for any lapse in this regards.
Note 7:
If any beneficiary, after the date of sanction of the Financial Assistance under this scheme is found drawing any type of Financial Assistance from any other Deptt. of Haryana Govt. He/she shall be permanently debarred from getting Financial Assistance under all schemes run by the Rajya and Zila Sainik Boards in Haryana.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online
Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:
Step 1:
The eligible applicant may apply online through the Official Portal-
Antyodaya-SARAL Portal
.
Step 2:
If the applicant is not registered on the portal, he/she gets registered there.
Step 3:
For registration, click “
New User
” under ‘Sign In Here’ and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password & State. Click on ‘Submit’.
Step 4:
Verify your mobile number and email ID through the received OTP and complete the registration process.
Login to apply for the scheme:
Step 1:
To avail the benefits of the scheme, visit the Official
Antyodaya-SARAL Portal
and log in through the email ID used while registering.
Step 2:
Enter Password & Captcha and click on ‘Login’.
Step 3:
After successful login, click on ‘Apply for Services’ and then ‘View all Available Services’
Step 4:
Now, you can search for the scheme and click on the scheme to go ahead and fill out the application form.
Step 5:
Enter your Parivar Pehchan Patra number - Family ID and click on “Click here to Fetch Family Data” which displays the family members registered under the given Family ID.
Step 6:
Select the beneficiary/applicant name and enter the OTP that is being sent to the selected family member for verification. Click on “Click to Verify”
Step 7:
Fill in all the mandatory details and upload all the mandatory documents.
Step 8:
Preview the application form and click on ‘Submit’.
Tracking of Application:
Applicants can track their applications through the Official

by entering their Department Name, Scheme Name, and Application Reference ID.

All the applications received by the Zila Sainik Boards shall be scrutinized at the level of Zila Sainik Boards itself and applications so found fit for grant of Financial Assistance will be forwarded with all relevant documents to Rajya Sainik Board with clear recommendation of Secretary, Zila Sainik Board.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Copy of Ex-servicemen Identity-Card
Parivar Pehchan Patra
Aadhaar Card
Original Discharge Book of ESM
Haryana Resident Certificate
Revenue Report verified from Tehsildar
Copy of Bank Passbook linked with Aadhaar Number
Death Certificate of the father and mother of the Orphan signed by the competent authority
Non-Employment Certificate (in case of major)
Delay report
Self-Photo ID card (Ration Card/Driving License/ Voter ID Card/PAN Card etc.)
NOC from the concerned District Social Welfare Department regarding not receiving any financial assistance except ordinary family pension.
Legal Guardianship certificate given by the court in case of a minor
Birth Certificate of the applicant
Affidavit for verifying the particulars given by the Orphan/Guardian of the Orphan
Any other documents as required
Note 1:
The applicants will have to produce a Domicile Certificate issued by the competent authority.
Note 2:
In the case of minor orphan children the application and all other documents will be signed by the legal guardian declared by (competent court), but in the case of major children, the application and all other documents will be signed by the major orphan child himself/herself.
Note 3:
In the case of minor orphan children the guardianship Certificate’ duly issued by the competent court will be submitted by the legal guardians along with the application.
Note 4:
A school certificate Birth certificate issued by a competent authority showing the date of birth of the orphan child will have to be submitted by the applicant.
Note 5:
Death certificate of father & mother birth certificate of the child must be signed by the competent authority in every case. Death Birth Certificates signed by the Sarpanch, Panch, or Chowkidar only shall not be accepted in any circumstances.
Note 6:
The original Discharge Book issued by the concerned Record Office of the Ex-servicemen will have to be submitted by the applicant for scrutiny of the case which will be returned through the respective Zila Sainik Board after the scrutiny of the claim case.
Note 7:
Every application for claiming Financial Assistance under this scheme shall be supported with an affidavit duly attested by a First Class Magistrate containing all necessary information in support of the application such as the relationship of the guardian with the child and his parents, financial position of the orphan children that he /she is unmarried and unemployed, etc.
Note 8:
Every applicant shall have to produce a certificate issued by the concerned District Social Welfare Officer to the effect that the applicant is not getting any Financial Assistance/ old age pension from the Social Justice & Empowerment Department of Haryana.

Frequently Asked Questions
Who is eligible for this scheme?
The orphan children of ex-servicemen who are bonafide residents of Haryana, below 21 years of age, unmarried, unemployed, and not receiving financial assistance from any other department of the Haryana Government.
What is the amount of financial assistance provided under this scheme?
₹3,000/- per month with an annual increase of ₹400/- starting from November 1, 2017.
When does the financial assistance start after approval?
Financial assistance is sanctioned from the first day of the following month in which the claim is approved.
Is the financial assistance provided on a monthly or annual basis?
The financial assistance is provided on a monthly basis.
What happens if an orphan child receives financial assistance from another Haryana Government department?
They will be permanently debarred from receiving financial assistance under all schemes run by the Rajya and Zila Sainik Boards in Haryana.
Can an orphan child who receives an ordinary family pension from the Government of India apply for this scheme?
Yes, they are eligible for financial assistance under this scheme.

The financial assistance is provided until the orphan child reaches 21 years of age.
What happens if the orphan child gets married or employed?
The financial assistance will be discontinued immediately.

SCHEME NAME: Financial Assistance to Purchase Outboard Motor of 2HP to 5 HP for Fitting to the Fishing Canoe
TAGS: Financial Assistance, Fish, Fishermen, Subsidy
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
“Financial Assistance to Purchase Outboard Motor of 2HP to 5 HP for Fitting to the Fishing Canoe” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. This Scheme has been introduced to grant financial assistance in the form of a subsidy on the purchase of an outboard motor of 2HP to 5 HP for the operation of the fishing canoe below 26 feet. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
For General Category
50% subsidy, limited to ₹30,000 on a unit cost of ₹60,000 (excluding GST).
For SC/ST/Woman Category
60% subsidy, limited to ₹36,000 on a unit cost of ₹60,000 (excluding GST).
NOTE 1:
The financial assistance is provided for only 01 Outboard Motor for fitting to the fishing canoe of below 26 feet.
NOTE 2:
The beneficiary can avail of the scheme every 5 years.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
The applicant should be a resident of Goa.
The applicant's Fishing Canoe should be registered with the Department of Captain of Ports, Government of Goa.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
The interested applicant should request the prescribed format of the application form from the department by paying ₹50/-.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned authority at the
Department of Fisheries, Dayanand Bandodkar Marg, Patto Colony, Panaji Goa - 403 521, or to the official posted at
BDO Office/ Sub-Offices
of the Department of Fisheries.
﻿
Grievance Redressal
Any dissatisfaction or complaint about any service or its standards can be registered with the Department's
Grievance Redressal Officer
. The grievance can also be lodged on the link
dir-fish.goa@nic.in
. All complaints will be acknowledged by us and final action taken will be communicated within 30 days.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Vessel Registration Certificate (VRC) issued by the Captain of Ports or the Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa, duly incorporating the details of the Outboard Motor purchased.
River Gill Net Registration Certificate (RGNC) and License Certificate (LC) issued by the Department of Fisheries.
Undertaking as per proforma.
Copy of Aadhaar Card.
Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste Certificate (ST/SC Certificate) (if applicable).
Mandate Form along with Bank Passbook.
Caste Certificate/Professional Certificate.
Original Invoice from the Authorized Dealer towards the purchase of the Outboard Motor of 2HP to 5HP.

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Goa
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/fatpomo2t5ffttfc

### DESCRIPTION
Details
“Financial Assistance to Purchase/Construct New Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for Fishing in Inland Waters of Goa” is a scheme by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa. The scheme has been introduced to uplift the sizeable community of traditional Fishermen, by providing them financial help in the form of a subsidy on the construction/ purchase of Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for fishing in inland waters of Goa. The applications are accepted only in offline mode.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
For General Category
50% subsidy, limited to ₹30,000, on a unit cost of ₹60,000 (excluding GST).
For SC/ST/Woman Category
60% subsidy, limited to ₹36,000, on a unit cost of ₹60,000 (excluding GST).
NOTE:
The benefits can be availed after every 7 years against the replacement of the existing Canoe.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
The applicant should be a resident of Goa.
The Fishing Canoe should be registered with the Department of Captain of Ports, Government of Goa.
