Yes, the scheme is exclusively for residents of Bihar.
What is the source of funding for this scheme?
The scheme is fully funded by the State Government of Bihar.



==================================================
SCHEME NAME: Kabir Puraskar Scheme
TAGS: Award, Cash, Certificate
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The Government of India introduced the “Kabir Puraskar Scheme” in1990 under which a National Award designated as “KABIR PURASKAR” was instituted in three grades, namely, Grade One, Grade Two, and Grade Three carrying a title and cash Award of ₹20,000, ₹10,000 & ₹5,000 respectively for acts performed during communal riots. The Scheme has been amended and the cash amounts of the various grades of the Award and eligibility criteria for the Award have been revised.
Purpose:
This Award is instituted to promote communal, caste, and ethnic harmony by recognizing acts of Physical/moral courage and humanity exhibited by the member(s)  of one a community, caste, or ethnic group in saving the lives and properties of the member(s) of another community, caste or ethnic group. Such courage and promptitude in saving the life and property of member(s) of another community,  caste, or ethnic group shall also involve a danger to the life/body/property of the rescuer himself or herself and to his or her family member(s). Three sets of criteria have been prescribed to decide the category of Award. It is entirely left to the Screening Committee mentioned in clause 6 to decide upon the category of Award on the merits of each individual act of courage as reported by the State Government or Union Territory Administration.
Timing of Announcement of Award:
The  Award shall be announced on 2nd October each year.
Presentation:
The Award may be given by the Central Government and presented to the recipients by the Prime Minister at a function organized for the purpose in New Delhi.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
1. Amount  of  Award:
Sl. No.
Grade
Amount of Award
1
Grade‐I
₹2,00,000 (Rupees two lakh only)
2
Grade‐II
₹1,00,000 (Rupees one lakh only)
3
Grade‐III
₹50,000 (Rupees fifty thousand only)
2. A certificate with a suitable citation shall also be awarded to the recipients.
Note 01:
The cash Award is non‐recurring. There shall be no bar on a  person receiving such Award for a second time on a subsequent occasion.
Note 02:
The names of those persons upon whom such Award is conferred shall be published in the official gazette
Note 03: The criteria for three grades of Award are as under:
Grade‐I:
For most conspicuous acts of physical/moral courage displayed under circumstances of very grave danger to the life of the rescuer or an act resulting in death or the permanent incapacitation of the rescuer/his or her family member(s) in saving life and property of member(s)  of another community, caste or ethnic group.
Grade‐II:
For conspicuous acts of physical/moral courage or promptitude under circumstances of danger to the life of the rescuer resulting in bodily injury in saving the life and property of member(s) of another community,  caste, or ethnic group.
Grade‐III:
For acts of physical/moral courage and promptitude in saving the life and property of member(s) of another community, caste, or ethnic group.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
1.	The Award (Kabir Puraskar) shall be awarded  to an  individual for  his/her conspicuous acts of physical/moral courage displayed under circumstances of danger to the life of the rescuer in:‐
(a) saving the life and property of member(s) of another community during communal  riots; or
(b) Saving the life and property of member(s) of another caste during  caste conflicts;  or
(c) Saving the life and property of member(s) of another ethnic group during ethnic clashes.
2.	All Indian citizens of either sex in all walks of life  (other than members of the Armed Forces, Police Forces and members of recognized fire services, Government servants, if the act performed by them falls in the sphere of their duty) shall be eligible for this Award.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 01:
All recommendations for the award shall be made through State Governments/UT Administrations. (
Nomination Form-Annexure-I
)
Step 02:
The proposals shall be placed before the Screening Committee consisting of the Union Home Secretary, Director (Intelligence Bureau), and Secretary in the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (formerly Ministry of Welfare).
Step 03:
The recommendations of this  Committee shall be placed before the Union Home Minister and the Prime  Minister for approval.
Note:
There is no fixed number of the Award in any of the three Grades. The State Governments/UT  Administrations may recommend the nominations of any number of persons who fulfill the relevant provisions of the Scheme.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
1.	Identity proof of candidate
2.	Three copies of recent passport Size Photographs
3.	A detailed note on the act of physical/moral courage displayed by the nominee during communal/caste/ethnic violence
4.	Details of any other work done  in the past for promotion of communal harmony/national integration
5.	Recommendations letter of the State Govt./UT Administration
6.	Any other document, if required

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: All
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/kps
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the “Kabir Puraskar Scheme”?
The Government of India introduced the “Kabir Puraskar Scheme” under which a National Award designated as “Kabir Puraskar” was instituted in three grades, namely, Grade One, Grade Two, and Grade Three carrying a title and cash Award for acts performed during communal riots.
Which is the implementing agency of this scheme?
Ministry of Home Affairs
When was this scheme launched?
The scheme was launched in the year 1990.
What is the timing of the announcement of the Award?
The award shall be announced on 2nd October each year.
Where will the award be given to the recipients?
The award may be given by the Central Government and presented to the recipients by the Prime Minister at a function organized for the purpose in New Delhi.
Who is eligible to get the award?
All Indian citizens of either sex in all walks of life (other than members of the Armed Forces, Police Forces and members of recognized fire services, Government servants, if the act performed by them falls in the sphere of their duty) shall be eligible for this Award.
What is the amount of cash award which is to be given to the recipients?
The cash award of ₹2,00,000, ₹1,00,000 & ₹50,000 will be given for Grade-I, Grade-II, and Grade-III respectively.
What are the other benefits given to the recipients of the award?
A certificate with a suitable citation shall also be awarded to the recipients.
Is there any bar on a person receiving such an award for a second time?
No, there shall be no bar on a person receiving such Award for a second time on a subsequent occasion.
Who will not be considered for the award?
The members of the Armed Forces, Police Forces and members of recognized fire services, Government servants, if the act performed by them falls in the sphere of their duty will not be considered for the award.
Can an individual directly nominate himself/herself for the award?
No, all recommendations for the Award shall be made through State Governments/UT Administrations.
How many numbers of persons can be nominated for the award from a state/UT?
The State Governments/UT Administrations may recommend the nominations of any number of persons who fulfill the relevant provisions of the Scheme.

SCHEME NAME: Kaidi Sahay Yojana
TAGS: Prisoner Family Aid, Social Welfare
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The Kaidi Sahay Yojana, initiated by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial relief to families of prisoners who are undergoing sentences in jails and are the main or sole earners of their households. Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance of ₹25,000/- is granted to the prisoner’s family, ensuring that they can sustain themselves through self-employment during the imprisonment period.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial Assistance:
A one-time assistance of ₹25,000/-.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
Applicant must be a family member of a prisoner currently serving sentence in a state jail in Gujarat.
The prisoner should be the sole or main earner of the family.
The prisoner's family must be economically dependent on the prisoner.
The total family income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum.
The family should not be fragmented (i.e., should be living together and dependent on the prisoner).
﻿
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
Visit the District Jail/ Sub Jail/ District Social Defense Office and obtain the
application form
.
Step 2:
Fill out the form with all required details and attach the necessary documents (Self-attested, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the completed application to the office of the District Welfare Officer/ Sub Jail.
﻿
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Aadhaar Card.
Bank Pass Book/Cancelled Cheque.
Income Certificate.
Ration Card.

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Gujarat
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/ksygsw
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the "Kaidi Sahay Yojana" and what is its objective?
The "Kaidi Sahay Yojana" is a welfare scheme launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of the Government of Gujarat with the objective of providing one-time financial assistance of ₹25,000 to the families of prisoners who are undergoing a sentence and were the sole or primary earners of their households prior to their imprisonment.
﻿
﻿
Who is eligible to receive benefits under the "Kaidi Sahay Yojana"?
The scheme is specifically designed for the dependent families of prisoners who are currently serving a sentence in any of the jails within Gujarat and who were the main or sole source of income for their families before their imprisonment.
﻿
﻿
What is the amount of financial assistance provided under this scheme?
Under the Kaidi Sahay Yojana, eligible applicants are granted a one-time financial assistance amounting to ₹25,000/-, which is intended to support the family through self-employment or other livelihood-generating activities during the period of imprisonment.
﻿
﻿
What are the income criteria that need to be fulfilled to avail the scheme benefits?
The total annual income of the prisoner's family must not exceed ₹1,50,000/-, and this financial threshold ensures that the benefits are targeted towards economically weaker families who are most in need of support.
﻿
﻿
Is it mandatory that the prisoner's family should not be fragmented to avail the scheme?
Yes, it is a necessary condition that the prisoner's family must not be fragmented, meaning the family should be living together and should be financially and socially dependent on the prisoner for their livelihood.
﻿
﻿
Can any family member of the prisoner apply for this scheme on behalf of the family?
Yes, any immediate and dependent family member of the prisoner, such as the spouse, parent, or adult child, is allowed to apply for the scheme, provided all eligibility criteria are fulfilled and supporting documents are submitted.
﻿
﻿
Is there any application fee that needs to be paid while submitting the form?
No, there is no application fee for this scheme, and the application form is available free of cost at designated government offices such as the District Jail, Sub Jail, and District Social Defense Office.
﻿
﻿
Can a family apply for the scheme if the prisoner is not the sole earner?
No, the scheme strictly applies only to those cases where the prisoner was the sole or main earning member of the family prior to being imprisoned, and this criterion is critical for determining eligibility.
﻿
﻿
How is the financial assistance amount disbursed to the beneficiaries under this scheme?
Once the application is approved and verified by the concerned authorities, the financial assistance amount of ₹25,000/- is directly transferred to the bank account of the applicant family member through a secure and traceable banking process.
﻿
﻿
Where should the completed application form be submitted?
Once all the required information is filled in and supporting documents are attached, the completed application form should be submitted to the Welfare Officer of the concerned District or Sub Jail.
﻿
﻿
What types of documents must be attached along with the application form?
Applicants must provide essential documents such as the Aadhaar card of the family member applying, a bank passbook or a cancelled cheque, an income certificate, and a copy of the ration card to establish their identity, financial status, and eligibility.
﻿
﻿
Does the applicant need to belong to a specific caste or community to apply?
The scheme is open to all castes and communities; it does not impose any caste-based or community-based eligibility restrictions.

SCHEME NAME: Kailash Darshan Yatra
TAGS: Culture, Heritage, Pilgrim, Tourism, Travel
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
Launched in 2001, the scheme "Kailash Darshan Yatra" by the Gujarat Holy Pilgrimage Development Board, Tourism Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the sacred Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage. The scheme offers one-time financial assistance to selected applicants who complete the yatra. To be eligible, the applicant must be a selected pilgrim from Gujarat and submit proof of yatra completion within 90 days. Applications for this scheme are accepted offline.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
One-time financial assistance is provided to the pilgrim for undertaking the Kailash Darshan Yatra.
Validity:
Once in a lifetime per pilgrim.
*The scheme guidelines do not specify the amount of the benefit; applicants should verify with the authorities.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a pilgrim from Gujarat.
The applicant must have completed the Kailash Darshan Yatra.
The applicant must apply within 90 days of yatra completion.
The applicant must not have availed of the benefit before under this scheme.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
The interested applicant should take a printout of the
prescribed format
of the application form.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields (details of the authorized travel agent/organizer, details of the pilgrims), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to
"Gujarat Holy Pilgrimage Development Board, Old Secretariat, Gandhinagar"
within 90 days of yatra completion.
*Retain a copy of the submitted application for future reference.
﻿
Verification & Disbursement
The board processes applications, and financial assistance is credited to the beneficiary’s account.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Copy of Passport
Certificate of Participation
Proof of Selection
Bank Details (for disbursement)

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Gujarat
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/kdy
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the time limit to submit my application after completing the yatra?
You must submit your complete application within 90 days of completing the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra.
Can I apply for this financial assistance more than once?
No, this is a once-in-a-lifetime benefit; pilgrims who have previously availed of this scheme cannot apply again.
Who is eligible to apply for this financial assistance for the pilgrimage?
Only pilgrims selected through the Ministry of External Affairs' process and who are residents of Gujarat may apply for this benefit.
What documents do I need to submit as proof of completing the pilgrimage?
You must provide a Certificate of Participation and proof of selection, both issued by the Ministry of External Affairs.
What supporting documents must accompany my application?
Required documents include your complete passport copy, bank details, selection proof, and the completed application form.
Where should I submit my completed application and documents?
Applications must be submitted in person or by mail to:
Gujarat Holy Pilgrimage Development Board, Old Secretariat, Gandhinagar
How will I receive the financial assistance if my application is approved?
The approved amount will be directly credited to your bank account after verification.
What happens if I submit my application after the 90-day deadline?
Applications received after 90 days of yatra completion will likely be rejected as per scheme guidelines.

TAGS: Financial Assistance, Mansarovar, Pilgrim, Tourism, Yatra
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme “Kailash Mansarovar Yatra Scheme 2016” was launched by the Tourism Department, Government of Haryana on 12th July 2016. Under the scheme, the government of Haryana provides financial assistance to the pilgrims of the State of Haryana. The financial assistance will be provided up to the extent of ₹50,000/- or 50% of the actual expenditure per person whichever is less. This scheme will be commenced w.e.f. 1st April 2016 and financial assistance will be provided to those applicants who complete the Yatra after this date.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
The financial assistance will be provided up to the extent of ₹50,000/- or 50% of the actual expenditure per person whichever is less.
Financial assistance shall be provided to a maximum of 50 (fifty) numbers of pilgrims.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Haryana State.
The applicant/pilgrim should complete the Yatra through the Ministry of External Affairs, Govt. of India and the completion certificate in this regard must be obtained from the Ministry of External Affairs, Govt. of India.
The financial assistance shall be given only once to a pilgrim.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Online
Step 01:
A pilgrim who has completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra shall submit the application within two months after completion of the Yatra through the Ministry of External Affairs, Govt. of India to the Director of Tourism Department, Haryana.
Step 02:
The application form in the prescribed format (
Annexure “A”
) shall be required to submit to the Director, along with all the relevant documents.
Step 03:
After scrutiny of the documents received from the pilgrims, the Director of Tourism Department Haryana shall submit the same within 15 (fifteen) days to the Administrative Secretary Government of Haryana, Tourism Department for approval.
Step 04:
Thereafter, the requisite sanction shall be issued for payment for financial assistance through a Demand Draft.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
1.	Identity proof
2.	Passport-size photographs
3.	Attested Copy of the Permanent Residential Certificate (Domicile) of Haryana.
4.	Resident Proof/Address Proof
5.	Attested Copy of the Yatra Completion Certificate from the Ministry of External Affairs, Govt. of India.
6.	Attested copy of required Visa and Passport.
7.	Declaration from the pilgrim that he/she never claim this Financial Assistance earlier and would not claim it in the future.

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Haryana
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/kmys2016

SCHEME NAME: Kaimagga Vikasa Yojana - Karnataka
TAGS: Handloom, Skill Development, Subsidy, Weaver
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The “Kaimagga Vikasa Yojana” was launched by the Department of Handloom & Textiles, Government of Karnataka. The scheme aims to sustain and develop the handloom weaving skills of existing weavers and to attract young talent to the industry, thus preserving the rich cultural heritage of handloom weaving in Karnataka. The scheme is designed to help both traditional and new weavers by offering support for the purchase of new handlooms and necessary equipment.
﻿
Equipment Covered:
Equipment such as handlooms, electronic jacquards, pre-loom facilities like knotting machines, and warping machines are covered under the scheme.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Subsidy:
Beneficiaries can get 50% of the unit cost of new handloom/equipment/machinery.
﻿
Disbursement of Subsidy:
50% after initial verification and the remaining 50% after confirming the purchase of equipment.
﻿
NOTE:
The remaining 50% can be financed by the beneficiary from a financial institution/bank loan or through the beneficiary's own capital.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The weaver should have membership in Handloom Weaver Co-operative Societies residing in their own house/rented house, or Handloom Associations/Organisations/Karnataka Development Corporation.
Traditional weavers should practice the current handloom weaving profession.
The weaver should have a Weaver's Identity Card.
Young men and women who are starting their weaving career must have completed training in handloom weaving under any government scheme and possess the relevant certificate.
The weaver purchasing a warping machine should have a proper certificate of experience in washing and the necessary space to install the machine.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the district-level office of the Handloom and Textile Department. and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the district-level office of the Handloom and Textile Department.
Step 4:
Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Weaver's Identity Card (Attested Copy)
Handloom Weaving Training Certificate (Attested Copy)
Loan Sanction Letter/ Letter of Agreement for financing 50% of unit cost from Financial Institution/ Bank Loan/Own Capital
Any other document if required
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Karnataka
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/kvy-k
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the Kaimagga Vikasa Yojana?
It is a scheme by the Karnataka Government to support handloom weavers by providing subsidies for purchasing new handlooms and equipment.
Who is eligible for this scheme?
Eligibility includes weavers who are members of Handloom Weaver Cooperative Societies, Handloom Associations, Karnataka Development Corporation, or individual weavers.
What is the subsidy amount provided under this scheme?
The scheme provides a subsidy of 50% of the unit cost for new handlooms and necessary equipment.
Can new weavers apply for this scheme?
Yes, new weavers who have completed handloom weaving training under any government scheme can apply.
Is there any age limit for applying to this scheme?
There is no specific age limit mentioned; however, young men and women entering the weaving profession can apply.
What kind of equipment can be purchased under this scheme?
Equipment such as handlooms, electronic jacquards, pre-loom facilities like knotting machines, and warping machines are covered under the scheme.
How is the subsidy disbursed to the beneficiaries?
The subsidy is disbursed in two installments: 50% after initial verification and the remaining 50% after confirming the purchase of equipment.
What is the role of district-level officials in this scheme?
District-level officials are responsible for identifying eligible beneficiaries, scrutinizing applications, and ensuring proper disbursement of subsidies.
Can beneficiaries receive additional loans under this scheme?
Yes, beneficiaries can avail themselves of loans under the Weavers Credit Card Scheme for additional working capital.
What should be done if the equipment is damaged after purchase?
Beneficiaries should report any damage to the district-level officers, who will provide further guidance based on the scheme rules.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Is there any provision for Kala Gaurav Puraskar beneficiaries to apply for other art-related schemes, such as the Kala Samman Scheme?
Yes, if Kala Gaurav Puraskar beneficiaries meet the criteria for the Kala Samman Scheme, they can apply for it. Similarly, Kala Samman beneficiaries can also avail the benefit of Kala Gaurav Puraskar if they fulfill its specific criteria.
Are there any exclusions or limitations regarding who can receive the Kala Gaurav Puraskar?
Yes, individuals who have received the State Cultural Award or have already availed of the benefit under the Kala Gaurav Puraskar scheme previously are not eligible.
Can you provide more details about the eligibility criteria for artists to be considered for the Kala Gaurav Puraskar?
Certainly. To be eligible for the Kala Gaurav Puraskar, an artist should be an individual artist, at least 60 years old, and have made substantial contributions to their respective field of art for a minimum of 10 years, specifically in Goa.
What is the primary objective of the Kala Gaurav Puraskar, and why is it important for artists in Goa?
The primary objective of the Kala Gaurav Puraskar is to recognize and felicitate artists who have made significant contributions to the field of Art and Culture in Goa. It is important because it honors their lifetime achievements and appreciates their invaluable cultural contributions.
Can artists from diverse fields of art, such as traditional and contemporary, visual and performing arts, apply for the Kala Gaurav Puraskar?
Yes, the Kala Gaurav Puraskar is open to artists from various fields, including traditional and contemporary, visual and performing arts.
Are there specific guidelines on what constitutes "substantial contributions" in the field of art and culture, especially for artists from lesser-known art forms?
Substantial contributions are assessed based on an artist's impact, recognition within their field, and contributions to their art form's development. Lesser-known art forms are equally valued.
Can artists with international acclaim, who have represented Goa on global platforms, apply for the Kala Gaurav Puraskar?
Yes, artists with international acclaim are eligible if they meet other criteria and have contributed significantly to Goa's cultural scene.
How does the scheme assess the impact of an artist's work on the local community, especially for artists involved in community-based or folk arts?
The scheme typically assesses impact through documentation, community testimonials, and the artist's active role in local cultural preservation.
Are there age restrictions beyond the 60-year requirement, such as an upper age limit for applicants?
The primary age requirement is 60 years. There's typically no upper age limit for eligible artists.
Can artists with disabilities who have made outstanding contributions to art and culture in Goa apply, and are there specific criteria for their eligibility?
Yes, artists with disabilities are eligible, and the scheme often considers their unique contributions and challenges.
Can artists who have received other national or state awards still apply for the Kala Gaurav Puraskar?
Yes, artists with other awards can still apply if they meet the scheme's eligibility criteria. Awards from other institutions can be considered a testament to an artist's excellence.
Can you provide more details about the recommended format for the Recommendation Letter required for the Kala Gaurav Puraskar application?
The Recommendation Letter should be a formal letter that outlines the reasons for nominating the artist. It should ideally come from someone familiar with the artist's work, such as an expert in the field, a fellow artist, or a respected institution.
Can you elaborate on what should be included in the Biodata of the nominee for the Kala Gaurav Puraskar application?
The nominee's Biodata should provide a comprehensive overview of their artistic journey, including their achievements, career highlights, notable works, and any relevant personal details such as educational background.
For nominees who are non-resident Indians (NRIs) or Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs), what documentary proof is needed, and how should they verify their eligibility?
NRIs or OCIs typically need to provide documentation verifying their status, such as a copy of their passport and relevant visas or permits. This helps establish their eligibility for the award.

SCHEME NAME: Kala Samman Scheme
TAGS: Art, Artist, Award, Culture, Financial Assistance
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Kala Samman Scheme" is implemented by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Goa, to grant financial assistance to eminent artists who are in indigent circumstances as a token of respect for their contribution to the field of Art and culture.
﻿
Objectives
To give financial support to the artists in indigent circumstances.
To grant monthly financial assistance to the artists who are in indigent conditions to meet their daily needs.
To recognize the contribution of artists in the field of Art and culture.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial Assistance to the extent of ₹ 2,500/- per month every year.
However, the recipient of State Cultural Award shall be entitled for Financial Assistance to the extent of ₹ 3,200/- per month every year.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be an artist who is in indigent condition.
The applicant should have attained the age of 60 years.
The applicant should have given a contribution to the field of Art and culture or should have worked in the field of Art and culture.
The income of the applicant should not exceed ₹ 48,000/- per annum. (However, this clause shall not be applicable, where the applicant is the recipient of the ‘State Cultural Award').
NOTE:
The number of cases to be sanctioned shall depend upon the availability of funds for every financial year.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
The Director of Art & Culture shall release an advertisement in local daily newspapers thereby inviting applications from eligible applicants.
Step 1:
The interested applicant should visit the Directorate Of Art & Culture, Government of Goa, 5th Floor, Shram Shakti Bhavan, Panaji, Patto, Panaji, Goa - 403001
Step 2:
Take a print of the
proforma
of the application form, or request a hard copy from the concerned authority.
Step 3:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest if required).
Step 4:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned authority.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Passport Sized Photograph
Proof of Age (Birth Certificate or School Leaving Certificate) (Self-Attested). In absence of both these documents, copy of Aadhar card or baptism certificate certifying his birth date.
Income certificate from competent authority.
Resume, giving details of work done in the field of Art & Culture.
References of two known persons or institutions working in respective field of Art & Culture.

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Goa
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/kss
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
In case of disputes or grievances related to the Kala Samman Scheme, who has the final decision-making authority?
In case of grievances arising from the implementation of this scheme, the Minister for Art & Culture will hear and decide such matters, and the Minister's decision will be final.
Can the Government relax any of the clauses in this scheme if necessary?
Yes, the Government has the authority to relax any or all of the clauses in this scheme if found necessary, for reasons that will be recorded.
When and how is the financial assistance disbursed to eligible artists?
After the Committee's recommendations are received and approved by the Director of Art and Culture, the financial assistance is disbursed to eligible artists during functions organized by the Department of Art & Culture or through other means.
How are applications for the Kala Samman Scheme processed, and who reviews them?
The Director of Art & Culture releases an advertisement inviting applications. An appointed Committee reviews all the applications and makes recommendations based on eligibility criteria.
Can artists with a false or incorrectly presented date of birth be penalized?
Yes, if the stated date of birth is false or incorrectly presented, the onus will lie on the applicant, and appropriate action may be taken against them.
What documents are required when applying for the Kala Samman Scheme?
When applying for the scheme, artists need to submit various documents, including proof of age, income certificate, a resume detailing their work in the field of Art & Culture, and references from two known persons or institutions in the same field.
How much financial assistance does an eligible artist receive under this scheme?
An eligible artist is granted financial assistance to the extent of ₹2,500 per month every year. However, recipients of the State Cultural Award are entitled to financial assistance to the extent of ₹3,200 per month every year.
Who is eligible to apply for assistance under the Kala Samman Scheme?
Any artist who is in indigent condition, has attained the age of 60 years, and has contributed to the field of Art & Culture can apply for assistance under this scheme.
What is the primary objective of the Kala Samman Scheme introduced by the Government of Goa?
The primary objective of the Kala Samman Scheme is to grant financial assistance to eminent artists who are in indigent circumstances as a token of respect for their contributions in the field of Art & Culture.

SCHEME NAME: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Compensation Towards Natural Calamities
TAGS: Artist, Calamity, Compensation, Construction, Culture, House
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Compensation Towards Natural Calamities" component of the scheme aims to financially assist the Goan artists to meet expenses towards repair or construction of their houses damaged due to natural calamities. The maximum financial assistance provided under this component is ₹25,000/- or the valuation done by the concerned Taluka Mamlatdar, whichever is less. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Art & Culture. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial assistance shall be provided to meet expenses towards the repair or construction of a house damaged due to natural calamities.
The quantum of financial assistance shall be a maximum of ₹25,000/- or as per the valuation done by the concerned Taluka Mamlatdar, whichever is less.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a Goan, i.e., born and brought up in Goa.
The applicant must be recognized as an artist by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.
The income of the family of the applicant (from all sources) must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum.
The artist must not be less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.)
The applicant must be in need of funds to meet expenses towards repair or construction of their house damaged due to natural calamities.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the
Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.
﻿
Post-Application Processes
Step 1:
The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee.
Step 2:
The sub-committee shall consider the received applications and recommend the names of the artists which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released to the needy artist.
Step 3:
After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance.
Step 4:
After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one-time financial assistance amount to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Valuation Report (from the concerned Taluka Mamlatdar)
Birth Certificate
Income Certificate
Proof of Recognition (by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Goa)
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Goa
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/kkn-ctnc
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the maximum amount of financial assistance that I can receive if my house has been damaged by a natural disaster?
The financial assistance is either ₹25,000/- or the amount determined by the concerned Taluka Mamlatdar's valuation report, whichever is lower.
﻿
Is there any age requirement that needs to be fulfilled by an artist to be eligible for this assistance?
Yes, the artist must be at least 50 years of age, although the Government may relax this criterion for deserving cases under special circumstances.
﻿
What happens if I have already received compensation for the same damage from another government source or scheme?
You will not be eligible for this assistance if you have already claimed or received benefits from any other sources for the same purpose.
﻿
Can an artist who was born in Goa but later moved to another state apply for this scheme?
No, the applicant must be a Goan artist who was born and brought up in the state of Goa to be eligible.
﻿
If my annual family income is slightly above ₹2,00,000/-, will I still be considered for this financial assistance?
No, the annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum to qualify for this assistance.
﻿
What specific document do I need to submit to prove the extent of damage caused to my house?
You must submit a valuation report from the concerned Taluka Mamlatdar that assesses the damage to your house.
﻿
Is it necessary to be officially recognized by any government department to qualify for this compensation towards natural calamities?
Yes, you must be recognized as an artist by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa to be eligible.
﻿
Can I use this financial assistance for constructing a new house or is it only for repairing an existing damaged house?
The assistance can be used for both repair and construction of the house that has been damaged due to natural calamities.
﻿
What types of natural calamities are covered under this component of the scheme for providing compensation to artists?
The scheme covers houses damaged due to natural calamities, although specific types of calamities are not explicitly listed in the guidelines.
﻿
Do I need to provide a birth certificate as part of my application for this natural calamity compensation?
Yes, a birth certificate is listed among the documents required for the application process under this scheme.
﻿
Is proof of my income required to establish eligibility, and from which authority should this certificate be obtained?
Yes, an income certificate is required as part of the documents, and it should be obtained from the competent authority.
﻿
If the Taluka Mamlatdar's valuation report shows damage worth ₹30,000/-, what amount will I receive as financial assistance?
You will receive ₹25,000/- as that is the maximum ceiling amount, even though the valuation is higher.
﻿

SCHEME NAME: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Lumpsum Grant
TAGS: Artist, Death, Dependent, Family, Financial Assistance
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Lumpsum Grant" component of the scheme aims to provide a lumpsum grant (maximum ₹20,000/-) to the dependent family in case of death of the artist. The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial Assistance in the form of a lumpsum grant, maximum of ₹20,000/- shall be provided.
The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode.
Conditions
The wife/husband of the late artist shall be considered first for the grant.
In the event of the wife/husband predeceasing the late artist, the benefit shall be passed on to the unmarried/unemployed sons/daughters of the deceased artist as the case may be in equal ratio.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The deceased artist must have been Goan, i.e., born and brought up in Goa.
The deceased artist must have been recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.
The deceased artist must not have been less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.)
The applicant must be the dependent family member of the deceased artist.
The wife/husband of the late artist shall be considered first for the grant.
In the event of the wife/husband predeceasing the late artist, the benefit shall be passed on to the unmarried/unemployed sons/daughters of the deceased artist as the case may be in equal ratio.
The annual income of the family of the deceased artist (from all the sources) must be less than ₹25,000/- per annum.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the
Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.
﻿
Post-Application Processes
Step 1:
The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee.
Step 2:
The sub-committee shall consider the received applications and recommend the applicants which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released to the needy artist.
Step 3:
After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance.
Step 4:
After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one-time financial assistance amount to the applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the maximum allowable annual family income from all sources to be eligible for this specific financial grant?
Only those families whose total annual family income from all sources is less than ₹25,000/- per annum shall be eligible for this grant category.
﻿
If the primary eligible family member is not alive, who is eligible to receive the benefit instead?
If the wife or husband predeceases the late artist, the benefit can be passed on to the unmarried or unemployed sons or daughters of the deceased artist.

The benefit shall be passed on to the eligible unmarried or unemployed sons or daughters of the deceased artist in equal ratio.

The deceased artist must have been an aged and needy Goan Artist recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.

The one-time financial assistance amount is disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing Service (ECS) mode.

The maximum financial assistance provided in the form of a lumpsum grant upon the death of the artist is ₹20,000/-.

The application must be submitted directly to the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.

Yes, relevant documentation like dependency certificates or birth certificates may have to be enclosed as required under various objectives of the scheme.

The applicant must enclose a Death certificate of the late artist along with the application.

The application forms will be available at the office of the department during the working days.

SCHEME NAME: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
TAGS: Artist, Culture, Daughter, Family, Marriage
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Marriage Component" of the scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists to address their daughter's marriage-related expenses. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The applications for this scheme are accepted through prescribed proforma directly at the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial Assistance
Financial assistance of ₹20,000/- shall be sanctioned for the first wholly dependent daughter's marriage.
Financial assistance of ₹15,000/- shall be sanctioned for the second wholly dependent daughter's marriage.
Maximum two wholly dependent unmarried daughters shall be eligible for this benefit.
Disbursement
The financial assistance shall be disbursed through Electronic Clearing System mode.
The assistance is a one-time grant per eligible daughter's marriage.
Conditions
The details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers shall be furnished to the department.
The unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount if any shall be refunded to the Government within 2 months from the date of marriage.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
For the Artist
The applicant must be a Goan aged needy artist, born and brought up in the state of Goa.
The applicant must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.
The applicant must be not less than 50 years of age.
The applicant's annual family income from all the sources should not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum.
For Dependent Daughter(s)
The daughters must be wholly dependent on the eligible Goan artist.
The daughters must be unmarried at the time of application.
Maximum two wholly dependent unmarried daughters shall be eligible.
Relaxation
The Government may relax the age criteria for the artist for deserving cases under special circumstances.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the
Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.
﻿
Post-Application Processes
Step 1:
The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee.
Step 2:
The sub-committee constituted by the Government shall meet as and when required and shall consider the applications received for this purpose. The committee shall recommend the names of the artists which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released to the needy artist.
Step 3:
After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance.
Step 4:
After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one-time financial assistance amount to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account.
﻿

At the Time of Application
Dependency Certificate from the Authorized Authority.

Marriage Certificate or any other document indicating the relationship.
Income Certificate from the Competent Authority.
Recognition Certificate from the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.
After Benefit Disbursal

The financial assistance provided is ₹20,000/- for the first wholly dependent daughter's marriage and ₹15,000/- for the second daughter's marriage.

If my annual family earnings from all sources are ₹2,50,000/-, would I still qualify for the marriage benefit?

Can I receive assistance for the marriages of three daughters if all of them are wholly dependent on me?

Yes, the age limit for grant of benefits shall be not less than 50 years in case of the eligible artist, though the Government may relax this in deserving cases.

What type of certificate do I need to provide to establish that my daughter is wholly dependent on me?
You must submit a dependency certificate from the authorized authority to establish that your daughter is wholly dependent on you.

You must furnish the details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers to the department after the completion of the marriage.

The scheme is meant for wholly dependent unmarried daughters, so they must be unmarried at the time of application for eligibility.

Yes, you must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa to be eligible for this assistance.

You should visit the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa during working days to obtain and submit the application form.

What is the consequence if I fail to attach all the required certificates and documents with my application?
If all relevant documentation like birth certificate, marriage certificate, dependency certificates, and income certificates are not enclosed, the application shall be summarily rejected.

If I am born in Goa but currently reside outside the state, can I still apply for this assistance?
The applicant must be a Goan aged needy artist, born and brought up in the state of Goa.

==================================================
SCHEME NAME: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Medical Treatment
TAGS: Artist, Healthcare, Hospital, Medical, Subsidy, Surgery
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Medical Treatment" component of the scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists and their dependent family members in indigent circumstances to meet expenses towards major or minor surgical treatment in local or outstation hospitals, including travelling and accommodation expenses outside the state for treatment. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Art & Culture. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial Assistance
Financial assistance shall be sanctioned to meet the expenses towards major or minor surgical treatment in local or outstation hospitals.
Financial assistance shall be provided to meet the expenses towards travelling and accommodation outside the state for treatment for self and or wholly dependent family members.
The maximum financial assistance under this category shall not exceed ₹50,000/-.
The Government may relax the ceiling in case of major chronic ailments.
Disbursement
The financial assistance amount shall be disbursed to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode.
The disbursement shall be one-time financial assistance.
Conditions
The beneficiary shall not avail the benefit of medical reimbursement from any other Government department or under any schemes or policies for the medical treatment for which the financial assistance is granted under this scheme.
The details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers shall be furnished to the department after availing the treatment.
The unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount if any shall be refunded to the government within 3 months from completion of the treatment.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be any Goan aged needy artist, born and brought up in the state of Goa.
The applicant must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.
The applicant must have an annual family income from all sources not exceeding ₹2,00,000/- per annum.
The applicant must be not less than 50 years of age.
Relaxation
The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the
Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.
﻿
Post-Application Processes
Step 1:
The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee.
Step 2:
The sub-committee constituted by the Government shall meet as and when required and shall consider the applications received for this purpose. The committee shall recommend the names of the artists which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released to the needy artist.
Step 3:
After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance.
Step 4:
After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one time financial assistance amount to the eligible applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account.
Step 5:
After availing the treatment, the beneficiary shall furnish the details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers to the department within 3 months from completion of the treatment.
*If there is any unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount, the same shall be refunded to the government within 3 months from completion of the treatment.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
During Application
Birth Certificate
Marriage Certificate (if applicable for family members)
Dependency Certificate (for dependent family members)
Income Certificate
Medical Certificate (issued by the authorized doctor or hospital)
Estimate of Expenditure from the Authorized Doctor or Hospital. (However, in case of treatment availed or to be availed on emergency basis, the estimate shall be submitted subsequently)
Recognition Certificate (from the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa)
After Treatment
Details of the Expenditure Incurred along with the Vouchers.
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Goa
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/kkn-mt
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the maximum financial assistance I can receive for my medical treatment expenses under this component?
The maximum financial assistance available is ₹50,000/-. However, the Government may relax this ceiling in case of major chronic ailments requiring higher expenditure.
﻿
If I need emergency treatment and cannot get an estimate beforehand, will my application still be considered valid?
Yes, your application will be considered valid. In case of treatment availed or to be availed on emergency basis, the estimate from the authorized doctor or hospital can be submitted subsequently.

Yes, financial assistance is provided to meet expenses towards treatment for self and or wholly dependent family members, including travelling and accommodation expenses outside the state.

The age limit for grant of benefits is not less than 50 years. However, the Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.

You must furnish the details of the expenditure incurred along with the vouchers to the department within 3 months from completion of the treatment.
﻿
What should I do with any remaining amount if I do not utilize the entire sanctioned financial assistance for my treatment?
Any unutilized amount out of the sanctioned amount must be refunded to the government within 3 months from completion of the treatment.
﻿
Can I claim reimbursement from another government department if I have already received financial assistance for the same medical treatment?
No, you cannot avail the benefit of medical reimbursement from any other Government department or under any schemes or policies for the medical treatment for which financial assistance is granted.

What is the annual family income limit that I must not exceed to qualify for this financial assistance?
Your annual family income from all sources should not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum to be eligible for the financial assistance under this component.
﻿

You can obtain and submit the prescribed application form directly at the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa during working days.
﻿
Does the financial assistance cover expenses for treatment only in local hospitals or can I seek treatment outside the state?
The financial assistance covers major or minor surgical treatment in local or outstation hospitals, and also includes expenses towards travelling and accommodation outside the state for treatment.
﻿
What type of recognition from authorities do I need to have to be considered eligible for this financial assistance?
You must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa, and you should be a Goan aged needy artist, born and brought up in the state of Goa.

After obtaining Government approval, the Director of Art & Culture shall disburse the one time financial assistance amount in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to your bank account.

Who can apply on my behalf if I am unable to submit the application myself for the financial assistance?
Eligible artist or the family or co-artist or any member of the public can apply in prescribed proforma directly to the Directorate of Art & Culture on your behalf.

SCHEME NAME: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
TAGS: Artist, Culture, Financial Assistance, Pandemic, Relief
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Pandemics" component of the scheme aims to provide financial assistance to aged and needy Goan artists who have lost the source of income due to the pandemic. The scheme provides relief in the form of financial assistance amounting to a minimum of ₹5,000/- (lumpsum) up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- (lumpsum) to eligible artists affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline at the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
One-time financial assistance in the range of ₹5,000/- to ₹10,000/- (lumpsum) per eligible artist, as decided by the committee.
Released in the Bank Account (Nationalized Bank) of the artist. The disbursement is done in the form of Electronic Clearing Service mode.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The artist must be a resident of Goa.
The artist must be above 18 years of age.
The artist must have lost the source of income due to the pandemic of COVID-19.
The individual income of the artist (from all the sources) must not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum.
The artist should be working and contributing in the field of art and culture fields, i.e. Music/Dance/Drama/Tiatr/ Folk/Kir tan/Bhajan/Painting/Sculpture/Literature/Cantarists/Sahittik/Poets/Photographers/traditional Handicraft etc.
Artists should be in need of such financial assistance as contemplated in the scheme.
The artist should solely be dependent on the art related activities/programmes.
The artist shall not be a Government employee or an employee of Autonomous bodies, Corporations nor pensioner of any organization.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the
Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.
﻿
Post-Application Processes
Step 1:
The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee.
Step 2:
The sub-committee shall consider the received applications and recommend the applicants which are considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released to the needy artist.
Step 3:
After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance.
Step 4:
After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one-time financial assistance amount to the applicant in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Domicile Certificate
Proof of Age
Income Certificate
Proof of Recent Contribution in the field of Art and Culture
Self-signed Affidavit/Declaration (on ₹50/- Stamp Paper) regarding the Individual Income (from all sources).
*Either a Proof or a Self-signed Affidavit/Declaration may be required from the applicant regarding the following -
Loss of the source of income due to the pandemic of COVID-19.
Solely dependence on the art related activities/programmes.

The applicant must be above 18 years of age and must have lost their source of income due to the COVID-19 pandemic to qualify for this assistance.
﻿
If I am working on a contract or daily wage basis in a private organization, can I still apply for this financial support?
Yes, employees working on contract or daily wages are considered eligible, provided their individual annual income from all sources does not exceed ₹1,50,000/-.

The individual annual income of the artist from all sources must not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum to be eligible for this pandemic relief.

No, beneficiaries of Kala Samman who receive monthly pensions from the Department of Art & Culture are not eligible for this scheme.

The financial assistance ranges from a minimum of ₹5,000/- to a maximum of ₹10,000/- as a lumpsum amount per eligible artist.

Can a government employee or a pensioner from any organization apply for financial assistance under the pandemic relief provision?

Yes, the applicant must be solely dependent on art-related activities and programmes to be considered eligible for this financial assistance.

What is the residency requirement for artists applying for pandemic-related financial assistance under this scheme?
The applicant artist must be a resident of Goa to be eligible for financial assistance under the pandemic relief provision.

The committee will decide the quantum of assistance to be sanctioned within the prescribed limit of ₹5,000/- to ₹10,000/- based on their assessment.

In what mode will the financial assistance amount be disbursed to the eligible artist under the pandemic relief category?

SCHEME NAME: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
TAGS: Artist, Culture, Education, Scholarship, Student
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi" was launched by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The "Scholarships/Incentives" component of the scheme aims to provide financial support to the wards of recognized Goan artists who are pursuing higher education, thereby addressing the economic challenges faced by artist families in supporting their children's educational aspirations and ensuring continuity of educational opportunities despite financial constraints. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
A monthly scholarship of ₹750/- is sanctioned to eligible wards during the currency of the academic year.
The vacation period is excluded from the scholarship disbursement period.
The scholarship is disbursed on a half-yearly basis.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
For the Artist
The artist must be a Goan, i.e., born and brought up in Goa.
The artist must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.
The income of the family of the artist (from all sources) must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum.
The artist must not be less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.)
For the Ward of the Artist
The ward must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution.
The ward must be pursuing Postgraduate, Degree, or Professional courses.
The ward may be enrolled in educational institutions within the state or outside the state.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
Visit the office of the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa, and collect the prescribed application form for the scheme.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the completed application form along with all required documents directly to the
Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.
﻿
Post-Application Processes
Step 1:
The Directorate shall forward the application to the sub-committee for scrutinizing the application thoroughly. The Director shall give its recommendations to the sub-committee.
Step 2:
The sub-committee shall consider the received applications and recommend the names considered fit by the sub-committee to avail the benefits under this scheme. The committee shall decide the quantum of assistance to be released.
Step 3:
After the committee decides on the quantum of assistance, the approval from the Government shall be obtained for disbursement of the financial assistance.
Step 4:
After obtaining Government approval, the Director shall disburse the one-time financial assistance amount in the form of Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
For the Artist
Birth Certificate.
Recognition Certificate, from the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa.
Income Certificate, from the Competent Authority.
For the Ward of the Artist
Birth Certificate.
Proof of Admission.
Dependency Certificate (or a document establishing the relation with  the artist).
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Goa
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/kkn-si
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the monthly scholarship amount that will be provided to eligible students under this financial assistance program?
Eligible wards receive a monthly scholarship of ₹750/- during the academic year, excluding vacation periods. The scholarship is disbursed on a half-yearly basis to support their educational expenses.
﻿
Is there any specific requirement regarding the type of educational courses for which the scholarship can be availed?
Yes, the ward must be enrolled in Post Graduate, Degree, or Professional courses at recognized educational institutions. These courses can be pursued either within the State of Goa or outside the state.
﻿
What is the minimum age criterion that must be satisfied by the parent or guardian who is an artist applying for this benefit?
The parent or guardian artist must be at least 50 years of age at the time of application. However, the Government may relax this age criterion for deserving cases under special circumstances.
﻿
Are there any income limitations that need to be considered when applying for this educational financial support?
Yes, the annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum. An income certificate from the competent authority must be submitted along with the application.
﻿
Is there any restriction on the location or state where the ward can pursue their higher education?
No, there is no geographical restriction. The ward can be enrolled in recognized educational institutions either within the State of Goa or outside the state for pursuing eligible courses.
﻿
Will the scholarship be provided during the vacation periods or breaks in the academic calendar?
No, the scholarship of ₹750/- per month is provided only during the currency of the academic year. The vacation period is explicitly excluded from the scholarship disbursement.
﻿
What is the frequency or periodicity with which the scholarship amount will be transferred to the beneficiary?
The scholarship amount is disbursed on a half-yearly basis. This means payments are made twice during the academic year to cover the eligible period.
﻿
Is it mandatory for the parent or guardian artist to have official recognition from any specific government department?
Yes, the parent or guardian artist must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. The recognition certificate must be submitted along with the application.
﻿
Where should the completed application form along with all supporting documents be submitted physically?
The completed application form with all required documents should be submitted directly to the Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa during working hours on any working day.
﻿
Through which mode will the scholarship amount be transferred to the beneficiary after approval?
After obtaining Government approval, the Director of Art & Culture disburses the scholarship amount through Electronic Clearing System mode to the bank account provided during the application process.
﻿

SCHEME NAME: Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana
TAGS: Education, Loan, Student
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The "
Kalinga Sikhya Sathi Yojana (KSSY)
" is a scheme introduced by the the Department of Higher Education, Government of Odisha. It is an educational loan scheme for the students who want to pursue their higher studies. The objective of the scheme is to bring down the financial burden on the parents of the students who want to move forward with higher education. A student can get a maximum of ₹ 10 lakhs as an educational loan under this scheme. The applicants will have to pay only 1% interest on the loan amount. The balance amount of the interest will be borne by the Government of Odisha, Higher Education Department. All the courses like medicine, engineering, law, management, etc are covered under this scheme. The loan will be provided to economically weaker background student, who secures admission in any professional or technical course in any University or IIM or any educational institution set up by an Act of Parliament or by State Legislature.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Maximum Loan:
According to the rules of the scheme, a student can get a maximum of ₹ 10,00,000 as an educational loan under this scheme.
Minimum Loan:
There is no minimum loan amount mentioned in the scheme. One can get any amount of loan up to ₹ 10,00,000.
Period of Loan:
The period of repayment will be up to 10 years and 15 years in respect of loans sanctioned up to ₹ 7,50,000 and ₹ 10,00,000 respectively.
Rate of Interest:
The applicants will have to pay only 1% interest on the loan amount. The balance amount of the interest will be borne by the Government of Odisha, Higher Education Department.
The
Moratorium Period
of education loans is a course period plus one year depending on the banks. But under KSSY, financial assistance in the form of interest subvention shall be provided for the period of repayments including the moratorium period after the completion of the course. This will prove to be very beneficial to students.
NOTE:
The terms are conditions of the loan will be as per the norms of individual scheduled banks. The loan applications will be processed by the rules of the banks.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The student must be a resident/domicile of Odisha.
The annual income of the applicant's family should be less than or equal to ₹ 8,00,000 per annum.
Poor students willing to continue higher studies can apply for a loan under this scheme.
The student shouldn’t avail of similar benefits from any other Government/Institution for the same purpose.
The student must have secured admission to a higher education course in recognized institutions in India or Abroad.
The course of study be in Management or Integrated Law or Course of Engineering or Medicine in any Educational Institution in India established by Acts of Parliament or by Any State Legislature or other institutions recognized by the concerned Statutory Bodies.

SCHEME NAME: Kalpana Chawla Chatravriti Yojana

### DESCRIPTION
Details
Launched in 2012-13 by the Government of Himachal Pradesh in honor of the late astronaut Kalpana Chawla, the "Kalpana Chawla Chatravriti Yojana" is a scholarship scheme that provides financial assistance to girls of Himachal Pradesh who belong to economically weaker sections and wish to pursue higher education without any financial burden, achieve their career goals and become self-reliant. The scheme is applicable to all the eligible girl students who are residents of Himachal Pradesh and studying in recognized institutions within the state.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
The scholarship amount is ₹ 15,000 per annum, which will be disbursed to the beneficiary's bank account directly.
The scholarship is renewable for up to five years, subject to the student meeting the eligibility criteria.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh.
The applicant must be a girl.
The applicant must be a regular student of 10+2, academic, professional or technical course in Science/Arts/Commerce stream.
The institution where the applicant is admitted must be a Government / Government Aided / Private School affiliated with the Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education.
The scholarship is available for higher education courses, including undergraduate, postgraduate, and professional courses.
The scholarship will be given strictly on 10+2 merit declared by the Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education, Dharamshala.

The Kalpana Chawla Chatravriti Yojana is a scholarship scheme launched by the government of Himachal Pradesh to provide financial assistance to meritorious girl students belonging to economically weaker sections.

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam" was launched in 2014 by the Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Telangana, aims to alleviate financial distress in SC/ST and minority families by providing financial assistance to unmarried girls at the time of marriage. this scheme, a one-time financial assistance of ₹1,00,116 (₹1,25,145 for disabled girls) is provided to eligible girls at the time of marriage.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
One-time financial assistance of ₹1,00,116/- for unmarried SC/ST and minority girls at the time of marriage.
One-time financial assistance of ₹1,25,145/- for disabled girls, irrespective of caste, under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
The amount is directly credited to the bride’s bank account.
Only one-time assistance is allowed in a lifetime.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be an unmarried girl belonging to the SC/ST/BC/EBC community.
The applicant should be a resident of Telangana.
The applicant should be 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
The applicant's marriage should be scheduled on or after October 2, 2014.
The applicant’s parental income should not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum.
Note:
Enhanced financial support is available for disabled girls under Section 24(1) of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY

Online
Step 1:
Visit the official ePASS website at
https://telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in/
.

Select "Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam" scheme.

Step 4:
Upload scanned documents including Aadhaar, caste/income certificates, bank passbook, marriage certificate/photo, etc.
Step 5:
Apply online.
Step 6:
A unique application number will be generated.
Step 7:
Await verification from the Welfare Department.
Step 8:
Upon approval, the sanctioned amount will be credited to the bride’s bank account.
Step 9:
Save acknowledgment/receipt for future reference.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED

SSC Hall Ticket Number and Year of Passing (optional, where applicable)
