==================================================
SCHEME NAME: Lifetime Contribution to Khell/Khell-Tiatr Awards
TAGS: Artist, Award, Culture, Heritage, Theatre
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Khell/Khell-Tiatr Awards" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize the immense contribution of Khell and Khell-Tiatr artistes who have significantly contributed to the development of this traditional art form, addressing the need to honor veteran performers who have dedicated their lives to preserving and promoting this cultural heritage. The scheme provides a prestigious lifetime achievement award consisting of a shawl, memento, citation, and cash burse of ₹50,000/- to deserving artistes, with a comprehensive selection process that evaluates excellence in acting, script writing, directing, singing, lyrics writing, set designing, and other theatrical contributions. The applications are accepted through recommendations from individuals/institutions and advertisements in local newspapers.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Cash burse of ₹50,000/- awarded to selected artistes.
Prestigious recognition through shawl, memento, and citation.
Special honor ceremony held annually on 24th October on the Birth Anniversary of Rosario Rodrigues, 'Promoter of Khell-Tiatr'.
Maximum 3 artistes are honored each year.
*The selected artistes must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age.
The applicant must have at least 10 years of contribution in the field of Khell-Tiatr.
The applicant must demonstrate excellence as an actor, script writer, director, singer, lyricist, set designer, or other theatrical role in Khell/Khell-Tiatr.
The applicant who is an actor/singer/stage manager/lights effects provider/make-up artist/costume designer/live music/background music provider must have performed in at least 10 khell-tiatrs.
The applicant who is a writer/director must have written/directed at least 10 khell-tiatrs.
*Award can only be received once in a lifetime across all related categories.
Evaluation Considerations
The applicant's innovative contributions to the presentation of Khell/Khell-Tiatr will be evaluated.
The applicant's work in other languages or films beyond Khell/Khell-Tiatr will be considered.
The applicant's published books of scripts/lyrics will be taken into account.
The applicant's previous awards in the field will be considered.
Relaxation
Age limit may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
The application is through recommendations from individuals or institutions, or through response to advertisements in local newspapers.
Step 1:
The applicant must take a printout of the prescribed format of the application form. Alternatively, the interested applicant should visit the Tiatr Academy of Goa, and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the designated staff.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields:
Recommender Information:
Fill in the complete details of the recommender including name, full address, contact numbers (landline and mobile), Aadhaar Card number, and provide a brief description of the recommender (limited to 100 characters).
Nominee Details:
Complete the nominee section with full personal information including name with title (Mr./Mrs./Miss), stage name, father's name, mother's name, date of birth, age, educational qualification, correspondence address, phone numbers (landline and mobile), Aadhaar Card number, and email identification.
Contribution Details:
Select the applicable contribution categories by ticking the appropriate boxes (Actor, Singer, Musician, Director, Producer, Writer, Lights, Setting, Sound, Promoter/Organizer, or Other with specification). Provide detailed information for each selected category including the number of Khell-Tiatrs involved and names of at least 10 productions.
Additional Achievements:
Fill in information about gramophone records, Compact Discs, Digital Versatile Discs produced, film appearances, published books of Khell-Tiatrs, and awards won for contributions to the Khell-Tiatrs stage.
Step 3:
Paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required). Attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 4:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to -
Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001
*Applicants are advised to save a copy of the submitted application form and any acknowledgment.
Selection Process
The Executive Board evaluates applications based on the stated criteria through recommendations and also reserves the right to select deserving artistes from outside the recommended list.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Birth Certificate
Recent Photograph
Aadhaar Card
Additional Documents/Evidence Supporting Contribution Claims
Photographs of Performances
*All documents should be submitted as copies.
*Recent photograph must be attached to the application form.
*Additional evidence may include records, certificates, programs, reviews, or other supporting materials.
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Goa
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/lckkta
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the monetary reward provided to the selected recipients of this lifetime achievement recognition?
The award consists of a cash burse of ₹50,000/- along with a shawl, memento, and citation as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
﻿
What is the minimum age requirement for being considered eligible for this prestigious cultural award?
Artistes selected for the award should be not less than 60 years of age, though this age limit may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well.
﻿
How many years of active contribution in the field are required for an artiste to qualify for consideration?
The awardee should have at least 10 years of contribution in the field of Khell-Tiatr to be eligible for this lifetime achievement recognition.
﻿
Are there any circumstances under which the minimum age criterion can be waived for potential recipients?
Yes, the age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well, allowing for exceptional considerations.
﻿
What is the minimum number of productions that actors and performers must have participated in to meet the eligibility requirements?
Actors, singers, stage managers, lights effects providers, make-up artists, costume designers, and music providers should have performed in at least 10 khell-tiatrs.
﻿
How many productions must writers and directors have created to qualify for this lifetime contribution award?
Writers and directors should have written or directed at least 10 khell-tiatrs respectively to meet the minimum qualification criteria.
﻿
What is the maximum number of recipients who can be honored with this award in a single year?
Not more than 3 artistes from the field will be conferred with Lifetime Contribution to Khell/Khell-Tiatr Awards every year.
﻿
On which specific date is the annual award ceremony held to honor the selected artistes?
The selected artistes will be honored with the award at a special function on 24th October every year on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Rosario Rodrigues, 'Promoter of Khell-Tiatr'.
﻿
Can an artiste receive this lifetime contribution award more than once during their career in different categories?
No, Tiatr Academy of Goa will confer Lifetime Contribution Awards only once in a lifetime, whether in Tiatr (Commercial/Non-Commercial), Khell, Khell-Tiatr, or Konkani Cinema.
﻿
Is physical attendance mandatory for the selected artistes at the award ceremony to receive their recognition?
Yes, the selected artistes will have to be compulsorily present in person to receive the award at the special function.
﻿
What types of additional creative contributions beyond Khell-Tiatr performances are considered during the selection evaluation process?
The selection considers whether the artiste has acted, directed, sung, composed music, composed lyrics, designed sets, designed background music, or designed light effects for dramas in other languages or films.
﻿
Are published literary works by script writers and lyricists taken into account during the assessment process?
Yes, if the nominee is a script writer or lyricist, whether they have published any books of their scripts or lyrics is considered during selection.
﻿
What kind of evidence or documentation should accompany the recommendation form to support the nominee's contribution claims?
Additional documents/evidence, photographs of performances, birth certificate, and Aadhaar Card copy should be enclosed along with the recommendation form.
﻿
Who has the authority to make modifications or amendments to the rules and guidelines of this award scheme?
Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules governing the Lifetime Contribution to Khell/Khell-Tiatr Awards.
﻿

SCHEME NAME: Lifetime Contribution to Konkani Cinema Award
TAGS: Artist, Award, Cinema, Culture, Heritage
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Konkani Cinema Award" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize and honor artistes including tiatr artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of Konkani Cinema in the past, addressing the need to acknowledge their significant contributions to this cultural art form. The scheme provides a prestigious annual award consisting of a shawl, memento, citation, and cash purse of ₹50,000/-, with recognition given at a special function held on 24th April every year on the anniversary of the release of the first Konkani film 'Mogacho Anvddo' by late Al-Jerry Braganza, 'The Father of Konkani Cinema'.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Cash Award:
₹50,000/- as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
Honorary Items:
Shawl, memento, and citation presented to the awardee.
Recognition Ceremony:
Special function held on 24th April every year on the anniversary of the first Konkani film.
*The awardee must be present in person to receive the award at the ceremony.
*The award ceremony attendance is mandatory - no proxy or representative acceptance is allowed.
*Once received, the award cannot be conferred again in the recipient's lifetime across any category.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age.
The applicant must have contributed to Konkani Cinema development.
Relaxation
The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well.
Selection Considerations
The applicant should demonstrate excellence as an actor, script writer, director, playback singer, lyricist, producer, or composer.
The applicant may have received awards in their respective field.
The applicant should have done innovation on the Konkani Cinema front.
The applicant, if a singer/musician, should have songs recorded on vinyl records, Compact Discs, Digital Versatile Discs, online platforms, or brought out in video format.
The applicant may have worked in films of other languages in various capacities including acting, directing, singing, composing music, composing lyrics, designing sets, providing background music, or designing light effects.
The applicant, if a script writer or lyricist, may have published books of their scripts or lyrics.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Step 1:
Recommendations are invited from individuals and institutions for deserving candidates.
Step 2:
Advertisements are published in local newspapers seeking nominations.
Step 3:
The Executive Board of Tiatr Academy of Goa reviews all recommendations and may also select deserving artistes from outside the recommended list.
Step 4:
Selection is made based on the specified criteria including years of service, excellence in their field, awards received, innovations made, and published works.
Step 5:
The selected artiste is informed and must confirm their availability to attend the award ceremony in person.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Proof of Age.
Proof of contribution to the Konkani Cinema.
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Goa
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/lckca

Not more than 5 artistes from the field will be conferred with these awards every year.
﻿
As a performer who has worked as an actor, singer, stage manager, or technical support, what is the minimum performance requirement I need to fulfill?
If you are an actor, singer, stage manager, lights provider, make-up artist, costume designer, live music provider, background music provider, organizer, or contractor, you must have performed in at least 30 tiatrs.
﻿
What types of innovative contributions on the tiatr stage are considered during the selection process for this recognition?
Any innovations you have done on the tiatr stage will be taken into consideration, though specific types are not detailed in the criteria.
﻿
Are there any age-related exceptions or relaxations available for artists who may not meet the standard age requirement?
The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artist is not well.
﻿
What are the different components that make up this lifetime achievement recognition package?
The award consists of a shawl, a memento, a citation, and a cash award as fixed by the Tiatr Academy of Goa.
﻿
On which specific date and occasion is the annual award ceremony held to honor the selected artistes?
The special function is organized on 14th December every year on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Joao Agostinho Fernandes, 'The Father of Tiatr'.
﻿
What is the standard age requirement that applicants must meet to be considered for this lifetime achievement recognition?
Artistes selected for the award should be not less than 60 years of age.
﻿
Can individuals nominate themselves directly, or must recommendations come through specific channels and procedures?
Selection is done through recommendations from individuals/institutions and advertisements in local newspapers, though the Executive Board can also nominate deserving artistes.
﻿
If I have worked in films or dramas in other languages besides tiatr, will this experience be considered during the evaluation?
Yes, your work in dramas in other languages or in films besides tiatr will be considered as part of the assessment criteria.
﻿
What role do published books play in the evaluation process for script writers and lyricists applying for this honor?
If you are a script writer or lyricist, any published books of your scripts or lyrics will be taken into consideration during the selection process.
﻿

SCHEME NAME: Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Non-Commercial)
TAGS: Achievement, Artist, Award, Culture, Heritage
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Non-Commercial)" was launched by the Tiatr Academy under the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to recognize and honor non-commercial artistes who have contributed immensely for the development of tiatr, its song and music through yearly Tiatr Festivals/Competitions organized by Kala Academy and by organizing tiatrs in villages, as well as artistes who have enriched Konkani Tiatr and Konkani Song through All India Radio, Doordarshan and other media platforms. The scheme provides lifetime recognition awards consisting of a shawl, a memento, a citation, and a cash burse as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa, with special consideration given to excellence in acting, script writing, directing, singing, lyric writing, set designing, and innovative contributions to the tiatr stage.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
The Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Award (Non-Commercial) consists of a shawl, a memento, a citation, and a Cash Burse as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa
Recognition and honor at a special function on 2nd January on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Lucasinho Ribeiro the 'Pioneer of Tiatr'
Lifetime achievement recognition for contribution to tiatr field
Awards are conferred annually with not more than 5 artistes receiving the award each year.
Awards are presented at a special function on 2nd January.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be not less than 60 years of age.
The applicant should have at least 10 years contribution in the field of tiatr.
The applicant should demonstrate excellence as an actor, script writer, director, singer, lyricist, set designer, or other relevant role.
The applicant should have performed in at least 10 tiatrs if working as actor/singer/stage manager/lights provider/make-up artist/costume designer/live music/background music.
The applicant should have written/directed at least 10 tiatrs if working as a writer/director.
Relaxation
The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well.
Post-Selection Conditions
*The selected artistes will have to be compulsorily present in person to receive the award.
*Tiatr Academy of Goa will confer Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards only once in a lifetime be it in Tiatr (Commercial/Non-Commercial) or Khell or Khell-Tiatr or Konkani Cinema.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
(This scheme operates through a recommendation system rather than direct individual applications)
Step 1:
Individuals or institutions can recommend deserving artistes by submitting the recommendation form along with complete nominee details. In the form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 2:
Submit the duly filled and signed recommendation form along with the documents to -
Tiatr Academy of Goa, AS-1 / AS-4, Block A, 2nd Floor, Campal Trade Centre, Opposite Kala Academy, Campal, Panaji, Goa, India – 403001
Alternative Method
The Executive Board of Tiatr Academy of Goa may also select deserving artistes from outside the recommended list through their own assessment and advertisements in local newspapers.
Selection Process
Step 1:
Selection is done based on established criteria considering years of service, excellence in specific roles, awards received, innovations on tiatr stage, recorded works, contributions to other language dramas or films, published materials, minimum 10 years contribution, and specific performance requirements based on role.
Step 2:
The Tiatr Academy of Goa Executive Board reviews all recommendations and makes final selections based on the established criteria, with successful candidates being notified for the award ceremony attendance.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Birth Certificate
Aadhaar Card (Copy)
Recent Photograph
Additional Documents/Evidence supporting contribution to tiatr
Photographs Of Performances
Details of educational qualification
List of tiatrs with specific contribution details as per role
Records of awards received (if any)
Documentation of published books (if applicable for script writers/lyricists)
Evidence of recordings on vinyl records, Cassettes, CDs, DVDs, digital media or broadcast on All India Radio/Doordarshan/TV Channels (if applicable for singers/musicians)

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the minimum number of years I need to have contributed to tiatr to be considered for recognition?
You must have contributed to the field of tiatr for at least 10 years to be eligible for consideration.
﻿
Can I apply directly for this recognition, or do I need someone else to recommend me?
You cannot apply directly. The selection process works through recommendations from individuals or institutions, though the Executive Board may also select deserving artistes independently.
﻿
What happens if I have already received a similar recognition in commercial tiatr or other Konkani performing arts?
You will not be eligible for this award if you have already received Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards in any category including Commercial/Non-Commercial, Khell, Khell-Tiatr, or Konkani Cinema.
﻿
If I am a script writer or director, how many productions must I have completed to qualify?
As a writer or director, you must have written or directed at least 10 tiatrs respectively to meet the eligibility requirements.
﻿
What is the specific age requirement for eligibility, and are there any exceptions to this rule?
You must be not less than 60 years of age, though this age limit may be relaxed if your health condition is not well.
﻿
How many artistes can receive this recognition in a single year, and is there any guarantee of selection?
Not more than 5 artistes from the field will be conferred with these awards every year, and selection is not guaranteed.
﻿
What types of contributions beyond acting and directing are considered for evaluation purposes?
Contributions as singer, lyricist, set designer, script writer, musician, stage manager, lights provider, make-up artist, costume designer, live music provider, and background music designer are all considered.
﻿
Is there any flexibility in the rules governing this recognition system that could affect my application?
Yes, Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules governing this recognition system.
﻿
What specific evidence should I provide if I have worked as a singer or musician in tiatr productions?
You should provide details of songs recorded on vinyl records, Cassettes, Compact Discs, Digital Versatile Discs, digital media, or broadcast on All India Radio/Doordarshan/Television Channels.
﻿
If I am primarily an actor or performer, what is the minimum number of productions I must have participated in?
If you work as an actor, singer, stage manager, lights provider, make-up artist, costume designer, live music provider, or background music provider, you must have performed in at least 10 tiatrs.
﻿
When and where will I receive the recognition if selected, and is my personal attendance mandatory?
You must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award at a special function on 2nd January on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Lucasinho Ribeiro.
﻿
What physical items and recognition will I receive as part of this lifetime achievement acknowledgment?
The recognition consists of a shawl, a memento, a citation, and a Cash Burse as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
﻿
Besides my tiatr work, will my contributions to films or dramas in other languages be considered during evaluation?
Yes, your work in acting, directing, singing, composing music, composing lyrics, designing sets, designing background music, or designing light effects for dramas in other languages or films will be considered.
﻿
What additional qualifications or achievements might strengthen my candidacy beyond the basic requirements?
Having received awards in your field, published books of scripts or lyrics, demonstrated innovation on the tiatr stage, and having a distinguished record as an excellent performer in your specific role will strengthen your candidacy.
﻿

SCHEME NAME: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled)
TAGS: Financial Assistance, Loan, Margin Money, Person With Disability, Self-employment, Shop
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The "Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled)" scheme was launched by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttarakhand. It aims to empower persons with disabilities by providing financial assistance for sustainable self-employment and livelihood generation. Under this scheme, the beneficiaries are supported with a mix of grants, subsidized loans, and margin money for term loans, shop construction, and bank-linked enterprises.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Term Loan Scheme:
Project Cost: ₹75,000/-
Grant: 20% or ₹10,000/-, whichever is less
Term Loan: ₹65,000/- at 6% annual interest rate
Shop Construction Scheme:
Project Cost: ₹50,000/-
Grant: 20% or ₹10,000/-, whichever is less
Margin Money Loan: ₹40,000/- at 4% annual interest rate, repayable in 60 monthly installments
Margin Money Loan Scheme for Bank Supported Loan:
Project Cost: Up to ₹2,00,000/-
Grant: 20%, maximum of ₹10,000/-
Margin Money: 25% of the project cost at 4% annual interest rate, repayable in 36 monthly installments

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
The applicant must possess a minimum of 40% disability.
The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000 in urban areas and ₹1,60,000/- in rural areas.
The applicant’s age must be between 18 and 50 years.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Application Process:
Step 1:
The interested applicant downloads the
application form
﻿
from the official website.
Step 2:
In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
Step 3:
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the office of the Vikas Khand (Block Development) Office.
﻿
Selection Process:
Step 1:
The application will be forwarded to the District Social Welfare Officer.
Step 2:
A District-Level Committee, headed by the District Social Welfare Officer, will review the proposals and select beneficiaries.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Passport-size Photograph.
Voter ID.
Aadhaar Card.
Disability Certificate.
Caste Certificate (If applicable).
Any Other Document if Required.

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Uttarakhand
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/lopsd
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Who can apply under this scheme?
Any Uttarakhand resident with at least 40% disability and within the age and income limits.
What is the income limit for applicants?
₹2,00,000 per year for urban residents and ₹1,60,000 for rural residents.
How much grant is provided?
Up to ₹10,000, depending on project cost and scheme type.
What is the interest rate on loans?
6% for term loans and 4% for margin money loans.
Can a person with UDID card apply?
Yes, the UDID card is valid proof of disability for this scheme.
Do I need a business plan?
Yes, a project proposal or cost estimate must be submitted.
Can I apply online?
No, the process is offline for the application.
Where do I apply for the scheme?
At your local Development Block Office in Uttarakhand.
Who selects the beneficiaries?
A district-level committee headed by the District Social Welfare Officer.
How do I know my application status?
Contact the Development Block or the District Social Welfare Office.

Only Scheduled Caste residents of Uttarakhand aged between 18 and 50 years.

₹1,05,600 annually for rural applicants; ₹1,29,840 for urban applicants.

Small-scale business, self-employment, and livelihood-based projects.

SCHEME NAME: Livelihood Support To Marine Fishermen During Fishing Ban Period
TAGS: Financial Assistance, Fishermen, Livelihood
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
Livelihood Support to Marine Fishermen during the Fishing Ban Period Scheme
under the Department of Fisheries & Animal Resources Development, Government of Odisha aims to support the livelihood of marine fisher families. This scheme is under the state sector Umbrella Scheme
Mukhyamantri Maschyajibi Kalyan Yojana (MMKY)
. The scheme supports the livelihood of marine fisher families in and around the turtle nesting and breeding areas of the state including round the year fishing ban in Bhitarkanika areas as no alternative is available. As the livelihood earning of fishermen is solely based on sea fishing and the ban on fishing directly prohibits the profession over a long period of seven months in a year (1st November to 31st May) (both days inclusive) along with a Uniform ban from 15th April to 14th June (61 days).
Area of Operation:
The Scheme shall be implemented in the Marine Districts of Kendrapara, Jagatsinghpur, Puri, and Ganjam along the Coastline of Odisha where the marine Fishers who are affected due to the ban on fishing round the year at Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary, Bhitarkanika National park and adjoining areas of Devi River and Rushikulya River Mouth for Sea Turtle Conservation.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Only one member of the affected families shall be assisted with ₹15,000/- annually under the scheme.
The amount shall be paid to the beneficiaries between November and March of a financial year in one Installment.
The assistance amount shall be released to the beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The following are the eligibility criteria for the beneficiary:
The beneficiary must be an active Marine fisherman.
The assistance will be provided to only one member of a family on behalf of the family.
The beneficiary must be in the age group of 18-70 years.
The beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Odisha and must possess identity and residential proof including an Aadhaar card.
The beneficiary must have a bank account in his/her name in the state of Odisha.
The beneficiary must be a boat owner (Motorized Boat)/ a crew member of a Motorized Boat / Fish trader/ engaged in sorting, and grading Fish, and other ancillary activities.
The Fishers should preferably belong to the BPL Category i.e. covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) and not belong to the automatically excluded household under the socio-economic and caste census (SECC)-2011.
If the fisherman is a Boat Owner, he must have valid registration (Real Craft) and a valid fishing license.
If the fisherman is a crew member, he must work in a registered fishing boat with a valid date fishing license and will produce a certificate from the boat owner in this respect.
If the fisherman is a Fish trader / engaged in sorting, grading of Fish, and other ancillary activities he must produce a certificate from a registered boat owner in this respect.
Note:
Preference of selection of beneficiaries shall be undertaken in the order of:
Boat Owner.
Crew member of a fishing boat.
workers engaged in sorting, grading, and other ancillary activities.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Application Process:
The scheme shall be advertised through the Departmental website, newspapers, and wall posters in the District and Block Fisheries Offices across the state.
Interested eligible beneficiaries/fishermen shall apply in the
prescribed format
devised by the Department to the Additional Fisheries Officer (Marine) of the district through the concerned Assistant Fisheries Officers (AFOs) (ME Unit)
(refer to page no.4 of guidelines).
﻿
﻿
﻿
The applicant shall attach the self-attested photocopy of the required document along with the application and show the original document at the time of submission of the application to the designated Receiving and Verifying Officer i.e. AFO Marine Extension unit.
Post-Application Processes:
After receipt of application forms the Receiving and Verifying Officer i.e. Assistant Fisheries Officer Marine Extension unit shall scrutinize the application and forward the same to the Additional Fisheries Officer (Marine).
A District Level Committee will be formed under the chairmanship of the Sub-Collector (concerned Sub-Division) along with Addl. Fisheries Officer (Marine) as a member convener for the finalization of the beneficiary list. The other members of the committee are the Tahasildar of the concerned Tehsil; a representative of the Forest, Environment and Climate Change Department; PRI Representatives, and an Office bearer of concerned marine PFCS.
The Committee of the concerned district will approve the applications after necessary cross-checks made at their level and recommend for release of assistance. The final list of the beneficiaries will be prepared by the Additional Fisheries Officer (Marine) and the same will be forwarded to the Directorate for uploading to the website.
The respective Additional Fisheries Officer (Marine) shall release the assistance amount to the beneficiaries through DBT.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Photocopy of Aadhaar Card
Photocopy of Voter I Card.
Photocopy of Ration Card.
Photocopy of the Registration Certificate of the Boat.
Photocopy of the Fishing License Certificate.
Certificate of Boat Owner, while working as a Crew Member/other activities.
Photocopy of 1st page of Bank Passbook.

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Odisha
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/lsmfdfbp

Frequently Asked Questions
What is the aim of the scheme?
The scheme aims to support the livelihood of marine fisher families in and around the turtle nesting and breeding areas of the state.
By which department was this scheme launched?
Fisheries & Animal Resources Development Department, Odisha

The scheme was launched in the financial year 2016-17.

Fishing is prohibited from 1st November to 31st May (both days inclusive) every year along with a Uniform ban from 15th April to 14th June (61 days).

SCHEME NAME: Livestock Health and Diseases Control
TAGS: Animal Health, Animal Husbandry, Livestock Diseases
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
Objectives
To implement Critical Animal disease control programme to eradicate PPR by 2030 by vaccinating all sheep and goats and to control Classical Swine Fever (CSF) by vaccinating the entire pig population To provide veterinary services at the farmers’ doorstep through Mobile Veterinary Units (MVUs) To assist States/UTs for Control of Animal Disease (ASCAD) by prevention & control of important livestock and poultry diseases prevalent in different States / UTs as per the State /UT’s priorities.
﻿
The LH&DC scheme covers a following activities:
Prophylactic vaccination programmes against various livestock and poultry diseases.
Disease surveillance and early detection.
Control and eradication of livestock diseases.
Capacity building of veterinary personnel.
Strengthening of veterinary infrastructure.
﻿
Critical Animal Disease Control Programme
Peste des Petits Ruminants Eradication Programme (PPR-EP).
Classical Swine Fever Control Programme (CSF-CP).
﻿
Scheme Implementation Strategy
State / UT to identify and designate suitable agency as SIA / LDB (preferably same as in NADCP).
State / UT / SIA shall develop further guidelines for implementation of the Scheme delineating roles and responsibilities of all functionaries at different levels.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Improved animal health and productivity
: To protect livestock from diseases, which leads to improved animal health and productivity.
Reduced economic losses:
To reduce economic losses to farmers due to livestock diseases.
Improved food security:
To improve food security by ensuring a steady supply of livestock products.
Increased employment opportunities:
To increased employment opportunities in the livestock sector.
Improved rural livelihood:
To improve the livelihoods of rural people who depend on livestock for their income.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
Beneficiary must be a bona fide farmer or livestock owner.
Beneficiary must have a valid livestock ownership document.
Beneficiary's livestock must be used for commercial purposes.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Contact local veterinary office or the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying in state.
Get the application form.
Fill out the application form with required details.
Submit it to the concerned authority.
Attach the required documents.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
An application form.
A copy of your Aadhaar card or other identity proof.
A copy of your livestock ownership documents.

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: All
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/lhadc
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is this scheme?
The Livestock Health and Diseases Control (LH&DC) scheme is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Government of India.
What are the benefits?
1. Improved animal health and productivity.
2. Reduced economic losses.
3. Improved food security.
4. Increased employment opportunities.
5. Improved rural livelihood.
Who can get the scheme benefits
1. Beneficiary must be a bona fide farmer or livestock owner.
2. Beneficiary must have a valid livestock ownership document.
3. Beneficiary's livestock must be used for commercial purposes.
What activities are cover under the scheme?
1. Prophylactic vaccination programmes against various livestock and poultry diseases.
2. Disease surveillance and early detection.
3. Control and eradication of livestock diseases.
4. Capacity building of veterinary personnel.
5. Strengthening of veterinary infrastructure.
What is the application process ?
1. Contact local veterinary office or the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying in state.
2. Fill out the application form and submit it to the concerned authority, along with the required documents.
What documents are required ?
1. An application form. 
2. A copy of your Aadhaar card or other identity proof.
3. A copy of your livestock ownership documents.

### DESCRIPTION

The "Living Craft Treasure Award" scheme was launched by the Handlooms, Handicrafts, Textiles, and Khadi Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. This award consists of a cash prize of Rs.1.00 lakh, a thamirapattiram, an 8-gram gold medal, and a certificate. The award is granted yearly.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Cash Prize of ₹1,00,000/-.
Thamirapattiram.
8-gram Gold Medal.
Certificate.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility

The applicant should be a native of Tamil Nadu.
The applicant should be working in the handicraft industry in Tamil Nadu.

The experience of the craftsman and the service he has rendered in his profession's special features will be taken into consideration during selection.

SCHEME NAME: Loan Assistance to Scheduled Castes Students for Commercial Pilot Training
TAGS: Loan, Pilot Training, SC
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme “Loan Assistance to Scheduled Castes Students for Commercial Pilot Training” is administered by the Director Scheduled Caste Welfare, Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat. The scheme was commenced in the year 1987 with the objective to provide financial assistance to bright Scheduled Castes Students who want to undergo training for commercial pilot license. Loan assistance is provided to all eligible Scheduled Castes candidates who are unable to afford training for a commercial pilot license due to poor economic conditions.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Under this scheme, a loan of ₹25 lakhs is provided at an interest rate of 4% to the eligible candidates.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state.
The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste Category of Gujarat State.
A candidate seeking to undergo Commercial Pilot License Training must have passed Matriculation or Higher Secondary School Certificate or its equivalent examination and must possess all the academic and technical qualifications required by the institute in which the candidate intends to undergo training for admission to the Commercial Pilot License Training Course.
The country/abroad institution providing such training should have obtained the conditions laid down for the admission of the trainee and all the necessary documents for such training such as a medical certificate, fitness certificate, etc.
The institute in which the trainee receives his training abroad must be approved by the government of his country for imparting such training and the commercial pilot license obtained after such training must be accepted in that country, after which the trainee must undergo a legal process of one year to get that license accepted in India.
The assistance will be sanctioned only after receiving the consent letter from the training institute for admission of the candidate; the trainee will have to submit the cost estimates for his training obtained from that institute.
If any of the relatives of the candidate desiring to undergo such training are living abroad, the trainees should not be sponsored for financial responsibility by them.
The applicant shall be free to repay the due amount earlier than the due date.
If the applicant uses this loan for any other purpose, the loan amount will be recovered from the date of repayment (together with penal interest).
The beneficiary has to furnish two valid sureties.
Note 01:
After completion of training the beneficiary will have to render his services in India for a minimum period of five years. If they settle abroad, the entire amount of such assistance will have to be returned to the Government of Gujarat with interest. There will be no relaxation in this.
Note 02:
The amount provided under this scheme will be limited to the amount actually required for training. The amount for training in India will include tuition fees and other incidental expenses. The decision of the Director, Scheduled Caste Welfare in this matter shall be final.
Note 03:
The amount of assistance will be paid at the rate of exchange fixed by the Reserve Bank of India while disbursing the amount under this scheme to the trainees who wish to undergo training abroad. And the allowances of the trainees will also have to be approved by the Reserve Bank. Loans can be sanctioned to the extent that the Reserve Bank approves tuition fees, subsistence allowance (for a maximum of six months), and allowance for start-up equipment.
Note 04:
The trainee should actually start the training within one month from the date of disbursement of the loan amount. The training should be obtained from the institution and also a quarterly report by the trainee on the progress of his training submitted to the Director, Scheduled Caste Welfare, Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
Note 05:
If the applicant defaults in regular repayment of the loan sanctioned, a penal interest at the rate of 2.5% per annum will be charged against the outstanding installments. In case of default in payment of penalty installments, all costs and other costs of recovery of the sheet as well as the balance will be recovered from the Revenue together.
Note 06:
Loan recovery will be started after one year from the date of disbursement of the loan to the beneficiary. The beneficiary will have to pay back the loan in 10 years with principal and interest in 2 years, total amount including interest in 12 years. Accordingly, the monthly installment amount will be calculated and recovered.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online
Offline
Step 01:
The eligible applicant may visit the e-Samaj Kalyan Portal:
https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/
﻿

Please Register Here
’.

Enter your Full Name as per Aadhaar Card, Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Card Number, Email ID, Caste etc., and then click on ‘Register’.

After successful registration, the applicants can login through their User ID and Password.
Step 05:
Now, click on ‘User Profile’ to update your profile.
Step 06:
Fill in all the mandatory information and then click on ‘Update’.
Step 07:
After updating the profile successfully, select the scheme appearing on the home page; an application form will open.
Step 08:
Fill in all the mandatory details in the application form and upload all the relevant documents.
Step 09:
Now agree with the terms & conditions and click on ‘Save Application’.
Step 10:
Submit the application form and take out the print of the application for future reference. The applicant can note down the application number to track the application status by logging into the portal using their User ID and Password.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
When was the scheme initiated?
The scheme was commenced in the year 1987.
What amount of loan is provided under this scheme?
A loan of ₹25 lakhs is provided at an interest rate of 4% to eligible candidates.
What are the eligibility criteria for availing this loan assistance?
The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state and belong to the Scheduled Caste category of Gujarat State.
Can the loan be used for other purposes?
No, the loan should be strictly used for training purposes. Any deviation may result in recovery with penal interest.
Are there any conditions regarding repayment of the loan?
Beneficiaries are free to repay the amount earlier than the due date. However, there are consequences for defaulting on repayments.
Is there any obligation after completing the training?
Yes, beneficiaries must render services in India for a minimum of five years after completing the training. Failure to do so may require repayment of the assistance with interest.
How can one apply for this loan assistance?
Eligible applicants can apply through the e-Samaj Kalyan Portal: https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/
What happens if the trainee settles abroad after training?
The entire amount of assistance must be returned to the Government of Gujarat with interest.
How is the rate of exchange determined for trainees undergoing training abroad?
The rate of exchange is fixed by the Reserve Bank of India, and allowances for trainees must also be approved by the Reserve Bank.
How long is the repayment period for the loan?
The loan must be repaid within 10 years, including a two-year grace period for interest repayment.
What is the frequency of loan recovery?
Loan recovery begins after one year from the date of disbursement and follows a monthly installment plan.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Offline
Loan applications are submitted by the applicants to the district offices of SCAs of NSKFDC of RRBs and Nationalised Banks.
These applications are then sent to the head offices where the project proposal is appraised by SCA/RRBs/Nationalised Banks and the projects are sent back to NSKFDC along with recommendations.
The Project Appraisal Committee of NSKFDC then appraises the proposals and after finding them in order places it in front of their board of directors for their approval.
Once the board of directors approves the project, the letter of sanction is issued by SCAs/ RRBs/Nationalised Banks.
Once all the terms and conditions have been accepted, the necessary documents and funds are then released to the concerned beneficiaries.
NSKFDC released the funds with the receipt of demand being made from the SCAs/ RRBs/Nationalised Banks after taking into consideration all the parameters of release as per the Lending Policies & Guidelines (LPG) of NSKFDC

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is moratorium period?
A moratorium period refers to a particular period of a loan tenure during which the borrower does not have to repay anything. It can be described as a waiting period before the borrower will have to start paying the equated monthly installments (EMIs) for his or her loan
Does the scheme provide loans to all Unorganized Workers persons?
No, the scheme  provides loans only to Safai Karamchari, Manual Scavengers and their dependants
How does the scheme provide assistance?
Under this scheme, term loans are extended through State Channelising Agencies (SCA), Regional Rural Banks(RRBs) and Nationalised Banks to the target group.
Is there any income limit for the scheme?
No, there is no such limit mentioned in the guidelines, however , other things being equal, NSKFDC accords priority to economic development and rehabilitation of:- i) Manual Scavengers and amongst scavengers those scavengers whose income is below double the poverty line; ii) Women from among the target group and iii) Disabled persons among the target group. • Financial viability, income generating capacity of the project etc. are considered while evaluating the projects for financing.
With what type of Projects can I avail this schemes?
Any viable and income generating schemes are financed by NSKFDC to Safai Karamcharis, Scavengers and their dependents. As per the project proposals received from the SCAs, the following sectors are given priority by the target group:-
Transport
Small and Petty Business
Non-land based schemes
Sanitation based equipments
I am a Domestic Worker, am I eligible for the scheme?
No, You are not eligible.
I am a Waste Picker, am I eligible for the scheme?
Yes, You are eligible.

These applications are then sent to the head offices where the project proposal is appraised by SCA/RRBs/Nationalised Banks and the projects are sent back to NSKFDC along with recommendations.
The Project Appraisal Committee of NSKFDC then appraises the proposals and after finding them in order places it in front of their board of directors for their approval.
Once the board of directors approves the project, the letter of sanction is issued by SCAs/ RRBs/Nationalised Banks.
Once all the terms and conditions have been accepted, the necessary documents and funds are then released to the concerned beneficiaries.
NSKFDC released the funds with the receipt of demand being made from the SCAs/ RRBs/Nationalised Banks after taking into consideration all the parameters of release as per the Lending Policies & Guidelines (LPG) of NSKFDC
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Indicative Documents
Aadhaar Card (not mandatory)
Occupation Certificate
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: All
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/lbssk-sms
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is moratorium period?
A moratorium period refers to a particular period of a loan tenure during which the borrower does not have repay anything. It can be described as a waiting period before the borrower will have to start paying the equated monthly installments (EMIs) for his or her loan
Does the scheme provide loans to all Unorganized Workers persons?
No, the scheme  provides loans only to Safai Karamchari, Manual Scavengers and their dependants
How does the scheme provide assistance?
Under this scheme, term loans are extended through State Channelising Agencies (SCA), Regional Rural Banks(RRBs) and Nationalised Banks to the target group.
Is there any income limit for the scheme?
The Scheme Guidelines do not mention any income limit. However, other things being equal, NSKFDC accords priority to economic development and rehabilitation of:- i) Manual Scavengers and amongst scavengers those scavengers whose income is below double the poverty line; ii) Women from among the target group and iii) Disabled persons among the target group. • Financial viability, income generating capacity of the project etc. are considered while evaluating the projects for financing.
I am a Domestic Worker, am I eligible for the scheme?
No, You are not eligible.
I am a Waste Picker, am I eligible for the scheme?
Yes, You are eligible.

SCHEME NAME: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Swachhta Udyami Yojana – Swachhta Se Sampannta Ki Aur
TAGS: Credit, Entrepreneurship, Financial Assistance, Loan, Manual Scavengers, Safai Karamcharis, Sanitation, Waste Pickers
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
A general term loan scheme by the Ministry of Social justice and Empowerment for Safai Karamchari, Manual Scavengers, and their dependants aged 18 years and above for procurement of sanitation-related vehicles.
﻿
Under this scheme, term loans are extended through State Channelising Agencies (SCA), Regional Rural Banks(RRBs), and Nationalised Banks to the target group.
﻿
Unit Cost
Upto 5 Lacs
Capital Subsidy:
50 % of the unit Cost
﻿
Unit Cost
5 to 10 Lacs
Capital Subsidy:
2 Lacs + 25 % of the unit Cost between Rs 5 -10 lac maximum upto 3.25 Lacs
﻿
Unit Cost
10 - 15 Lacs
Capital Subsidy
3.25 Lacs
﻿
Note
There will be no beneficiary contribution and the balance amount other than the capital subsidy will be provided as loan under SUY.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Term loan with a maximum unit cost of
Rs.50.00 lacs
at an interest rate of
4%
, for any viable income-generating schemes
including sanitation-related activities.
A
rebate of
1%
per annum on interest will be admissible to
women beneficiaries.
A
rebate of 0.5%
per annum will be extended for the beneficiaries for
timely repayment.
﻿
Repayment period:
Up to 10 years
after an implementation period of
4 months
and a moratorium of
6 months
and from the date of disbursement of the loan depending on the viability/profitability and repaying capacity of the unit.
﻿
Note:
Loans are extended through Channelizing Agencies (CAs) i.e. State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs), Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), and Public Sector Banks (PSBs) to the target group.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The following person(s)/entities shall be considered eligible for availing of financial assistance under the various schemes of NSKFDC:- • Safai Karamcharis (including Wastepickers), identified Manual Scavengers and their dependents.
Registered co-operative societies of the target group.
Legally constituted association/firm promoted by the target group, and
Persons, who produce a certificate from local Revenue Officer/local Municipal Officer/Cantonment Executive Officer/ Railway Officer, Head of the Govt. Departments (i.e. Schools, Colleges, Forest, Health, Education, Animal Husbandry) having rank not less than Gazetted Officer, Elected Members of Municipal Body, Pradhan of Gram Panchayats, and Regional Managers of Regional Rural Banks (RRBs)/Public Sector Banks (PSBs). However, under the MS Act, 2013, a person identified as a Manual Scavenger in a survey, need not provide any certificate once his/her name appeared in the final list of Manual Scavengers prepared by State Governments/Union Territory Administration (https://nskfdc.nic.in/en/content/home/ms-survey-2018, https://nskfdc.nic.in/en/node/79798  ).
Mukhia/ Sarpanch/ President or any other authority equivalent to Pradhan of Gram Panchayat for the issue of Occupation Certificate to Safai Karamcharis/ dependants; and In case of Municipal Bodies without Gazetted Officers, the head of such Municipal Bodies, maybe the Competent Authority.

SCHEME NAME: Loan For Commercial Pilot Training
TAGS: Loan, Opportunity, Pilot Training, Schedule Tribe
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The "Loan For Commercial Pilot Training" scheme was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe (ST) students in pursuing professional pilot training by providing affordable loans. Under this scheme, tribal students can avail a loan at a concessional interest rate, enabling them to secure high-quality training and good employment opportunities.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Monetary Benefit
Loan of up to ₹25,00,000 or the actual cost of training, whichever is lower.
Interest Rate
4% per annum.
Penalty Interest
2.5% per annum on delayed repayments.
Beneficiary Contribution
No contribution is required from the applicant.
Repayment Terms
Repayment begins 1 year after the loan disbursement date.
Repayment period is 144 monthly installments (12 years).
Includes 10 years for principal repayment and 2 years for interest repayment.
Early repayment is permitted.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
The applicant must be a student.
The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
The applicant must have passed Matriculation, Higher Secondary, Indian School Certificate, or an equivalent examination.
The applicant must have secured admission to a recognized commercial pilot training institute.
The applicant should have passed Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC).
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online
Registration Process
Visit the Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation
official website
.
Click on the "
APPLY FOR LOAN
".
Select the scheme name "Foreign Study".
Fill the registration form: Full Name (as per Aadhaar Card), Gender, Date of Birth, Aadhaar Number, Mobile Number, Uder name, Password for login, Confirm Password.
Click on the "Sign Up.
After successful registration, User ID and Password will be generated.
Application Process
Enter User ID, Password, and Captcha Code.
After login, schemes applicable to your caste will be displayed.
Click on the scheme you want to apply for.
Fill the "Application Form" and upload the required documents
Click Save Application. The system will generate an Application Number.
Click Print Application.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
7/12 Certificate
Affidavit

Certificate of Professional Course

Bank Passbook/Cancelled Cheque
Caste Certificate
Passport-size Photo
Ration Card
School Leaving Certificate
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Gujarat
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/lfcpt
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Who is eligible for the scheme?
Only Scheduled Tribe (ST) students of Gujarat who have secured admission to a recognized pilot training institute.
﻿
What is the maximum loan amount available?
₹25,00,000 or the actual cost of training, whichever is lower.
﻿
Is there any income limit for applying?
No, there is no income limit.

A penalty interest of 2.5% per annum is applicable.

.

Aadhaar, Caste Certificate, Educational Certificates, Admission Proof, Fee Receipt, Bank Details, among others.

No, only Scheduled Tribe students are eligible.

Yes, it applies to all tribal areas within the state.

==================================================
SCHEME NAME: Loan For Foreign Study (E.B.C.)
TAGS: College, Education, Finance, Loan, Student
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The scheme "Loan for Foreign Study (E.B.C.)" was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to provide students belonging to the Educationally Backward Class (E.B.C.) with financial assistance for higher education abroad. The scheme provides a maximum loan of ₹15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakh) for higher studies in foreign countries. The applications for this scheme are accepted online via the official website
https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/
.
﻿

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Financial Assistance
A maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- is provided for higher education abroad.
The loan is offered at a simple annual interest rate of 4%.
The loan covers costs such as air tickets, registration fees, tuition fees, education fees, hostel fees, books, and other expenses associated with the first year of the course abroad.
Disbursement Conditions
The full loan amount of ₹15,00,000/- will be disbursed to the student in a single installment.
The money will be deposited into the student's bank account after the submission of the original registered mortgage deed.
Post-Selection Obligations
After the sanction order is received, the student's parent or guardian must obtain the prescribed mortgage deed form from the District Office.
The property presented by the student's parent/guardian or the guarantor must be registered as a mortgage in favor of the government.
The loan repayment must begin one year after the completion of the student's study.
The loan must be repaid in monthly or quarterly installments.
The principal loan amount must be fully repaid within a maximum period of 10 years.
The interest amount must be fully repaid within a maximum period of 2 years.
The student must ensure all required documentation is completed within the prescribed time limit.
﻿

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
The applicant must belong to the Educationally Backward Class (S.E.B.C.).
The applicant's family annual income must be less than ₹10,00,000/-.
The applicant must have secured a minimum of 60% or more marks in 12th standard.
The applicant must have secured a minimum of 50% marks if they belong to Notified Tribes/De-notified Tribes (NT/DNT), More Backward, or Extremely Backward categories.
The applicant must be pursuing higher education abroad.
The applicant must be pursuing a Diploma, Graduate, Post Graduate, Post Graduate Diploma, Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.), or higher-level courses in any field.
The course must be for a minimum duration of 1 (one) academic year or more, or at least two semesters.
The applicant must apply before traveling abroad or within six months of arriving abroad.
The applicant must submit one solvent guarantor.
﻿

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online
Registration
Step 1:
Visit the Official Website of
eSamajkalyan
.
Step 2:
In the right pane of the home page, click "
New User? Please Register Here!
".
You will be taken to the Registration Form.
Step 3:
In the form, provide all the mandatory fields, fill in the captcha code, and click "Submit" to complete the registration process. A popup will appear acknowledging successful registration and displaying your User ID for Login.
﻿
Application
Step 1:
Visit the Official Website of
eSamajkalyan
. In the "Citizen Login" section provided in the right pane of the home page, provide your User ID and Password, fill in the Captcha Code, then click "Login".
Step 2:
In the ribbon provided at the top of the website, click the "Corporation" menu, then click "Gujarat State Divyangjan Finance and Development Corporation". A list of schemes will be displayed. Select the scheme you intend to apply for.
Step 3:
You will be taken to the online application form of the scheme. In the form, provide all the mandatory fields and upload all the mandatory documents in the specified format and size. Carefully review all the information provided and the documents uploaded. Make corrections, if any.
Step 4:
Click "Submit" to submit your application. You'll receive a confirmation message. Note down your Application Number for future reference. You can also take a printout of the submitted application form.
Step 5:
Following the successful online submission, the applicant must take a printout of the final application form. Two identical physical copies of the complete application set, along with attached enclosures of all uploaded documents, must be prepared. These two copies must then be deposited at the respective District Office (District Social Welfare Officer) applicable to the student.
﻿

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
During Application
• Caste Certificate.
• Family Income Certificate.
• Income Tax Return.
• Form-16.
• Mark Sheet.
• Degree Certificate.
• Offer Letter from Foreign University (Offer Letter/Letter of Acceptance).
• Copy of Student’s Passport.
• Copy of Student’s Visa (of the Foreign Country).
• Copy of Air Ticket.
• Parents’/Guardian’s Property Documents (And Valuation Report).
For Loan Disbursement
• Registered Mortgage Deed (Original) (Required after approval for loan disbursement).
﻿

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: Gujarat
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/lfs-ebc
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the minimum percentage of marks required in 12th standard to be eligible for applying for this educational loan scheme?
Applicants must have secured a minimum of 60% or more marks in their 12th standard examinations. However, if the applicant belongs to Notified Tribes/De-notified Tribes, More Backward, or Extremely Backward categories, the minimum requirement is 50% marks.
﻿
Is there a specific time frame within which I must apply for this financial assistance after deciding to pursue my studies in a foreign country?
Yes, you must submit your application either before traveling abroad for your studies or within six months of arriving in the foreign country where you intend to pursue your higher education.
﻿
What is the maximum amount of financial assistance available under this educational loan program for students planning to study outside India?
The scheme provides a maximum loan amount of ₹15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakh) to eligible students for pursuing higher education in foreign countries.
﻿
After receiving approval, what is the procedure for ensuring that the loan amount is transferred to my bank account?
After receiving the sanction order, your parent or guardian must obtain the prescribed mortgage deed form from the District Office and register the property as a mortgage in favor of the government. Once the original registered mortgage deed is submitted, the full loan amount will be deposited directly into your designated bank account in a single installment.
﻿
What types of educational programs and course durations are covered under this financial assistance scheme for overseas education?
The scheme covers Diploma, Graduate, Post Graduate, Post Graduate Diploma, Doctor of Philosophy courses, or higher-level courses in any field. The course must have a minimum duration of one academic year or more, or consist of at least two semesters.
﻿
What is the maximum annual family income limit that an applicant must meet to qualify for this loan assistance program?
The applicant's family annual income must be less than ₹10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakh) to be eligible for this loan scheme.
﻿
What is the interest rate charged on the loan provided for pursuing higher education in foreign universities under this scheme?
The loan is offered at a simple annual interest rate of 4%, making it an affordable option for eligible students seeking financial assistance for overseas education.
﻿
What specific expenses related to my foreign education will this loan cover during the first year of my course abroad?
The loan covers various expenses including air tickets, registration fees, tuition fees, education fees, hostel fees, books, and other costs associated with the first year of your course abroad.
﻿
When am I expected to start repaying the loan amount after completing my studies, and what are the installment options available?
Loan repayment must begin one year after the completion of your studies. The loan must be repaid in monthly or quarterly installments according to your convenience and financial capacity.
﻿
What is the maximum time period allowed for completely repaying the principal amount of the loan I have received?
The principal loan amount must be fully repaid within a maximum period of 10 years from the date you begin repayment, which starts one year after course completion.
﻿
Are there any mandatory requirements regarding property mortgage or guarantor that I need to fulfill for this loan scheme?
Yes, you must submit one solvent guarantor with your application. Additionally, after approval, the property presented by your parent/guardian or the guarantor must be registered as a mortgage in favor of the government before loan disbursement.
﻿
Which social categories are eligible to apply for this financial assistance program for pursuing education in foreign countries?
Applicants must belong to the Educationally Backward Class. This includes various categories such as Notified Tribes/De-notified Tribes, More Backward, and Extremely Backward categories with specific eligibility criteria.
﻿
What is the deadline for repaying the interest amount accumulated on the loan taken for my foreign education?
The interest amount on the loan must be fully repaid within a maximum period of 2 years from the commencement of your repayment schedule.
﻿
What documents related to my admission and travel must I provide when applying for this overseas education loan?
You must provide an Offer Letter or Letter of Acceptance from the foreign university, a copy of your passport, a copy of your visa for the foreign country, and a copy of your air ticket.
﻿

SCHEME NAME: Loan based Scheme for Pay and Use Community Toilets
TAGS: Pay And Use Toilets, Safai Karamchari, Toilet Construction Loan
==================================================

### DESCRIPTION
Details
The
Pay and Use Community Toilets Scheme
was
launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, aims to empower Safai Karamcharis and their dependents through livelihood-linked sanitation entrepreneurship. It is a Loan Based Scheme implemented by the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSKFDC). The Loans are extended through Channelizing Agencies (CAs) i.e. State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs), Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and Public Sector Banks (PSBs) to the target group. The key objective of this scheme is to promote entrepreneurship among Safai Karamcharis, manual scavengers, and their dependents by providing financial assistance to set up “pay and use” community toilets.
Purpose:
Provision of easy accessibility of the community latrines to the households (not having any such facilities in their houses) and for floating population in public places with high footfall e.g. bus stands, railway stations, markets etc.
To ensure proper maintenance of the facilities.
To prevent the necessity of manual scavenging.
Key Features:
Loan for Construction & Operation:
Financial assistance is provided to build and operate 10-seater community toilet units on a pay-and-use basis.
Maximum Loan Amount:
Up to ₹25 lakh for one unit.
Interest Rates:
4% per annum; 3% for women beneficiaries; 2.5% for timely repayment.
Repayment Period:
Up to 10 years, including 6 months moratorium on principal repayment.

### BENEFITS
Benefits
Livelihood:
Enables Safai Karamcharis to shift from manual scavenging to a respectable, income-generating sanitation business.
Collateral-Free, Low-Interest Loan:
Offers up to ₹25 lakh without collateral, at just 4% interest (even lower for women and timely repayment).
Moratorium period:
Six Months in addition to implementation period of six months.
Repayment period:
10 Years after implementation period of 180 days and moratorium of 180 days
Entrepreneurship Opportunity:
Encourages self-employment by allowing beneficiaries to construct and operate public “Pay and Use” toilet units.

### ELIGIBILITY
Eligibility
Indian citizens aged 18 years or above are eligible belonging to the category of:
Safai Karamcharis
Manual scavengers
Dependents of the above groups
Individual beneficiaries/ self-help groups from the target group of NSKFDC, through State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs), in collaboration with reputed organizations are eligible to apply for the scheme.
﻿
Note:
Scavenger/Safai Karamchari and their dependents duly identified under the National Scheme for Liberation & Rehabilitation of Scavengers (NSLRS) in a survey/registered co-operative societies of Safai Karamcharis/legally constituted association/firm promoted by the target group and also all those who produce a certificate from local Revenue Officer/local Municipal Officer/Cantonment Executive Officer/Railway Officer, Head of the Govt. Departments (i.e. Schools, Colleges, Forest, Health, Education, Animal Husbandry) having rank not less than Gazetted Officer, Elected Members of Municipal Body & Pradhan of Gram Panchayats for which the State Govt. is required to issue necessary notification, Regional Managers of the Regional Rural Banks/Nationalised Banks.
However, under the MS Act, 2013, a person identified as Manual Scavenger in a survey need not to provide any certificate once his/her name appeared in the final list of Manual Scavengers prepared by State/UT Governments.

### HOW TO APPLY
Application Process
Online
Offline
Loan applications are submitted by the applicants to the district offices of SCAs of NSKFDC of RRBs and Nationalised Banks.
These applications are then sent to the head offices where the project proposal is appraised by SCA/RRBs/Nationalised Banks and the projects are sent back to NSKFDC along with recommendations.
The Project Appraisal Committee of NSKFDC then appraises the proposals and after finding them in order places it in front of their board of directors for their approval.
Once the board of directors approves the project, the letter of sanction is issued by SCAs/ RRBs/Nationalised Banks.
Once all the terms and conditions have been accepted, the necessary documents and funds are then released to the concerned beneficiaries.
NSKFDC released the funds with the receipt of demand being made from the SCAs/ RRBs/Nationalised Banks after taking into consideration all the parameters of release as per the Lending Policies & Guidelines (LPG) of NSKFDC.

### DOCUMENTS REQUIRED
Documents Required
Proof of identity (e.g., Aadhaar card, voter ID).
Proof of age (e.g., birth certificate, school certificate).
Project proposal detailing the plan for the Pay & Use Community Toilet.
Proof of occupation as a Safai Karamchari or manual scavenger (if applicable).
Any other documents as specified by the Channelizing Agency.​

### METADATA & LINKS

        - Min Age: 18
        - Max Age: 60
        - State: All
        - Link: https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/lbssk-spuct
        

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Who is eligible to apply for the scheme?
Safai Karamcharis, manual scavengers and their dependents are eligible. Applicants must be aged 18 years or above and belong to the target group defined under the scheme.
What is the maximum financial assistance available under the scheme?
A maximum loan of ₹25 lakh is available for setting up Pay and Use Community Toilets, including construction, operation, and maintenance.
What is the rate of interest on the loan?
The standard interest rate is 8% per annum. However:
Women beneficiaries get a 1% rebate.
A 0.5% rebate is provided for timely repayment.
What is the repayment period for the loan?
The loan is to be repaid in 10 years, which includes:
A 180-day moratorium period after implementation.
A 180-day implementation period after loan sanction.
How can one apply for the scheme?
Applicants must approach the State Channelizing Agency (SCA) or other authorized partners like RRBs, PSBs, or NBFC-MFIs. A formal application with supporting documents must be submitted.
Is collateral required to avail the loan?
Generally, no collateral is required for loans up to ₹1.25 lakh. For higher loan amounts, security norms may vary depending on the Channelizing Agency’s terms.
Can groups like SHGs or cooperatives also apply?
Yes. In addition to individuals, Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and cooperative societies of eligible members can also apply under the scheme.

### FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the objective of the "Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC)" scheme?
The "Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC)" scheme, initiated by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, offers financial support to candidates from the Unreserved category. Eligible candidates can avail a loan of up to ₹25,00,000/- at a concessional interest rate of 4% per annum to undergo training for obtaining a Commercial Pilot License (CPL).
Who can apply for the Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot scheme?
Any candidate who belongs to the Unreserved (General) category, has passed the 12th standard (HSC), is a permanent resident of Gujarat, and has secured admission in a recognized commercial pilot training institute is eligible to apply under this scheme.
﻿
﻿
What is the maximum amount of financial assistance that a candidate can receive under this scheme?
Under this scheme, the Government of Gujarat provides eligible candidates with a loan of up to ₹25,00,000/- to cover the expenses associated with commercial pilot license training.
﻿
﻿
At what interest rate is the loan offered to the eligible applicants under this scheme?
The loan is provided at a concessional simple interest rate of 4 percent per annum, making it an affordable financial option for aspiring commercial pilots from the Unreserved category.
﻿
﻿
Is there any income limit specified for the candidate or their family to qualify for this scheme?
No, there is no individual or family income limit specified under this scheme, which means that applicants from all economic backgrounds within the Unreserved category can apply for the loan.
﻿
﻿
Can candidates from Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), or Other Backward Classes (OBC) apply for this loan scheme?
No, this scheme is specifically designed for candidates belonging to the Unreserved (General) category, and candidates from other social categories are not eligible to apply.
﻿
﻿
What is the mode of application for this pilot training loan scheme?
The application process is entirely offline, and interested candidates must obtain and submit the duly filled application form along with all necessary documents to the District Social Welfare Office.
﻿
﻿
What documents are required to be submitted along with the application form for this loan scheme?
Applicants are required to submit documents such as the income certificate, 12th standard marksheet, school leaving certificate, passport-size photographs, bank passbook or a cancelled cheque, and the fee receipt from the training institute.
﻿
﻿
Is the loan amount provided under this scheme required to be repaid by the applicant?
Yes, the loan amount provided under this scheme is repayable, and the candidate is obligated to repay the amount with a simple annual interest of 4 percent as per the terms and conditions specified by the department.
﻿
﻿
Does the scheme impose any age restrictions on applicants seeking financial assistance?
Although the scheme primarily emphasizes educational qualifications and category-based eligibility, applicants are generally expected to be of a suitable age for pilot training as per aviation training norms, though no specific age limit is mentioned in the scheme guidelines.
